document.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
From the starting position, breathe in and begin coming down slowly until the bar touches your middle chest.

After a brief pause, push the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out. Focus on pushing the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position at the top of the motion, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上。采用中等握距（使动作中点时前臂与上臂约成90度），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定将杠铃笔直举于身体上方。这是起始姿势。
从起始姿势吸气，开始缓慢下放，直到杠铃触及胸部中部。
短暂停顿后，呼气将杠铃推回起始姿势。集中用胸肌发力推起。在动作顶端手臂锁定并挤压胸肌，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所需时间约为上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over your neck with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, bring the bar down slowly until it is about 1 inch from your neck.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 采用中等握距（下放至动作中段时，前臂与上臂约呈90度角），将杠铃从架上取下，双臂锁定，将杠铃保持在颈部正上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到距离颈部约1英寸。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用胸肌发力将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位锁定手臂并挤压胸部，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。下放所用时间应至少是上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。
完成后，将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on you upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: it should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜训练凳上。采用中等握距（即动作中段时前臂与上臂约呈90度角），从架上取下杠铃，双臂伸直锁定，将杠铃保持在身体正上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到感觉杠铃接触上胸部。
停顿1秒后，呼气并用胸部肌肉将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂，挤压胸肌，保持1秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复该动作。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Bench Press - Powerlifting
instructions: Begin by lying on the bench, getting your head beyond the bar if possible. Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement.
However wide your grip, it should cover the ring on the bar. Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting your shoulders. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest or upper stomach. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times.
Pause when the barbell touches your torso, and then drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
instructions_zh: 先仰卧在卧推凳上，尽量让头部超过杠铃杆。双脚收在身体下方并拱起背部。借助杠铃杆支撑体重，将肩部抬离凳面并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚将斜方肌顶向凳面。整个动作中保持这种紧绷的身体姿势。
无论握距多宽，都应覆盖杠铃杆上的标记环。将杠铃从架上拉出，同时不要让肩部前伸。专注于握紧杠铃并尝试将其向两边掰开。
将杠铃下放至下胸部或上腹部。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持一条直线。
当杠铃接触躯干时稍作停顿，然后以最大力量将杠铃向上推起。肘部应收紧，直到锁定。

document.name: Bench Press - With Bands
instructions: Using a flat bench secure a band under the leg of the bench that is nearest to your head.
Once the band is secure, grab it by both handles and lie down on the bench.
Extend your arms so that you are holding the band handles in front of you at shoulder width.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
Bring down the handles slowly until your elbow forms a 90 degree angle. Keep full control at all times.

As you breathe out, bring the handles up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
instructions_zh: 使用平板凳，将弹力带固定在靠近头部的凳腿下方。
固定好弹力带后，双手握住两端把手，仰卧在长凳上。
双臂伸直，在身前与肩同宽握住弹力带把手。
达到肩宽后，将手腕向前旋转，使掌心朝外。这是起始姿势。
缓慢下放把手，直到肘部形成90度角。全程保持完全控制。
呼气时，用胸大肌将把手上举。在收缩位置锁住手臂，挤压胸部，停顿一秒，然后缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间应至少是上举时间的两倍。
按照训练计划规定的次数重复该动作。

document.name: Bench Press with Chains
instructions: Adjust the leader chain, shortening it to the desired length.Place the chains on the sleeves of the bar.

Lying on the bench, get your head beyond the bar if possible. Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement. However wide your grip, it should cover the ring on the bar.

Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting your shoulders. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart. Lower the bar to your lower chest or upper stomach. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times.
Pause when the barbell touches your torso, and then drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
instructions_zh: 调整主链条，将其缩短到所需长度。将链条放在杠铃杆的套筒上。
仰卧在卧推凳上，尽量让头部超过杠铃杆。双脚收在身体下方并拱起背部。借助杠铃杆支撑体重，将肩部抬离凳面并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚将斜方肌顶向凳面。整个动作中保持这种紧绷的身体姿势。无论握距多宽，都应覆盖杠铃杆上的标记环。
将杠铃从架上拉出，同时不要让肩部前伸。专注于握紧杠铃并尝试将其向两边掰开。将杠铃下放至下胸部或上腹部。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持一条直线。
当杠铃接触躯干时稍作停顿，然后以最大力量将杠铃向上推起。肘部应收紧，直到锁定。

document.name: Board Press
instructions: Begin by lying on the bench, getting your head beyond the bar if possible. One to five boards, made out of 2x6's, can be screwed together and held in place by a training partner, bands, or just tucked under your shirt.

Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement.

You can take a standard bench grip, or shoulder width to focus on the triceps. Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting your shoulders. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart.
Lower the bar to the boards, and then drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
instructions_zh: 先躺在卧推凳上，尽量让头部超过杠铃杆。可将1到5块2x6木板用螺丝固定在一起，由训练伙伴或弹力带固定，或直接塞在衣服下。
将双脚收在身体下方并拱起背部。借助杠铃支撑体重，将肩部抬离卧推凳并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚发力将斜方肌顶入凳面。整个动作过程中保持这种紧绷的身体姿势。
可采用标准卧推握距，或肩宽握距以侧重肱三头肌。将杠铃从架上取出时肩部不要前伸。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持对齐。专注于握紧杠铃并试图将其向外掰开。
将杠铃下放至木板上，然后以尽可能大的力量向上推起。肘部应收紧，直到锁定。

document.name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a close grip (around shoulder width), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest. Tip: Make sure that - as opposed to a regular bench press - you keep the elbows close to the torso at all times in order to maximize triceps involvement.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your triceps muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平板凳上。使用窄握（约与肩同宽），将杠铃从架上取下，双臂锁定，将杠铃笔直举在身体上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触及胸部中部。提示：与常规卧推不同，整个过程中应始终保持肘部贴近躯干，以最大化肱三头肌参与。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用肱三头肌将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂，保持一秒，然后再次开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所需时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按规定的次数重复该动作。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and slowly lay down on the bench.

Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The arms should be perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position. Tip: In order to protect your rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you lift the barbell off the rack.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your lower chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 将双腿固定在下斜长凳末端，然后缓慢躺到长凳上。
采用中等宽度握距（即在动作中段使前臂与上臂呈90度角的握距），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定并将杠铃笔直举在身体上方。手臂应与地面垂直。这是起始位置。提示：为保护肩袖，最好让保护者协助你将杠铃从架上取下。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触及下胸部。
停顿1秒后，呼气并用胸肌将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂并挤压胸部，保持1秒，然后再次开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。
完成后，将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. The dumbbells should be just to the sides of your chest, with your upper arm and forearm creating a 90 degree angle. Be sure to maintain full control of the dumbbells at all times. This will be your starting position.

Then, as you breathe out, use your chest to push the dumbbells up. Lock your arms at the top of the lift and squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then begin coming down slowly. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，哑铃放在大腿上方。掌心相对。
然后借助大腿将哑铃逐只抬起，使你能在身前以肩宽握持哑铃。
到达肩宽后，向前旋转手腕，使掌心朝向远离你的方向。哑铃应位于胸部两侧，上臂与前臂约呈90度角。始终确保完全控制哑铃。此为起始姿势。
然后呼气，用胸部发力将哑铃向上推起。在动作顶端锁臂并挤压胸部，停顿一秒后开始缓慢下放。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所用时间约为上推时间的两倍。
按训练计划规定的重复次数重复该动作。

document.name: Floor Press
instructions: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together; pull the bar off of the hooks.

Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck your elbows throughout the movement. Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.
instructions_zh: 调整J型挂钩到适合架上杠铃的高度。开始仰卧在地面上，头部靠近力量架一端。保持肩胛骨夹紧；将杠铃从挂钩上取下。
将杠铃下放至胸部下方或上腹部，下放时握紧杠铃并尝试将其向两侧拉开。整个动作中确保肘部内收。下放杠铃直到上臂接触地面并暂停，避免重量撞击或弹起。
尽可能快速地将杠铃推回上方，同时保持杠铃、手腕和肘部成一直线。

document.name: Floor Press with Chains
instructions: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. For this exercise, drape the chains directly over the end of the bar, trying to keep the ends away from the plates.
Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together, pull the bar off of the hooks.

Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck your elbows throughout the movement. Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.
instructions_zh: 调整J型挂钩至合适高度，以便架起杠铃。此动作中，将链条直接搭在杠铃杆末端，尽量让链条端头远离杠片。
仰卧在地面上，头部靠近力量架一端。保持肩胛骨夹紧，将杠铃从挂钩上取下。
将杠铃下放至胸部下缘或上腹部，同时握紧杠铃并尝试将其向外拉断。整个动作中确保肘部内收。下放杠铃直到上臂接触地面并停顿，避免重物砸地或反弹。
尽可能快速地将杠铃推回，同时保持杠铃、手腕和肘部成一直线。

document.name: JM Press
instructions: Start the exercise the same way you would a close grip bench press. You will lie on a flat bench while holding a barbell at arms length (fully extended) with the elbows in. However, instead of having the arms perpendicular to the torso, make sure the bar is set in a direct line above the upper chest. This will be your starting position.

Now beginning from a fully extended position lower the bar down as if performing a lying triceps extension. Inhale as you perform this movement. When you reach the half way point, let the bar roll back about one inch by moving the upper arms towards your legs until they are perpendicular to the torso. Tip: Keep the bend at the elbows constant as you bring the upper arms forward.
As you exhale, press the bar back up by using the triceps to perform a close grip bench press.
Now go back to the starting position and start over.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 以与窄距杠铃卧推相同的方式开始练习。仰卧于平板凳上，双手握杠，双臂伸直（完全伸展），肘部内收。不过，双臂不要与躯干垂直，而应确保杠铃位于上胸部正上方的一条直线上。这将是你的起始姿势。
现在从完全伸直的位置开始，像做仰卧三头肌伸展一样将杠铃下放。下放时吸气。当到达一半位置时，通过将上臂向腿部方向移动，让杠铃向回滚动约1英寸，直到上臂与躯干垂直。提示：在上臂向前移动时，保持肘部弯曲角度不变。
呼气时，使用肱三头肌以窄距卧推的方式将杠铃推回上方。
现在回到起始姿势并重新开始。
按推荐次数重复。

document.name: Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance
instructions: Lie face down with your whole body straight on a flat bench while holding a weight plate behind your head. Tip: You will need to position yourself so that your shoulders are slightly above the end of a flat bench in order for the upper chest, neck and face to be off the bench. This will be your starting position.
While keeping the plate secure on the back of your head slowly lower your head (as in saying "yes") as you breathe in.
Raise your head back up to the starting position in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold the contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在平板凳上，全身伸直，双手将杠铃片固定在头后。提示：调整位置，使肩部略高于凳端，让上胸、颈部和面部离开凳面。这是起始姿势。
保持杠铃片固定在头后，吸气时缓慢低头，像点头说“是”一样。
呼气时以半圆形轨迹抬头回到起始位置，顶峰收缩1秒。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Neck Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over your neck with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your neck.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上。采用中等握距（即在动作中段使前臂与上臂成90度角的握距），将杠铃从架上取下，双臂锁定，将杠铃笔直保持在颈部上方。这将是起始姿势。
吸气时缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃碰到颈部。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用胸肌发力将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂并挤压胸部，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所需时间至少应是上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复动作。
完成后，将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Pin Presses
instructions: Pin presses remove the eccentric phase of the bench press, developing starting strength. They also allow you to train a desired range of motion.

The bench should be set up in a power rack. Set the pins to the desired point in your range of motion, whether it just be lockout or an inch off of your chest. The bar should be moved to the pins and prepared for lifting.

Begin by lying on the bench, with the bar directly above the contact point during your regular bench. Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement.
You can take a standard bench grip, or shoulder width to focus on the triceps. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart.
Drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
Return the bar to the pins, pausing before beginning the next repetition.
instructions_zh: 销钉卧推去除了卧推的离心阶段，发展起始力量。它还允许你训练所需的动作幅度。
卧推凳应设置在力量举架内。将销钉调到动作幅度中的目标位置，无论是锁定位置还是离胸部一英寸处。应将杠铃移到销钉上并准备举起。
先仰卧在卧推凳上，使杠铃位于常规卧推时接触点的正上方。将双脚收在身体下方并拱起背部。借助杠铃支撑体重，将肩部抬离卧推凳并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚发力将斜方肌压向卧推凳。整个动作过程中保持这种紧绷的身体姿势。
你可以采用标准卧推握距，或采用与肩同宽以侧重肱三头肌。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持在一条直线上。专注于握紧杠铃并尝试将其向外掰开。
尽可能用力将杠铃向上推起。肘部应收紧，直到锁定。
将杠铃放回销钉上，在开始下一次重复前稍作停顿。

document.name: Plank
instructions: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.
instructions_zh: 俯卧于地面，用脚趾和前臂支撑体重。手臂弯曲，位于肩膀正下方。
始终保持身体挺直，并尽可能长时间保持该姿势。要增加难度，可以抬起一只手臂或一条腿。

document.name: Reverse Band Bench Press
instructions: Position a bench inside a power rack, with the bar set to the correct height. Begin by anchoring bands either to band pegs or to the top of the rack. Ensure that you will be position properly under the bands. Attach the other end to the barbell.

Lie on the bench, tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement. However wide your grip, it should cover the ring on the bar.

Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting your shoulders. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart. Lower the bar to your lower chest or upper stomach. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times.
Pause when the barbell touches your torso, and then drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
instructions_zh: 将卧推凳放在深蹲架内，把杠铃调到合适高度。先将弹力带固定在带钉或架顶，确保卧推时弹力带位于杠铃正上方，再将另一端连接到杠铃。
仰卧在凳上，双脚收于身下并拱起背部。借助杠铃支撑体重，将肩部抬离凳面并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚发力将斜方肌顶向凳面。整个动作保持这种紧绷身体姿态。无论握距多宽，都应覆盖杠铃上的标记环。
将杠铃从架上拉出，同时不要让肩部前伸。专注于握紧杠铃并试图将其拉断。将杠铃下放至下胸或上腹。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持在一条线上。
杠铃触及躯干时暂停，然后尽可能用力将杠铃推起。肘部应收紧，直至锁定。

document.name: Reverse Triceps Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a close, supinated grip (around shoulder width), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked extended in front of you and perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest. Tip: Make sure that as opposed to a regular bench press, you keep the elbows close to the torso at all times in order to maximize triceps involvement.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your triceps muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上。采用窄距、掌心向上（反握）握法（约与肩同宽），将杠铃从架上取下，双臂锁定伸直，置于身体正上方并与地面垂直。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃位于胸部中部。提示：与常规卧推不同，整个过程中始终保持肘部贴近躯干，以最大化三头肌参与。
停顿1秒后，呼气，用三头肌发力将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位锁臂，保持1秒，然后再开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间应至少是上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat bench underneath the smith machine. Now place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the flat bench. Using a pronated grip that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, lock the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 在史密斯机下方放置平凳。将杠铃杆调到躺下且双臂接近完全伸直时能够到的位置。选择所需重量后，仰卧于平凳。采用宽于肩的正握，从架上解锁杠铃杆，双臂锁定将杆笔直举于身体上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃杆落在胸部中部。
停顿一秒，呼气并用胸肌发力将杆推回起始位置。在收缩位锁定双臂，停顿一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放用时至少是上推的两倍。
按建议次数重复动作。
完成后，将杠铃杆锁回架上。

document.name: Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench with feet firm on the floor. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away from shoulder width (for each hand), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双脚牢牢踩在地面。采用宽握正握（掌心朝前），每只手比肩宽向外约3英寸（约7.6厘米），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定将杠铃保持在身体正上方。杠铃应垂直于躯干和地面。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触到胸部中部。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用胸肌将杠铃推回起始姿势。在收缩位置锁定双臂并挤压胸部，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应是上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench with the feet securely locked at the front of the bench. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away from shoulder width (for each hand), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your lower chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在下斜凳上，双脚牢牢固定在下斜凳前端。采用宽握正握（掌心朝前），每只手比肩宽向外约3英寸（约7.6厘米），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定将杠铃保持在身体正上方。杠铃应垂直于躯干和地面。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触到胸部下侧。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用胸肌将杠铃推回起始姿势。在收缩位置锁定双臂并挤压胸部，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应是上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

Ensuring that the dumbbell stays securely placed at the top of the bench, lie perpendicular to the bench (torso across it as in forming a cross) with only your shoulders lying on the surface. Hips should be below the bench and legs bent with feet firmly on the floor. The head will be off the bench as well.

Grasp the dumbbell with both hands and hold it straight over your chest with a bend in your arms. Both palms should be pressing against the underside one of the sides of the dumbbell. This will be your starting position. Caution: Always ensure that the dumbbell used for this exercise is secure. Using a dumbbell with loose plates can result in the dumbbell falling apart and falling on your face.
While keeping your arms locked in the bent arm position, lower the weight slowly in an arc behind your head while breathing in until you feel a stretch on the chest.
At that point, bring the dumbbell back to the starting position using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhale as you perform this movement.
Hold the weight on the initial position for a second and repeat the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将一只哑铃直立放在平凳上。
确保哑铃稳固地放在平凳顶端，身体与平凳垂直（躯干横跨凳面，呈十字形），仅肩部贴在凳面上。髋部应低于凳面，双腿弯曲，双脚稳稳踩地。头部也应离开凳面。
双手握住哑铃，手臂微屈，将哑铃保持在胸部正上方。双掌心应抵住哑铃同一侧的下方。这是起始姿势。注意：始终确保本练习使用的哑铃牢固可靠。使用片片松动的哑铃可能导致哑铃散开并砸到脸部。
保持手臂锁定在弯曲姿势，吸气，将重量沿弧线缓慢下放至头后，直到胸部有拉伸感。
到达该位置后，沿下放时的弧线将哑铃带回起始位置，并在动作过程中呼气。
在起始位置稍作停顿一秒，然后按规定的次数重复动作。

document.name: Board Press
instructions: Begin by lying on the bench, getting your head beyond the bar if possible. One to five boards, made out of 2x6's, can be screwed together and held in place by a training partner, bands, or just tucked under your shirt.

Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement.

You can take a standard bench grip, or shoulder width to focus on the triceps. Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting your shoulders. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart.
Lower the bar to the boards, and then drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
instructions_zh: 先躺在卧推凳上，尽量让头部超过杠铃杆。可将1到5块2x6木板用螺丝固定在一起，由训练伙伴或弹力带固定，或直接塞在衣服下。
将双脚收在身体下方并拱起背部。借助杠铃支撑体重，将肩部抬离卧推凳并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚发力将斜方肌顶入凳面。整个动作过程中保持这种紧绷的身体姿势。
可采用标准卧推握距，或肩宽握距以侧重肱三头肌。将杠铃从架上取出时肩部不要前伸。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持对齐。专注于握紧杠铃并试图将其向外掰开。
将杠铃下放至木板上，然后以尽可能大的力量向上推起。肘部应收紧，直到锁定。

document.name: Chain Press
instructions: Begin by connecting the chains to the cable handle attachments. Position yourself on the flat bench in the same position as for a dumbbell press. Your wrists should be pronated and arms perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Lower the chains by flexing the elbows, unloading some of the chain onto the floor.
Continue until your elbow forms a 90 degree angle, and then reverse the motion by extending through the elbow to lockout.
instructions_zh: 先把链条连接到绳索手柄上。仰卧在平板凳上，姿势与哑铃卧推相同。手腕旋前，手臂垂直于地面。这是起始姿势。
屈肘下放链条，让部分链条落到地面上卸载重量。
继续下放直至肘关节约呈90度，然后反向通过伸展肘关节推至锁定位置。

document.name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Press
instructions: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

Ensuring that the dumbbell stays securely placed at the top of the bench, lie perpendicular to the bench with only your shoulders lying on the surface. Hips should be below the bench and your legs bent with your feet firmly on the floor.

Grasp the dumbbell with both hands and hold it straight over your chest at arm's length. Both palms should be pressing against the underside of the sides of the dumbbell. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by lowering the dumbbell to your chest.
Return to the starting position by extending the elbows.
instructions_zh: 将一个哑铃竖直放在平板凳上。
确保哑铃稳固地放在凳子上端，身体与凳子垂直仰卧，只有肩部躺在凳面上。髋部应低于凳子，双腿弯曲，双脚牢牢踩地。
双手抓住哑铃，双臂伸直将哑铃举在胸部正上方。双掌应压住哑铃两侧的下缘。这是起始姿势。
通过将哑铃下放到胸部来启动动作。
伸肘回到起始位置。

document.name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
Once you are laying down, move the dumbbells in front of you at shoulder width.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
Bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe out. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times. Tip: Throughout the motion, the forearms should always be perpendicular to the floor.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up..
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
instructions_zh: 将双腿固定在下降凳末端，躺下，双手各持一个哑铃置于大腿上方，掌心相对。
躺下后，将哑铃移到身前，与肩同宽。
到达肩宽后，将手腕向前旋转，使掌心朝外。这将是你的起始位置。
呼气的同时，将哑铃缓慢下放至身体两侧。始终完全控制哑铃。提示：整个动作过程中，前臂应始终垂直于地面。
呼气的同时，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置锁定手臂，挤压胸部，保持1秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间应至少是上推时间的两倍。
按照训练计划规定的次数重复该动作。

document.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. The dumbbells should be just to the sides of your chest, with your upper arm and forearm creating a 90 degree angle. Be sure to maintain full control of the dumbbells at all times. This will be your starting position.

Then, as you breathe out, use your chest to push the dumbbells up. Lock your arms at the top of the lift and squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then begin coming down slowly. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，哑铃放在大腿上方。掌心相对。
然后借助大腿将哑铃逐只抬起，使你能在身前以肩宽握持哑铃。
到达肩宽后，向前旋转手腕，使掌心朝向远离你的方向。哑铃应位于胸部两侧，上臂与前臂约呈90度角。始终确保完全控制哑铃。此为起始姿势。
然后呼气，用胸部发力将哑铃向上推起。在动作顶端锁臂并挤压胸部，停顿一秒后开始缓慢下放。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所用时间约为上推时间的两倍。
按训练计划规定的重复次数重复该动作。

document.name: Dumbbell Bench Press with Neutral Grip
instructions: Take a dumbbell in each hand and lay back onto a flat bench. Your feet should be flat on the floor and your shoulder blades retracted.
Maintaining a neutral grip, palms facing each other, begin with your arms extended directly above you, perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the elbow, lowering the upper arms to the side. Descend until the dumbbells are to your torso.
Pause, then extend the elbow and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，仰卧在平凳上。双脚平放于地面，肩胛骨后缩。
保持中立握法（掌心相对），双臂伸直位于身体正上方，与地面垂直。此为起始姿势。
开始动作时屈肘，将上臂向身体两侧下放。下降至哑铃到达躯干两侧。
稍作停顿，然后伸肘回到起始位置。

document.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lay on the floor holding dumbbells in your hands. Your knees can be bent. Begin with the weights fully extended above you.
Lower the weights until your upper arm comes in contact with the floor. You can tuck your elbows to emphasize triceps size and strength, or to focus on your chest angle your arms to the side.
Pause at the bottom, and then bring the weight together at the top by extending through the elbows.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，双手持哑铃。膝盖可弯曲。开始时将哑铃完全伸直举于身体上方。
下放哑铃，直到上臂接触地面。你可以内收肘部以强化肱三头肌的尺寸和力量，或让手臂向两侧展开以侧重胸部。
在底部稍作停顿，然后通过伸肘将哑铃推起，并在顶部将哑铃靠拢。

document.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: While holding a dumbbell in each hand, sit on a military press bench or utility bench that has back support. Place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.
Now raise the dumbbells to shoulder height one at a time using your thighs to help propel them up into position.
Make sure to rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position.
Now, exhale and push the dumbbells upward until they touch at the top.
Then, after a brief pause at the top contracted position, slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，坐在有靠背的肩推凳或综合训练凳上。将哑铃竖直放在大腿上方。
现在用大腿帮助，将哑铃一只一只推起到肩部高度。
确保转动手腕，使掌心朝前。这是起始姿势。
现在呼气，向上推起哑铃，直到顶端相触。
在顶端收缩位置短暂停顿后，吸气并缓慢将哑铃放回起始姿势。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. This will be your starting position.
Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back in your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to dispose of the dumbbells.
document.name_zh: 锤式握法上斜哑铃卧推
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜凳上，双手各持哑铃置于大腿上方。掌心相对。
借助大腿将哑铃向上送，一次一只手臂将哑铃翻起，以便以肩宽握住。
到达肩宽后，保持双手中立握（掌心相对）。肘部向外展开，上臂与肩部成一直线（垂直于躯干），肘部弯曲使上臂与前臂成90度。这是起始姿势。
吸气，同时缓慢将重量下放至身体两侧。始终完全控制哑铃。
呼气，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置锁定手臂，停留一秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复动作。
完成后，将哑铃放回大腿上，再放到地面。这是放下哑铃最安全的方式。

document.name: Incline Bench Pull
instructions: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and lie face down on an incline bench that is set to an incline that is approximately 30 degrees.
Let the arms hang to your sides fully extended as they point to the floor.
Turn the wrists until your hands have a pronated (palms down) grip.
Now flare the elbows out. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, start to pull the dumbbells up as if you are doing a reverse bench press. You will do this by bending at the elbows and bringing the upper arms up as you let the forearms hang. Continue this motion until the upper arms are at the same level as your back. Tip: The elbows will come out to the side and your upper arms and torso should make the letter "T" at the top of the movement. Hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各握一只哑铃，俯卧在上斜凳上，凳面角度约为30度。
让双臂自然垂于身体两侧并完全伸直，指向地面。
转动手腕，使双手呈旋前握法（掌心向下）。
现在将肘部向外展开。这是起始姿势。
呼气，开始像做反向卧推一样将哑铃向上拉起。通过屈肘并抬起上臂、让前臂自然下垂来完成。继续该动作，直到上臂与背部处于同一水平。提示：肘部会向两侧打开，动作顶端上臂与躯干应呈字母“T”形。在顶端保持收缩一秒。
吸气，缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. This will be your starting position.
Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back in your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to dispose of the dumbbells.
document.name_zh: 上斜哑铃卧推（掌心相对）
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上。掌心相对。
借助大腿将哑铃抬起，一次一只手臂将哑铃翻举到肩宽位置。
到达肩宽后，双手保持中立握法（掌心相对）。肘部向外展开，上臂与肩同一直线（垂直于躯干），肘部弯曲使上臂与前臂呈90度。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢将哑铃下放至身体两侧。始终完全控制哑铃。
呼气，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置锁定手臂，保持一秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复动作。
完成后，将哑铃放回大腿上，再放到地面。这是放下哑铃最安全的方式。

document.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand atop your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help push the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.
Once you have the dumbbells raised to shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
Be sure to keep full control of the dumbbells at all times. Then breathe out and push the dumbbells up with your chest.
Lock your arms at the top, hold for a second, and then start slowly lowering the weight. Tip Ideally, lowering the weights should take about twice as long as raising them.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back on your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to release the dumbbells.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上，掌心相对。
然后借助大腿将哑铃向上推起，一次举起一只，使你能以与肩同宽的距离握住哑铃。
将哑铃举到与肩同宽后，向前转动手腕，使掌心朝向远离自己的方向。这是起始姿势。
始终确保完全控制哑铃。然后呼气，用胸部力量将哑铃向上推起。
在顶部伸直手臂并锁定，停顿1秒，然后开始缓慢下放重量。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所用时间应约为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复动作。
完成后，将哑铃放回大腿上，再放到地面。这是放下哑铃最安全的方式。

document.name: Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench face up while holding a dumbbell in each arm on top of your thighs.
Bring the dumbbells to the sides with the arms extended and the palms of the hands facing your thighs (neutral grip).

While keeping the arms close to your torso and elbows in, slowly lower your arms (as you keep them extended with a slight bend at the elbows) as far down towards the floor as you can go. Once you cannot go down any further, lock your upper arms in that position and that will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, slowly begin to curl the weights up as you simultaneously rotate your wrists so that the palms of the hands face up. Continue curling the weight until your biceps are fully contracted and squeeze hard at the top position for a second. Tip: Only the forearms should move. Upper arms should remain stationary and elbows should stay in throughout the movement.
Return back to the starting position very slowly.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平板凳上，双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上。
将哑铃移至身体两侧，手臂伸直，掌心朝向大腿（中立握法）。
保持手臂贴近躯干、肘部内收，缓慢将手臂（保持伸直但肘部微屈）尽可能向地面方向下放。下放到最低点后，在该位置固定上臂，此为起始姿势。
呼气的同时缓慢开始弯举重量，同时旋转手腕使掌心朝上。持续弯举至肱二头肌完全收缩，并在顶端用力挤压一秒。提示：只有前臂应移动，上臂保持不动、肘部始终内收。
非常缓慢地回到起始位置。

document.name: One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie down sideways on an incline bench press with a dumbbell in the hand. Make sure the shoulder is pressing against the incline bench and the arm is lying across your body with the palm around your navel.
Hold a dumbbell in your uppermost arm while keeping it extended in front of you parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.

While keeping the dumbbell parallel to the floor at all times, perform a lateral raise. Your arm should travel straight up until it is pointing at the ceiling. Tip: Exhale as you perform this movement. Hold the dumbbell in the position and feel the contraction in the shoulders for a second.
While inhaling lower the weight across your body back into the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
instructions_zh: 侧卧在上斜卧推凳上，一只手握哑铃。确保肩部贴紧上斜凳，手臂横放在身体前方，手掌位于肚脐附近。
用位于上方的手臂握住哑铃，并保持手臂向前伸直、与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
始终保持哑铃与地面平行，做侧平举。手臂应笔直向上移动，直到指向天花板。提示：执行此动作时呼气。在最高位置保持哑铃并感受肩部收缩一秒。
吸气的同时，将重量沿身体前方下放回起始位置。
按指定次数重复该动作。
换手臂重复该动作。

document.name: One-Arm Side Laterals
instructions: Pick a dumbbell and place it in one of your hands. Your non lifting hand should be used to grab something steady such as an incline bench press. Lean towards your lifting arm and away from the hand that is gripping the incline bench as this will allow you to keep your balance.
Stand with a straight torso and have the dumbbell by your side at arm's length with the palm of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbell to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and your hand slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arm is parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
instructions_zh: 选择一只哑铃放在一只手中。非持铃手应抓住稳固物体，如上斜卧推凳。身体向持铃臂一侧倾斜，并远离抓握上斜凳的手，以保持平衡。
站直，躯干保持正直，哑铃垂于体侧，手臂伸直，掌心朝向自己。这是起始姿势。
保持躯干不动（不要摆动），肘部微屈，将哑铃向侧面举起，手部略微向前倾斜，如同向玻璃杯中倒水。继续上举直至手臂与地面平行。执行此动作时呼气，并在顶部停顿一秒。
吸气的同时缓慢将哑铃放回起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。
换另一侧手臂重复该练习。

document.name: One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand on top of your thigh.

By using your thigh to help you get the dumbbell up, clean the dumbbell up so that you can hold it in front of you at shoulder width. Use the hand you are not lifting with to help position the dumbbell over you properly.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrist forward so that the palm of your hand is facing away from you. This will be your starting position.

Bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbell at all times. Tip: Use the hand that you are not lifting with to help keep the dumbbell balance as you may struggle a bit at first. Only use your non-lifting hand if it is needed. Otherwise, keep it resting to the side.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，一只手持哑铃置于大腿上方。
借助大腿将哑铃向上送到肩宽位置，使其能在身前握住。用未持铃的手帮助将哑铃摆放到身体正上方。
到达肩宽后，向前转腕，使掌心背向自己。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢将哑铃下放至身体一侧。始终完全控制哑铃。提示：初练时可能有些不稳，可用未持铃的手辅助保持哑铃平衡；仅在需要时使用，否则放在体侧休息。
呼气，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置伸直手臂，挤压胸部，停留一秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间应至少是上推时间的两倍。
按训练计划规定次数重复动作。
换手臂重复。

document.name: Pin Presses
instructions: Pin presses remove the eccentric phase of the bench press, developing starting strength. They also allow you to train a desired range of motion.

The bench should be set up in a power rack. Set the pins to the desired point in your range of motion, whether it just be lockout or an inch off of your chest. The bar should be moved to the pins and prepared for lifting.

Begin by lying on the bench, with the bar directly above the contact point during your regular bench. Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement.
You can take a standard bench grip, or shoulder width to focus on the triceps. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart.
Drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
Return the bar to the pins, pausing before beginning the next repetition.
instructions_zh: 销钉卧推去除了卧推的离心阶段，发展起始力量。它还允许你训练所需的动作幅度。
卧推凳应设置在力量举架内。将销钉调到动作幅度中的目标位置，无论是锁定位置还是离胸部一英寸处。应将杠铃移到销钉上并准备举起。
先仰卧在卧推凳上，使杠铃位于常规卧推时接触点的正上方。将双脚收在身体下方并拱起背部。借助杠铃支撑体重，将肩部抬离卧推凳并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚发力将斜方肌压向卧推凳。整个动作过程中保持这种紧绷的身体姿势。
你可以采用标准卧推握距，或采用与肩同宽以侧重肱三头肌。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持在一条直线上。专注于握紧杠铃并尝试将其向外掰开。
尽可能用力将杠铃向上推起。肘部应收紧，直到锁定。
将杠铃放回销钉上，在开始下一次重复前稍作停顿。

document.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Grab a couple of dumbbells and sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.
Clean the dumbbells up one at a time by using your thighs to bring the dumbbells up to shoulder height at each side.
Rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position.
As you exhale, push the dumbbells up until they touch at the top.
After a second pause, slowly come down back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 拿起一对哑铃，坐在有靠背的军用推举凳或训练凳上，将哑铃竖直放在大腿上方。
用大腿将哑铃逐个辅助上提至肩部高度，左右各一。
旋转手腕，使掌心朝前。这是起始姿势。
呼气时向上推举哑铃，直到顶部相触。
停顿一秒后，吸气并缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Standing Alternating Dumbbell Press
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand. Raise the dumbbells to your shoulders with your palms facing forward and your elbows pointed out. This will be your starting position.
Extend one arm to press the dumbbell straight up, keeping your off hand in place. Do not lean or jerk the weight during the movement.
After a brief pause, return the weight to the starting position.
Repeat for the opposite side, continuing to alternate between arms.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手各持一只哑铃。将哑铃举至肩部，掌心向前，肘部向外。这是起始姿势。
伸直一侧手臂，将哑铃垂直向上推起，另一只手保持不动。动作过程中不要倾斜身体或猛甩重量。
短暂停顿后，将重量放回起始姿势。
换另一侧重复，继续双臂交替进行。

document.name: Standing Dumbbell Press
instructions: Standing with your feet shoulder width apart, take a dumbbell in each hand. Raise the dumbbells to head height, the elbows out and about 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Maintaining strict technique with no leg drive or leaning back, extend through the elbow to raise the weights together directly above your head.
Pause, and slowly return the weight to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃。将哑铃举至头部高度，肘部外展约90度。这是起始姿势。
保持严格动作，不借助腿部驱动或后仰，伸展肘关节将哑铃一起直接举过头顶。
停顿，然后缓慢将重量回到起始姿势。

document.name: Alternate Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. Tip: Keep the elbows close to the torso.This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the right weight forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. As you do so, rotate the hand so that the palm is facing up. Continue the movement until your biceps is fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps. Tip: Only the forearms should move.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbell back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat the movement with the left hand. This equals one repetition.
Continue alternating in this manner for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，手臂自然下垂。提示：肘部靠近躯干。这是起始姿势。
保持上臂不动，呼气时向前弯举右侧哑铃并收缩肱二头肌。同时旋转手部，使掌心朝上。继续动作直到肱二头肌完全收缩、哑铃到达肩部高度。在收缩位置停留一秒并挤压肱二头肌。提示：只有前臂应移动。
吸气时慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复该动作。这算一次重复。
按此方式继续交替进行建议的次数。

document.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on you upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: it should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜训练凳上。采用中等握距（即动作中段时前臂与上臂约呈90度角），从架上取下杠铃，双臂伸直锁定，将杠铃保持在身体正上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到感觉杠铃接触上胸部。
停顿1秒后，呼气并用胸部肌肉将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂，挤压胸肌，保持1秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复该动作。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

Ensuring that the dumbbell stays securely placed at the top of the bench, lie perpendicular to the bench (torso across it as in forming a cross) with only your shoulders lying on the surface. Hips should be below the bench and legs bent with feet firmly on the floor. The head will be off the bench as well.

Grasp the dumbbell with both hands and hold it straight over your chest with a bend in your arms. Both palms should be pressing against the underside one of the sides of the dumbbell. This will be your starting position. Caution: Always ensure that the dumbbell used for this exercise is secure. Using a dumbbell with loose plates can result in the dumbbell falling apart and falling on your face.
While keeping your arms locked in the bent arm position, lower the weight slowly in an arc behind your head while breathing in until you feel a stretch on the chest.
At that point, bring the dumbbell back to the starting position using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhale as you perform this movement.
Hold the weight on the initial position for a second and repeat the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将一只哑铃直立放在平凳上。
确保哑铃稳固地放在平凳顶端，身体与平凳垂直（躯干横跨凳面，呈十字形），仅肩部贴在凳面上。髋部应低于凳面，双腿弯曲，双脚稳稳踩地。头部也应离开凳面。
双手握住哑铃，手臂微屈，将哑铃保持在胸部正上方。双掌心应抵住哑铃同一侧的下方。这是起始姿势。注意：始终确保本练习使用的哑铃牢固可靠。使用片片松动的哑铃可能导致哑铃散开并砸到脸部。
保持手臂锁定在弯曲姿势，吸气，将重量沿弧线缓慢下放至头后，直到胸部有拉伸感。
到达该位置后，沿下放时的弧线将哑铃带回起始位置，并在动作过程中呼气。
在起始位置稍作停顿一秒，然后按规定的次数重复动作。

document.name: Chain Press
instructions: Begin by connecting the chains to the cable handle attachments. Position yourself on the flat bench in the same position as for a dumbbell press. Your wrists should be pronated and arms perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Lower the chains by flexing the elbows, unloading some of the chain onto the floor.
Continue until your elbow forms a 90 degree angle, and then reverse the motion by extending through the elbow to lockout.
instructions_zh: 先把链条连接到绳索手柄上。仰卧在平板凳上，姿势与哑铃卧推相同。手腕旋前，手臂垂直于地面。这是起始姿势。
屈肘下放链条，让部分链条落到地面上卸载重量。
继续下放直至肘关节约呈90度，然后反向通过伸展肘关节推至锁定位置。

document.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and slowly lay down on the bench.

Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The arms should be perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position. Tip: In order to protect your rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you lift the barbell off the rack.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your lower chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 将双腿固定在下斜长凳末端，然后缓慢躺到长凳上。
采用中等宽度握距（即在动作中段使前臂与上臂呈90度角的握距），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定并将杠铃笔直举在身体上方。手臂应与地面垂直。这是起始位置。提示：为保护肩袖，最好让保护者协助你将杠铃从架上取下。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触及下胸部。
停顿1秒后，呼气并用胸肌将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂并挤压胸部，保持1秒，然后再次开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。
完成后，将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
Once you are laying down, move the dumbbells in front of you at shoulder width.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
Bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe out. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times. Tip: Throughout the motion, the forearms should always be perpendicular to the floor.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up..
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
instructions_zh: 将双腿固定在下降凳末端，躺下，双手各持一个哑铃置于大腿上方，掌心相对。
躺下后，将哑铃移到身前，与肩同宽。
到达肩宽后，将手腕向前旋转，使掌心朝外。这将是你的起始位置。
呼气的同时，将哑铃缓慢下放至身体两侧。始终完全控制哑铃。提示：整个动作过程中，前臂应始终垂直于地面。
呼气的同时，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置锁定手臂，挤压胸部，保持1秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间应至少是上推时间的两倍。
按照训练计划规定的次数重复该动作。

document.name: Decline Smith Press
instructions: Place a decline bench underneath the Smith machine. Now place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Using a pronated grip that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms extended. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, lower the bar under control by allowing the elbows to flex, lightly contacting the torso.
After a brief pause, bring the bar back to the starting position by extending the elbows, exhaling as you do so.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When the set is complete, lock the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 将下斜长凳放在史密斯机下方。将杠铃调到躺下时手臂几乎完全伸直能够到的位置。采用宽于肩的正握，从架上解锁杠铃，双臂伸直将杠铃稳定举于身体上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，控制下放杠铃，让肘部弯曲，轻触躯干。
稍作停顿后，伸直肘部将杠铃回到起始位置，同时呼气。
按建议次数重复动作。
组数完成后，将杠铃锁回架上。

document.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. The dumbbells should be just to the sides of your chest, with your upper arm and forearm creating a 90 degree angle. Be sure to maintain full control of the dumbbells at all times. This will be your starting position.

Then, as you breathe out, use your chest to push the dumbbells up. Lock your arms at the top of the lift and squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then begin coming down slowly. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，哑铃放在大腿上方。掌心相对。
然后借助大腿将哑铃逐只抬起，使你能在身前以肩宽握持哑铃。
到达肩宽后，向前旋转手腕，使掌心朝向远离你的方向。哑铃应位于胸部两侧，上臂与前臂约呈90度角。始终确保完全控制哑铃。此为起始姿势。
然后呼气，用胸部发力将哑铃向上推起。在动作顶端锁臂并挤压胸部，停顿一秒后开始缓慢下放。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所用时间约为上推时间的两倍。
按训练计划规定的重复次数重复该动作。

document.name: Dumbbell Bench Press with Neutral Grip
instructions: Take a dumbbell in each hand and lay back onto a flat bench. Your feet should be flat on the floor and your shoulder blades retracted.
Maintaining a neutral grip, palms facing each other, begin with your arms extended directly above you, perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the elbow, lowering the upper arms to the side. Descend until the dumbbells are to your torso.
Pause, then extend the elbow and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，仰卧在平凳上。双脚平放于地面，肩胛骨后缩。
保持中立握法（掌心相对），双臂伸直位于身体正上方，与地面垂直。此为起始姿势。
开始动作时屈肘，将上臂向身体两侧下放。下降至哑铃到达躯干两侧。
稍作停顿，然后伸肘回到起始位置。

document.name: Dumbbell Incline Row
instructions: Using a neutral grip, lean into an incline bench.
Take a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, beginning with the arms straight. This will be your starting position.
Retract the shoulder blades and flex the elbows to row the dumbbells to your side.
Pause at the top of the motion, and then return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 采用中立握法，身体前倾靠在上斜凳上。
双手各持一只哑铃，采用中立握法，开始时手臂伸直。此为起始姿势。
肩胛骨后缩，屈肘将哑铃划向身体两侧。
在动作顶端稍作停顿，然后回到起始位置。

document.name: Dumbbell Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Sit on an Incline Bench while holding a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs.

Lift your legs up to kick the weights to your shoulders and lean back. Position the dumbbells above your shoulders with your arms extended. The arms should be perpendicular to the floor with your palms facing forward and knuckles pointing towards the ceiling. This will be your starting position.
While keeping the arms straight and locked, lift the dumbbells by raising the shoulders from the bench as you breathe out.
Bring back the dumbbells to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上。
抬腿将哑铃踢到肩部并向后靠。将哑铃置于肩部上方，手臂伸直。手臂应垂直于地面，掌心朝前，指关节朝向天花板。这是起始姿势。
保持手臂伸直锁定，呼气时通过将肩部抬离凳面来举起哑铃。
吸气时让哑铃回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls
instructions: Hold the dumbbell towards the side farther from you so that you have more weight on the side closest to you. (This can be done for a good effect on all bicep dumbbell exercises). Now do a normal incline dumbbell curl, but keep your wrists as far back as possible so as to neutralize any stress that is placed on them.
Sit on an incline bench that is angled at 45-degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand.

Let your arms hang down on your sides, with the elbows in, and turn the palms of your hands forward with the thumbs pointing away from the body. Tip: You will keep this hand position throughout the movement as there should not be any twisting of the hands as they come up. This will be your starting position.

Curl up the two dumbbells at the same time until your biceps are fully contracted and exhale. Tip: Do not swing the arms or use momentum. Keep a controlled motion at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second at the top.
As you inhale, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 握住哑铃时让重量偏向远离你的一侧，使你靠近身体的一侧承受更多重量。（在所有哑铃肱二头肌练习中这样做都能取得良好效果）。现在做常规上斜哑铃弯举，但尽量让手腕向后，以中和施加在手腕上的压力。
坐在倾角为45度的上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃。
双臂垂于身体两侧，肘部内收，掌心向前，拇指朝向身体外侧。提示：整个动作过程中保持这个手部位置，手臂上举时不应有任何手腕扭转。这将是你的起始姿势。
同时向上弯举两只哑铃，直到肱二头肌完全收缩并呼气。提示：不要摆臂或借助惯性。始终保持受控动作。在顶端保持收缩位置一秒。
吸气时缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Front Incline Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Sit down on an incline bench with the incline set anywhere between 30 to 60 degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand. Tip: You can change the angle to hit the muscle a little differently each time.
Extend your arms straight in front of you and have your palms facing down with the dumbbells raised about 1 inch above your thighs. This will be your starting position.

Slowly raise the dumbbells straight up until they are slightly above your shoulders, while keeping your elbows locked. Squeeze at the top for a second and make sure you breathe out during this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep your head resting down against the bench and your legs on the floor at all times.
Lower the arms back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在上斜凳上，斜度设为30至60度之间，双手各持一只哑铃。提示：你可以改变角度，让肌肉每次受到略微不同的刺激。
双臂向前伸直，掌心朝下，哑铃抬至大腿上方约1英寸（2.5厘米）处。这是起始姿势。
保持肘部锁定，缓慢将哑铃竖直上举，直到略高于肩部。在顶部挤压1秒，并确保此阶段呼气。提示：始终让头部向后靠在凳上，双脚踩在地面。
吸气，将手臂放回起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. This will be your starting position.
Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back in your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to dispose of the dumbbells.
document.name_zh: 锤式握法上斜哑铃卧推
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜凳上，双手各持哑铃置于大腿上方。掌心相对。
借助大腿将哑铃向上送，一次一只手臂将哑铃翻起，以便以肩宽握住。
到达肩宽后，保持双手中立握（掌心相对）。肘部向外展开，上臂与肩部成一直线（垂直于躯干），肘部弯曲使上臂与前臂成90度。这是起始姿势。
吸气，同时缓慢将重量下放至身体两侧。始终完全控制哑铃。
呼气，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置锁定手臂，停留一秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复动作。
完成后，将哑铃放回大腿上，再放到地面。这是放下哑铃最安全的方式。

document.name: Incline Bench Pull
instructions: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and lie face down on an incline bench that is set to an incline that is approximately 30 degrees.
Let the arms hang to your sides fully extended as they point to the floor.
Turn the wrists until your hands have a pronated (palms down) grip.
Now flare the elbows out. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, start to pull the dumbbells up as if you are doing a reverse bench press. You will do this by bending at the elbows and bringing the upper arms up as you let the forearms hang. Continue this motion until the upper arms are at the same level as your back. Tip: The elbows will come out to the side and your upper arms and torso should make the letter "T" at the top of the movement. Hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各握一只哑铃，俯卧在上斜凳上，凳面角度约为30度。
让双臂自然垂于身体两侧并完全伸直，指向地面。
转动手腕，使双手呈旋前握法（掌心向下）。
现在将肘部向外展开。这是起始姿势。
呼气，开始像做反向卧推一样将哑铃向上拉起。通过屈肘并抬起上臂、让前臂自然下垂来完成。继续该动作，直到上臂与背部处于同一水平。提示：肘部会向两侧打开，动作顶端上臂与躯干应呈字母“T”形。在顶端保持收缩一秒。
吸气，缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Incline Cable Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the weight to an appropriate amount and be seated, grasping the handles. Your upper arms should be about 45 degrees to the body, with your head and chest up. The elbows should be bent to about 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Begin by extending through the elbow, pressing the handles together straight in front of you. Keep your shoulder blades retracted as you execute the movement.
After pausing at full extension, return to the starting position, keeping tension on the cables.
instructions_zh: 将重量调整到合适数值并坐下，握住把手。上臂应与身体约呈45度，头部和胸部抬起。肘部应弯曲约90度。这是起始姿势。
开始伸肘，将把手在正前方并拢推出。执行动作时保持肩胛骨后缩。
在完全伸展处稍作停顿后，回到起始姿势，保持绳索张力。

document.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. This will be your starting position.
Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back in your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to dispose of the dumbbells.
document.name_zh: 上斜哑铃卧推（掌心相对）
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上。掌心相对。
借助大腿将哑铃抬起，一次一只手臂将哑铃翻举到肩宽位置。
到达肩宽后，双手保持中立握法（掌心相对）。肘部向外展开，上臂与肩同一直线（垂直于躯干），肘部弯曲使上臂与前臂呈90度。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢将哑铃下放至身体两侧。始终完全控制哑铃。
呼气，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置锁定手臂，保持一秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复动作。
完成后，将哑铃放回大腿上，再放到地面。这是放下哑铃最安全的方式。

document.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Hold a dumbbell on each hand and lie on an incline bench that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees.
Extend your arms above you with a slight bend at the elbows.
Now rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing you. Tip: The pinky fingers should be next to each other. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe in, start to slowly lower the arms to the side while keeping the arms extended and while rotating the wrists until the palms of the hand are facing each other. Tip: At the end of the movement the arms will be by your side with the palms facing the ceiling.

As you exhale start to bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position by reversing the motion and rotating the hands so that the pinky fingers are next to each other again. Tip: Keep in mind that the movement will only happen at the shoulder joint and at the wrist. There is no motion that happens at the elbow joint.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，仰卧在倾斜角度不超过30度的上斜凳上。
将手臂向上伸直，肘部微屈。
转动手腕，使掌心朝向自己。提示：小指应相互靠近。这是起始姿势。
吸气，开始慢慢将手臂向两侧下放，同时保持手臂伸直并转动手腕，直到掌心相对。提示：动作结束时手臂位于身体两侧，掌心朝向天花板。
呼气，开始按相反方向将哑铃带回起始位置，并转动手掌使小指再次相互靠近。提示：记住动作只发生在肩关节和腕关节，肘关节不产生运动。
重复推荐次数。

document.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes - With A Twist
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lie on an incline bench that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees.
Extend your arms above you with a slight bend at the elbows.
Now rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing you. Tip: The pinky fingers should be next to each other. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe in, start to slowly lower the arms to the side while keeping the arms extended and while rotating the wrists until the palms of the hand are facing each other. Tip: At the end of the movement the arms will be by your side with the palms facing the ceiling.

As you exhale start to bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position by reversing the motion and rotating the hands so that the pinky fingers are next to each other again. Tip: Keep in mind that the movement will only happen at the shoulder joint and at the wrist. There is no motion that happens at the elbow joint.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，仰卧在倾斜角度不超过30度的上斜凳上。
将手臂向上伸直，肘部微屈。
转动手腕，使掌心朝向自己。提示：小指应相互靠近。这是起始姿势。
吸气，开始慢慢将手臂向两侧下放，同时保持手臂伸直并转动手腕，直到掌心相对。提示：动作结束时手臂位于身体两侧，掌心朝向天花板。
呼气，开始按相反方向将哑铃带回起始位置，并转动手掌使小指再次相互靠近。提示：记住动作只发生在肩关节和腕关节，肘关节不产生运动。
重复推荐次数。

document.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand atop your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help push the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.
Once you have the dumbbells raised to shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
Be sure to keep full control of the dumbbells at all times. Then breathe out and push the dumbbells up with your chest.
Lock your arms at the top, hold for a second, and then start slowly lowering the weight. Tip Ideally, lowering the weights should take about twice as long as raising them.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back on your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to release the dumbbells.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上，掌心相对。
然后借助大腿将哑铃向上推起，一次举起一只，使你能以与肩同宽的距离握住哑铃。
将哑铃举到与肩同宽后，向前转动手腕，使掌心朝向远离自己的方向。这是起始姿势。
始终确保完全控制哑铃。然后呼气，用胸部力量将哑铃向上推起。
在顶部伸直手臂并锁定，停顿1秒，然后开始缓慢下放重量。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所用时间应约为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复动作。
完成后，将哑铃放回大腿上，再放到地面。这是放下哑铃最安全的方式。

document.name: Incline Inner Biceps Curl
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lie back on an incline bench.
The dumbbells should be at arm's length hanging at your sides and your palms should be facing out. This will be your starting position.

Now as you exhale curl the weight outward and up while keeping your forearms in line with your side deltoids. Continue the curl until the dumbbells are at shoulder height and to the sides of your deltoids. Tip: The end of the movement should look similar to a double biceps pose.
After a second contraction at the top of the movement, start to inhale and slowly lower the weights back to the starting position using the same path used to bring them up.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
document.name_zh: 上斜内侧肱二头肌弯举
aliases_zh: 上斜内收肱二头肌弯举
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，仰卧在上斜凳上。
哑铃应位于身体两侧、手臂伸直下垂，掌心朝外。这是起始姿势。
呼气，同时将重量向外、向上弯举，并保持前臂与侧三角肌对齐。继续弯举，直到哑铃到达肩部高度并位于三角肌两侧。提示：动作顶端应看起来像双肱二头肌展示姿势。
在动作顶端收缩1秒后，开始吸气，并沿举起时的相同轨迹慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复推荐次数。

document.name: One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie down sideways on an incline bench press with a dumbbell in the hand. Make sure the shoulder is pressing against the incline bench and the arm is lying across your body with the palm around your navel.
Hold a dumbbell in your uppermost arm while keeping it extended in front of you parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.

While keeping the dumbbell parallel to the floor at all times, perform a lateral raise. Your arm should travel straight up until it is pointing at the ceiling. Tip: Exhale as you perform this movement. Hold the dumbbell in the position and feel the contraction in the shoulders for a second.
While inhaling lower the weight across your body back into the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
instructions_zh: 侧卧在上斜卧推凳上，一只手握哑铃。确保肩部贴紧上斜凳，手臂横放在身体前方，手掌位于肚脐附近。
用位于上方的手臂握住哑铃，并保持手臂向前伸直、与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
始终保持哑铃与地面平行，做侧平举。手臂应笔直向上移动，直到指向天花板。提示：执行此动作时呼气。在最高位置保持哑铃并感受肩部收缩一秒。
吸气的同时，将重量沿身体前方下放回起始位置。
按指定次数重复该动作。
换手臂重复该动作。

document.name: One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand on top of your thigh.

By using your thigh to help you get the dumbbell up, clean the dumbbell up so that you can hold it in front of you at shoulder width. Use the hand you are not lifting with to help position the dumbbell over you properly.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrist forward so that the palm of your hand is facing away from you. This will be your starting position.

Bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbell at all times. Tip: Use the hand that you are not lifting with to help keep the dumbbell balance as you may struggle a bit at first. Only use your non-lifting hand if it is needed. Otherwise, keep it resting to the side.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，一只手持哑铃置于大腿上方。
借助大腿将哑铃向上送到肩宽位置，使其能在身前握住。用未持铃的手帮助将哑铃摆放到身体正上方。
到达肩宽后，向前转腕，使掌心背向自己。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢将哑铃下放至身体一侧。始终完全控制哑铃。提示：初练时可能有些不稳，可用未持铃的手辅助保持哑铃平衡；仅在需要时使用，否则放在体侧休息。
呼气，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置伸直手臂，挤压胸部，停留一秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间应至少是上推时间的两倍。
按训练计划规定次数重复动作。
换手臂重复。

document.name: Smith Machine Decline Press
instructions: Position a decline bench in the rack so that the bar will be above your chest. Load an appropriate weight and take your place on the bench.
Rotate the bar to unhook it from the rack and fully extend your arms. Your back should be slightly arched and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing your arms, lowering the bar to your chest.
Pause briefly, and then extend your arms to push the weight back to the starting position.
After completing the desired number of repetitions, rotate the bar to rack the weight.
instructions_zh: 将下斜凳放入架内，使杠铃杆位于胸部上方。加载合适重量并躺到下斜凳上。
旋转杠铃杆将其从架上解锁并完全伸直双臂。背部应略微反拱，肩胛骨后收。这是起始姿势。
屈臂开始动作，将杠铃杆下放到胸部。
短暂停顿，然后伸直双臂将重量推回起始位置。
完成目标次数后，旋转杠铃杆将重量放回架上。

document.name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
instructions: Place an incline bench underneath the smith machine. Place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the incline bench and make sure your upper chest is aligned with the barbell. Using a pronated grip (palms facing forward) that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 将上斜凳放在史密斯机下方。将杠铃调到躺下后手臂几乎完全伸直时能够到的位置。选择好所需重量后，躺在上斜凳上，确保上胸部与杠铃对齐。采用正握（掌心向前）、宽于肩的握距，从架上解锁杠铃，双臂伸直将杠铃保持在身体正上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气时缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触碰到上胸部。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用胸肌将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置伸直手臂，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按规定的次数重复动作。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

Ensuring that the dumbbell stays securely placed at the top of the bench, lie perpendicular to the bench (torso across it as in forming a cross) with only your shoulders lying on the surface. Hips should be below the bench and legs bent with feet firmly on the floor. The head will be off the bench as well.

Grasp the dumbbell with both hands and hold it straight over your chest at arms length. Both palms should be pressing against the underside one of the sides of the dumbbell. This will be your starting position.
Caution: Always ensure that the dumbbell used for this exercise is secure. Using a dumbbell with loose plates can result in the dumbbell falling apart and falling on your face.
While keeping your arms straight, lower the weight slowly in an arc behind your head while breathing in until you feel a stretch on the chest.
At that point, bring the dumbbell back to the starting position using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhale as you perform this movement.
Hold the weight on the initial position for a second and repeat the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将一只哑铃竖直放在平凳上。
确保哑铃稳固地放在平凳一端，身体与平凳垂直仰卧（躯干横跨凳面，呈十字形），只有肩部落在凳面上。髋部应低于凳面，双腿屈膝，双脚牢牢踩地。头部也悬在凳外。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直将哑铃举于胸部正上方。两手掌应抵住哑铃同一侧的下方。这是起始姿势。注意：务必确保本练习使用的哑铃牢固可靠。使用杠铃片松动的哑铃可能导致哑铃散落并砸到脸部。
保持双臂伸直，吸气，将重量沿弧线缓慢下放至头后，直到胸部有拉伸感。
此时，沿下放时的弧线将哑铃回到起始位置，并在动作过程中呼气。
在起始位置保持重量一秒钟，然后按规定的次数重复动作。

document.name: Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench with the feet securely locked at the front of the bench. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away from shoulder width (for each hand), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your lower chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在下斜凳上，双脚牢牢固定在下斜凳前端。采用宽握正握（掌心朝前），每只手比肩宽向外约3英寸（约7.6厘米），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定将杠铃保持在身体正上方。杠铃应垂直于躯干和地面。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触到胸部下侧。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用胸肌将杠铃推回起始姿势。在收缩位置锁定双臂并挤压胸部，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应是上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
instructions: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell in each hand and with an incline bench in front of you.

While keeping your back straight and maintaining the natural arch of your back, lean forward until your forehead touches the bench in front of you. Let the arms hang in front of you perpendicular to the ground. The palms of your hands should be facing each other and your torso should be parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position.

Keeping your torso forward and stationary, and the arms straight with a slight bend at the elbows, lift the dumbbells straight to the side until both arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you lift the weights. Caution: avoid swinging the torso or bringing the arms back as opposed to the side.
After a one second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat the recommended amount of repetitions.
document.name_zh: 俯身哑铃后束飞鸟（头靠凳）
aliases_zh: 头靠凳俯身哑铃后束飞鸟
俯身哑铃后三角肌飞鸟
instructions_zh: 站直，双手各持一只哑铃，面前放一张上斜凳。
保持背部挺直并维持背部自然弧度，身体前倾，直到额头触碰面前的凳子。双臂自然下垂于身体前方，与地面垂直。双掌相对，躯干与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
保持躯干前倾且不动，手臂伸直、肘部微屈，将哑铃向两侧抬起，直到双臂与地面平行。抬起重量时呼气。注意：避免躯干摆动，或将手臂向后拉而不是向侧抬。
在顶端收缩一秒后，缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Bodyweight Flyes
instructions: Position two equally loaded EZ bars on the ground next to each other. Ensure they are able to roll.
Assume a push-up position over the bars, supporting your weight on your toes and hands with your arms extended and body straight.
Place your hands on the bars. This will be your starting position.
Using a slow and controlled motion, move your hands away from the midline of your body, rolling the bars apart. Inhale during this portion of the motion.
After moving the bars as far apart as you can, return to the starting position by pulling them back together. Exhale as you perform this movement.
instructions_zh: 将两根负重相同的EZ杆并排放在地上，确保它们能够滚动。
在杆上方呈俯卧撑姿势，用脚趾和双手支撑体重，双臂伸直，身体保持挺直。
将双手放在杆上，这将是你的起始姿势。
以缓慢可控的动作将双手向身体中线两侧分开，使杆向外滚动。此阶段吸气。
将杆分开到最大幅度后，再将其拉回并拢，回到起始姿势。此动作过程中呼气。

document.name: Butterfly
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back flat on the pad.
Take hold of the handles. Tip: Your upper arms should be positioned parallel to the floor; adjust the machine accordingly. This will be your starting position.
