换另一侧手臂重复该动作。

document.name: Rack Pulls
instructions: Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins. The pins should be set to the desired point; just below the knees, just above, or in the mid thigh position. Position yourself against the bar in proper deadlifting position. Your feet should be under your hips, your grip shoulder width, back arched, and hips back to engage the hamstrings. Since the weight is typically heavy, you may use a mixed grip, a hook grip, or use straps to aid in holding the weight.
With your head looking forward, extend through the hips and knees, pulling the weight up and back until lockout. Be sure to pull your shoulders back as you complete the movement.
Return the weight to the pins and repeat.
instructions_zh: 在力量架中设置好，将杠铃放在销钉上。销钉应设到所需高度：膝盖下方、膝盖上方或大腿中部位置。以正确的硬拉姿势面对杠铃站好。双脚应位于髋部下方，握距与肩同宽，背部拱起，髋部后移以激活腘绳肌。由于重量通常较大，你可以使用正反握、锁握或使用助力带来帮助握持重量。
头部向前看，通过伸展髋部和膝盖，将重量向上并向后拉，直到锁定。完成动作时确保将肩部向后收。
将重量放回销钉上并重复。

document.name: Reverse Band Deadlift
instructions: Set the bar up in a power rack. Attach bands to the top of the rack, using either bands pegs or the frame itself. Attach the other end of the bands to the bar.

Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets.

With your feet, and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and bend the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward.
After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
instructions_zh: 在深蹲架内设置杠铃。用带钉或架体本身将弹力带固定在架顶。将弹力带另一端连接到杠铃。
靠近杠铃，使其位于双脚正上方。双脚约与髋同宽。屈髋以肩宽握杠，让肩胛骨前伸。较重组通常使用正握或正反握。
双脚和握法就位后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝，直到小腿接触杠铃。头部朝前，挺胸并拱背，开始通过脚跟发力将重量向上移动。
杠铃过膝后，积极将杠铃向后拉，同时肩胛骨夹紧，髋部向前顶向杠铃。
屈髋下放杠铃，并引导其回到地面。

document.name: Reverse Band Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Begin with a bar loaded on the floor inside of a power rack. Attach bands to the top of the rack, using either pegs or the frame itself. Attach the other end to the barbell.

Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens your arms.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
instructions_zh: 先将杠铃加载在深蹲架内的地面上。用带钉或架体本身将弹力带固定在架顶。将另一端连接到杠铃。
靠近杠铃，使杠铃与双脚中部相交。双脚应站得很宽，接近杠铃套环。屈髋握杠。手臂应位于肩部正下方、双腿内侧，可采用正握、正反握或锁握。放松肩部，这样实际上会拉长手臂。
吸气，然后降低髋部，头部朝前、挺胸。通过脚掌蹬地，双脚向外撑开，重心放在脚的后半部。伸展髋部和膝盖。
当杠铃经过膝盖时，身体后仰，髋部向前顶向杠铃，同时夹紧肩胛骨。
屈髋将重量放回地面，并在下放过程中控制重量。

document.name: Rickshaw Deadlift
instructions: Load the frame with the desired weight. Center yourself between the handles. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hips to grip the handles, allowing your shoulder blades to protract.

With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and flex the knees. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. As the weight comes up, pull your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward.
Lower the weight by bending at the hips and guiding it to the ground.
instructions_zh: 在框架上装入目标重量。站在两个把手之间居中，双脚约与髋同宽。屈髋握住把手，让肩胛骨前伸。
双脚和握法固定后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝。头部向前看，保持挺胸、背部反弓，并开始通过脚跟发力将重量向上移动。重量上升时，将肩胛骨向后收拢，同时髋部向前顶。
屈髋下放重量，并引导其回到地面。

document.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Put a barbell in front of you on the ground and grab it using a pronated (palms facing down) grip that a little wider than shoulder width. Tip: Depending on the weight used, you may need wrist wraps to perform the exercise and also a raised platform in order to allow for better range of motion.
Bend the knees slightly and keep the shins vertical, hips back and back straight. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your back and arms completely straight at all times, use your hips to lift the bar as you exhale. Tip: The movement should not be fast but steady and under control.

Once you are standing completely straight up, lower the bar by pushing the hips back, only slightly bending the knees, unlike when squatting. Tip: Take a deep breath at the start of the movement and keep your chest up. Hold your breath as you lower and exhale as you complete the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放在身前地面上，采用掌心朝下（正握）、略宽于肩的握距握住杠铃。提示：根据所用重量，可能需要使用护腕，并站在抬高的平台上以获得更好的活动范围。
膝盖微屈，小腿保持垂直，髋部向后推，背部挺直。此为起始姿势。
全程保持背部和手臂完全伸直，呼气时用髋部发力将杠铃拉起。提示：动作不要过快，应平稳且受控。
完全站直后，通过髋部后推下放杠铃，膝盖只轻微弯曲，与深蹲不同。提示：动作开始时深吸气并保持挺胸；下放时屏住呼吸，完成动作时呼气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Romanian Deadlift from Deficit
instructions: Begin standing while holding a bar at arm's length in front of you. You can stand on a raised platform to increase the range of motion.

Begin by flexing the knees slightly, and then flex at the hip, moving your butt back as far as possible, lowering the torso as far as flexibility allows. The back should remain in absolute extension at all times, and the bar should remain in contact with the legs. If done properly, there should be heavy tension felt in the hamstrings.
Reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始站立，双臂伸直在身前握住杠铃。可以站在抬高的平台上以增加活动范围。
先微屈膝盖，然后屈髋，将臀部尽可能向后推，在柔韧性允许范围内尽量下放躯干。背部应始终完全挺直伸展，杠铃应保持贴腿。若动作正确，腘绳肌会有强烈牵拉感。
反向完成动作，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Snatch Deadlift
instructions: The snatch deadlift strengthens the first pull of the snatch. Begin with a wide snatch grip with the barbell placed on the platform. The feet should be directly under the hips, with the feet turned out. Squat down to the bar, keeping the back in absolute extension with the head facing forward.
Initiate the movement by driving through the heels, raising the hips. The back angle should remain the same until the bar passes the knees.
At that point, drive your hips through the bar as you lay back. Return the bar to the platform by reversing the motion.
instructions_zh: 抓举硬拉可强化抓举的第一次拉拽。开始时采用宽握抓举握距，杠铃放在举重台上。双脚应位于髋部正下方，脚尖外展。下蹲至杠铃处，保持背部完全挺直，头部朝前。
通过脚跟发力、抬高髋部来启动动作。在杠铃超过膝盖之前，背部角度应保持不变。
到达该位置后，向前送髋并使身体略微后仰。然后按相反动作将杠铃放回举重台。

document.name: Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down). You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the hips while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips until you are back at the starting position. Exhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 使用正握（掌心向下）握住杠铃。如果使用较大重量，可能需要护腕。
躯干挺直站立，双腿采用与肩同宽或更窄的站距。膝盖应微屈。这是起始姿势。
保持膝盖不动，通过屈髋将杠铃下放至双脚上方，同时保持背部挺直。像要从地上捡东西一样继续前倾，直到感觉腘绳肌被拉伸。此动作过程中吸气。
通过伸展髋部开始将躯干重新抬起，直到回到起始姿势。此动作过程中呼气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Grasp a couple of dumbbells holding them by your side at arm's length.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the dumbbells to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各握一只哑铃，手臂伸直垂于身体两侧。
躯干挺直站立，双腿采用与肩同宽或更窄的站距。膝盖应微屈。这是起始姿势。
保持膝盖不动，通过屈髋将哑铃下放至双脚上方，同时保持背部挺直。像要从地上捡东西一样继续前倾，直到感觉腘绳肌被拉伸。此动作过程中呼气。
通过伸展髋部和腰部开始将躯干重新抬起，直到回到起始姿势。此动作过程中吸气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens your arms.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
instructions_zh: 从地面装有杠铃开始。走近杠铃，使杠铃与双脚中点相交。双脚应站得很宽，接近杠铃片卡箍。屈髋握住杠铃。手臂应位于肩部正下方、双腿内侧，可采用正握、正反握或锁握。放松肩部，这样能有效拉长手臂。
吸气，然后降低髋部，抬头向前看，胸部挺起。蹬地发力，双脚向外撑开，重心放在脚后跟至脚掌后半部。通过伸髋伸膝站起。
当杠铃经过膝盖时，身体后倾，髋部向前顶向杠铃，同时肩胛骨收紧。
屈髋控制重量下放，将杠铃放回地面。

document.name: Sumo Deadlift with Bands
instructions: To deadlift with short bands, simply loop them over the bar before you start, and step into them to set up. Ensure that they under the back half of your foot, directly where you are driving into the floor.

Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
instructions_zh: 要使用短弹力带做硬拉，开始前只需将弹力带绕过杠铃，然后踩进去做好姿势。确保弹力带位于脚后半部下方，也就是你蹬地发力的正下方。
从地面装有杠铃开始。走近杠铃，使杠铃与双脚中点相交。双脚应站得很宽，接近杠铃片卡箍。屈髋握住杠铃。手臂应位于肩部正下方、双腿内侧，可采用正握、正反握或锁握。
吸气，然后降低髋部，抬头向前看，胸部挺起。蹬地发力，双脚向外撑开，重心放在脚后跟至脚掌后半部。通过伸髋伸膝站起。
当杠铃经过膝盖时，身体后倾，髋部向前顶向杠铃，同时肩胛骨收紧。
屈髋控制重量下放，将杠铃放回地面。

document.name: Sumo Deadlift with Chains
instructions: You can attach the chains to the sleeves of the bar, or just drape the middle over the bar so there is a greater weight increase as you lift. Attempt to keep the ends of the chains away from the plates so you don't hit them when you lower the weight.

Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens your arms.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
instructions_zh: 可将铁链挂在杠铃套筒上，或直接将链子中部搭在杠铃上，这样提起时重量会增加。尽量让链条两端远离杠铃片，以免下放重量时撞到杠铃片。
从地面装有杠铃开始。走近杠铃，使杠铃与双脚中点相交。双脚应站得很宽，接近杠铃片卡箍。屈髋握住杠铃。手臂应位于肩部正下方、双腿内侧，可采用正握、正反握或锁握。放松肩部，这样能有效拉长手臂。
吸气，然后降低髋部，抬头向前看，胸部挺起。蹬地发力，双脚向外撑开，重心放在脚后跟至脚掌后半部。通过伸髋伸膝站起。
当杠铃经过膝盖时，身体后倾，髋部向前顶向杠铃，同时肩胛骨收紧。
屈髋控制重量下放，将杠铃放回地面。

document.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: For this exercise load a trap bar, also known as a hex bar, to an appropriate weight resting on the ground. Stand in the center of the apparatus and grasp both handles.
Lower your hips, look forward with your head and keep your chest up.
Begin the movement by driving through the heels and extend your hips and knees. Avoid rounding your back at all times.
At the completion of the movement, lower the weight back to the ground under control.
instructions_zh: 进行此动作时，将六角杠（又称陷阱杠）装上合适重量并置于地面。站在器械中央，双手握住两侧把手。
下蹲降低髋部，目视前方，保持挺胸。
通过脚跟发力开始动作，伸展髋部和膝盖。始终避免弓背。
动作完成时，控制重量将其放回地面。

document.name: Axle Deadlift
instructions: Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract. Typically, you would use an over/under grip.

With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and flex the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward.
After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
instructions_zh: 走近杠铃，使杠铃位于双脚正上方。双脚约与髋同宽。屈髋，以与肩同宽的握距握杠，让肩胛骨前伸。通常采用正反握。
双脚和握法就位后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝，直到小腿接触杠铃。目视前方，挺胸弓背，开始用脚跟发力将重量向上拉起。
杠铃过膝后，积极将杠铃向后拉，同时肩胛骨收紧，髋部向前顶向杠铃。
屈髋将杠铃控制下放至地面。

document.name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand in front of a loaded barbell.

While keeping the back as straight as possible, bend your knees, bend forward and grasp the bar using a medium (shoulder width) overhand grip. This will be the starting position of the exercise. Tip: If it is difficult to hold on to the bar with this grip, alternate your grip or use wrist straps.

While holding the bar, start the lift by pushing with your legs while simultaneously getting your torso to the upright position as you breathe out. In the upright position, stick your chest out and contract the back by bringing the shoulder blades back. Think of how the soldiers in the military look when they are in standing in attention.

Go back to the starting position by bending at the knees while simultaneously leaning the torso forward at the waist while keeping the back straight. When the weights on the bar touch the floor you are back at the starting position and ready to perform another repetition.
Perform the amount of repetitions prescribed in the program.
instructions_zh: 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前。
尽量保持背部挺直，屈膝、俯身，用与肩同宽的中等宽度正握握住杠铃。这是动作的起始姿势。提示：如果该握法难以握住杠铃，可改用正反握或使用助力带。
握住杠铃，呼气的同时用腿发力开始上拉，并同时将躯干抬至直立。在直立位挺胸，肩胛骨后收以收紧背部。想象军人立正时的姿态。
屈膝回到起始位置，同时以髋部为轴向前俯身，并保持背部挺直。当杠铃片触地时，即回到起始位置，准备下一次重复。
按计划规定的次数完成。

document.name: Cable Deadlifts
instructions: Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight. Stand directly in between the uprights.
To begin, squat down be flexing your hips and knees until you can reach the handles.
After grasping them, begin your ascent. Driving through your heels extend your hips and knees keeping your hands hanging at your side. Keep your head and chest up throughout the movement.
After reaching a full standing position, Return to the starting position and repeat.
instructions_zh: 将绳索调至器械架底部，选择合适重量。站在两侧立柱正中间。
开始时，屈髋屈膝下蹲，直到能够握住把手。
握住把手后，开始起身。脚跟发力，伸展髋部和膝部，双手自然垂于体侧。整个动作过程中保持头部和胸部抬起。
达到完全站立姿势后，回到起始姿势并重复。

document.name: Car Deadlift
instructions: This event apparatus typically has neutral grip handles, however some have a straight bar that you can approach like a normal deadlift. The apparatus can be loaded with a vehicle or other heavy objects such as tractor tires or kegs.

Center yourself between the handles if you are a strong squatter, or back a couple inches if you are a strong deadlifter. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the handles. With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and flex the knees.

Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. As the weight comes up, pull your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward.
Lower the weight by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
instructions_zh: 这种比赛器械通常配有中立握把，不过有些装的是直杆，可以像普通硬拉一样握。器械上可以加载汽车或其他重物，例如拖拉机轮胎或啤酒桶。
如果你深蹲较强，就站在两个握把的正中间；如果你硬拉较强，就往后退几英寸。双脚约与髋同宽，屈髋握住握把。双脚站好、握法确定后，深吸一口气，然后下沉臀部、屈膝。
头部目视前方，保持挺胸、背部弓起，开始用脚跟发力将重量向上顶起。随着重量上升，在向前送髋的同时把肩胛骨向后收紧。
屈髋控制重量，将其缓慢放回地面。

document.name: Deadlift with Bands
instructions: To deadlift with short bands, simply loop them over the bar before you start, and step into them to set up. For long bands, they will need to be anchored to a secure base, such as heavy dumbbells or a rack.

With your feet, and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and bend the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
instructions_zh: 使用短弹力带做硬拉时，开始前只需将弹力带套在杠铃杆上，并踩进弹力带中做好准备姿势。对于长弹力带，需要将其固定在稳固的基座（如重哑铃或深蹲架）上。
双脚和握法就位后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝，直到小腿接触杠铃杆。头部目视前方，挺胸、背部拱起，开始通过脚跟发力将重量向上移动。杠铃杆过膝后，积极向后拉杆，肩胛骨收紧，同时髋部向前顶向杠铃杆。
通过屈髋降低杠铃杆，并引导其回到地面。

document.name: Deadlift with Chains
instructions: You can attach the chains to the sleeves of the bar, or just drape the middle over the bar so there is a greater weight increase as you lift.

Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets. With your feet, and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and bend the knees until your shins contact the bar.

Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
instructions_zh: 可将链条挂在杠铃杆套筒上，或直接将链条中部搭在杠铃杆上，这样随着举起，重量会增加得更多。
走近杠铃杆，使其位于双脚正上方。双脚约与髋同宽。屈髋以肩宽握杆，让肩胛骨前伸。通常使用正握，较重组可使用正反握。双脚和握法就位后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝，直到小腿接触杠铃杆。
头部目视前方，挺胸、背部拱起，开始通过脚跟发力将重量向上移动。杠铃杆过膝后，积极向后拉杆，肩胛骨收紧，同时髋部向前顶向杠铃杆。
通过屈髋降低杠铃杆，并引导其回到地面。

document.name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Begin by having a platform or weight plates that you can stand on, usually 1-3 inches in height. Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets.

With your feet, and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and bend the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
instructions_zh: 先准备一个可站立的平台或杠铃片，通常高度为1至3英寸。走近杠铃，使其位于双脚正中上方。双脚约与髋同宽。屈髋握住杠铃，握距与肩同宽，让肩胛骨前伸。较重组通常采用正握或正反握。
双脚和握法就位后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝，直到小腿接触杠铃。头部向前看，挺胸并保持背部反弓，开始通过脚跟发力将重量向上移动。杠铃过膝后，积极将杠铃向后拉，同时肩胛骨收紧，髋部向前顶向杠铃。
屈髋下放杠铃，并引导其回到地面。

document.name: Hyperextensions (Back Extensions)
instructions: Lie face down on a hyperextension bench, tucking your ankles securely under the footpads.
Adjust the upper pad if possible so your upper thighs lie flat across the wide pad, leaving enough room for you to bend at the waist without any restriction.

With your body straight, cross your arms in front of you (my preference) or behind your head. This will be your starting position. Tip: You can also hold a weight plate for extra resistance in front of you under your crossed arms.

Start bending forward slowly at the waist as far as you can while keeping your back flat. Inhale as you perform this movement. Keep moving forward until you feel a nice stretch on the hamstrings and you can no longer keep going without a rounding of the back. Tip: Never round the back as you perform this exercise. Also, some people can go farther than others. The key thing is that you go as far as your body allows you to without rounding the back.

Slowly raise your torso back to the initial position as you inhale. Tip: Avoid the temptation to arch your back past a straight line. Also, do not swing the torso at any time in order to protect the back from injury.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在罗马椅上，将脚踝牢牢卡在脚垫下方。
如有可能，调整上方垫子，使大腿上部平贴在宽垫上，并为腰部弯曲留出足够空间，不受限制。
身体保持挺直，双臂交叉放在胸前（我的偏好）或放在脑后。这是起始姿势。提示：也可在交叉的双臂下方胸前抱一片杠铃片，以增加阻力。
保持背部平直，从腰部开始缓慢向前弯屈到最大幅度；进行此动作时吸气。继续前屈，直到腘绳肌有明显拉伸感，且若再继续就必须弓背时停止。提示：做此动作时切勿弓背。另外，每个人可前屈的幅度不同，关键是做到身体允许且不弓背的最大幅度。
吸气的同时，缓慢将躯干抬回起始位置。提示：避免挺腰超过身体直线；任何时候都不要甩动躯干，以保护背部免受伤害。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension Bench
instructions: With someone holding down your legs, slide yourself down to the edge a flat bench until your hips hang off the end of the bench. Tip: Your entire upper body should be hanging down towards the floor. Also, you will be in the same position as if you were on a hyperextension bench but the range of motion will be shorter due to the height of the flat bench vs. that of the hyperextension bench.

With your body straight, cross your arms in front of you (my preference) or behind your head. This will be your starting position. Tip: You can also hold a weight plate for extra resistance in front of you under your crossed arms.

Start bending forward slowly at the waist as far as you can while keeping your back flat. Inhale as you perform this movement. Keep moving forward until you almost touch the floor or you feel a nice stretch on the hamstrings (whichever comes first). Tip: Never round the back as you perform this exercise.

Slowly raise your torso back to the initial position as you exhale. Tip: Avoid the temptation to arch your back past a straight line. Also, do not swing the torso at any time in order to protect the back from injury.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 让人按住你的双腿，将身体沿平板凳向前滑到边缘，直到髋部悬在凳子末端之外。提示：整个上半身应朝地面下垂。此时姿势与在罗马椅上相同，但由于平板凳高度较低，动作幅度会更短。
身体保持挺直，双臂交叉放在胸前（我的偏好）或放在脑后。这是起始姿势。提示：也可在交叉双臂下胸前抱杠铃片增加阻力。
保持背部平直，从腰部开始缓慢前屈到最大幅度，同时吸气。继续前屈，直到几乎触地或腘绳肌有明显拉伸感（以先出现者为准）。提示：做此动作时切勿弓背。
呼气的同时，缓慢将躯干抬回起始位置。提示：避免腰部反弓超过直线；任何时候都不要甩动躯干，以保护背部免受伤害。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Kettlebell One-Legged Deadlift
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the handle in one hand. Stand on one leg, on the same side that you hold the kettlebell.
Keeping that knee slightly bent, perform a stiff legged deadlift by bending at the hip, extending your free leg behind you for balance.
Continue lowering the kettlebell until you are parallel to the ground, and then return to the upright position.
aliases_zh: 壶铃单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions_zh: 单手握住壶铃把手，站在与持铃手同侧的腿上。
保持该膝微屈，以髋部为轴做直腿硬拉，同时将另一条腿向后伸以保持平衡。
继续下放壶铃，直至身体与地面平行，然后回到直立姿势。

document.name: Leverage Deadlift
instructions: Load the pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between the handles. Grasp the bottom handles with a comfortable grip, and then lower your hips as you take a breath. Look forward with your head and keep your chest up. This will be your starting position.
Return the weight to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 在配重销上加载适当重量。站在两个把手正中间。以舒适握法握住下方把手，然后吸气并降低髋部。头朝前看，保持胸部挺起。这是起始姿势。
将重量放回起始位置。

document.name: One-Arm Side Deadlift
instructions: Stand to the side of a barbell next to its center. Bend your knees and lower your body until you are able to reach the barbell.

Grasp the bar as if you were grabbing a briefcase (palms facing you since the bar is sideways). You may need a wrist wrap if you are using a significant amount of weight. This is your starting position.
Use your legs to help lift the barbell up while exhaling. Your arms should extend fully as bring the barbell up until you are in a standing position.
Slowly bring the barbell back down while inhaling. Tip: Make sure to bend your knees while lowering the weight to avoid any injury from occurring.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
instructions_zh: 站在杠铃一侧，靠近杠铃中心。屈膝下蹲，直到能够到杠铃。
像提公文包一样握住杠铃杆（由于杠铃杆是横向的，掌心朝向自己）。如果使用较大重量，可能需要使用腕带。这是起始姿势。
呼气的同时用腿部帮助将杠铃提起。手臂应完全伸直，将杠铃提至站立姿势。
吸气的同时缓慢将杠铃放回。提示：下放重量时务必屈膝，以避免受伤。
按建议次数重复。
换另一侧手臂重复该动作。

document.name: Reverse Band Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Begin with a bar loaded on the floor inside of a power rack. Attach bands to the top of the rack, using either pegs or the frame itself. Attach the other end to the barbell.

Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens your arms.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
instructions_zh: 先将杠铃加载在深蹲架内的地面上。用带钉或架体本身将弹力带固定在架顶。将另一端连接到杠铃。
靠近杠铃，使杠铃与双脚中部相交。双脚应站得很宽，接近杠铃套环。屈髋握杠。手臂应位于肩部正下方、双腿内侧，可采用正握、正反握或锁握。放松肩部，这样实际上会拉长手臂。
吸气，然后降低髋部，头部朝前、挺胸。通过脚掌蹬地，双脚向外撑开，重心放在脚的后半部。伸展髋部和膝盖。
当杠铃经过膝盖时，身体后仰，髋部向前顶向杠铃，同时夹紧肩胛骨。
屈髋将重量放回地面，并在下放过程中控制重量。

document.name: Rickshaw Deadlift
instructions: Load the frame with the desired weight. Center yourself between the handles. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hips to grip the handles, allowing your shoulder blades to protract.

With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and flex the knees. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. As the weight comes up, pull your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward.
Lower the weight by bending at the hips and guiding it to the ground.
instructions_zh: 在框架上装入目标重量。站在两个把手之间居中，双脚约与髋同宽。屈髋握住把手，让肩胛骨前伸。
双脚和握法固定后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝。头部向前看，保持挺胸、背部反弓，并开始通过脚跟发力将重量向上移动。重量上升时，将肩胛骨向后收拢，同时髋部向前顶。
屈髋下放重量，并引导其回到地面。

document.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Put a barbell in front of you on the ground and grab it using a pronated (palms facing down) grip that a little wider than shoulder width. Tip: Depending on the weight used, you may need wrist wraps to perform the exercise and also a raised platform in order to allow for better range of motion.
Bend the knees slightly and keep the shins vertical, hips back and back straight. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your back and arms completely straight at all times, use your hips to lift the bar as you exhale. Tip: The movement should not be fast but steady and under control.

Once you are standing completely straight up, lower the bar by pushing the hips back, only slightly bending the knees, unlike when squatting. Tip: Take a deep breath at the start of the movement and keep your chest up. Hold your breath as you lower and exhale as you complete the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放在身前地面上，采用掌心朝下（正握）、略宽于肩的握距握住杠铃。提示：根据所用重量，可能需要使用护腕，并站在抬高的平台上以获得更好的活动范围。
膝盖微屈，小腿保持垂直，髋部向后推，背部挺直。此为起始姿势。
全程保持背部和手臂完全伸直，呼气时用髋部发力将杠铃拉起。提示：动作不要过快，应平稳且受控。
完全站直后，通过髋部后推下放杠铃，膝盖只轻微弯曲，与深蹲不同。提示：动作开始时深吸气并保持挺胸；下放时屏住呼吸，完成动作时呼气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Romanian Deadlift from Deficit
instructions: Begin standing while holding a bar at arm's length in front of you. You can stand on a raised platform to increase the range of motion.

Begin by flexing the knees slightly, and then flex at the hip, moving your butt back as far as possible, lowering the torso as far as flexibility allows. The back should remain in absolute extension at all times, and the bar should remain in contact with the legs. If done properly, there should be heavy tension felt in the hamstrings.
Reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始站立，双臂伸直在身前握住杠铃。可以站在抬高的平台上以增加活动范围。
先微屈膝盖，然后屈髋，将臀部尽可能向后推，在柔韧性允许范围内尽量下放躯干。背部应始终完全挺直伸展，杠铃应保持贴腿。若动作正确，腘绳肌会有强烈牵拉感。
反向完成动作，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Snatch Deadlift
instructions: The snatch deadlift strengthens the first pull of the snatch. Begin with a wide snatch grip with the barbell placed on the platform. The feet should be directly under the hips, with the feet turned out. Squat down to the bar, keeping the back in absolute extension with the head facing forward.
Initiate the movement by driving through the heels, raising the hips. The back angle should remain the same until the bar passes the knees.
At that point, drive your hips through the bar as you lay back. Return the bar to the platform by reversing the motion.
instructions_zh: 抓举硬拉可强化抓举的第一次拉拽。开始时采用宽握抓举握距，杠铃放在举重台上。双脚应位于髋部正下方，脚尖外展。下蹲至杠铃处，保持背部完全挺直，头部朝前。
通过脚跟发力、抬高髋部来启动动作。在杠铃超过膝盖之前，背部角度应保持不变。
到达该位置后，向前送髋并使身体略微后仰。然后按相反动作将杠铃放回举重台。

document.name: Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down). You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the hips while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips until you are back at the starting position. Exhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 使用正握（掌心向下）握住杠铃。如果使用较大重量，可能需要护腕。
躯干挺直站立，双腿采用与肩同宽或更窄的站距。膝盖应微屈。这是起始姿势。
保持膝盖不动，通过屈髋将杠铃下放至双脚上方，同时保持背部挺直。像要从地上捡东西一样继续前倾，直到感觉腘绳肌被拉伸。此动作过程中吸气。
通过伸展髋部开始将躯干重新抬起，直到回到起始姿势。此动作过程中呼气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Grasp a couple of dumbbells holding them by your side at arm's length.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the dumbbells to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各握一只哑铃，手臂伸直垂于身体两侧。
躯干挺直站立，双腿采用与肩同宽或更窄的站距。膝盖应微屈。这是起始姿势。
保持膝盖不动，通过屈髋将哑铃下放至双脚上方，同时保持背部挺直。像要从地上捡东西一样继续前倾，直到感觉腘绳肌被拉伸。此动作过程中呼气。
通过伸展髋部和腰部开始将躯干重新抬起，直到回到起始姿势。此动作过程中吸气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Sumo Deadlift with Bands
instructions: To deadlift with short bands, simply loop them over the bar before you start, and step into them to set up. Ensure that they under the back half of your foot, directly where you are driving into the floor.

Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
instructions_zh: 要使用短弹力带做硬拉，开始前只需将弹力带绕过杠铃，然后踩进去做好姿势。确保弹力带位于脚后半部下方，也就是你蹬地发力的正下方。
从地面装有杠铃开始。走近杠铃，使杠铃与双脚中点相交。双脚应站得很宽，接近杠铃片卡箍。屈髋握住杠铃。手臂应位于肩部正下方、双腿内侧，可采用正握、正反握或锁握。
吸气，然后降低髋部，抬头向前看，胸部挺起。蹬地发力，双脚向外撑开，重心放在脚后跟至脚掌后半部。通过伸髋伸膝站起。
当杠铃经过膝盖时，身体后倾，髋部向前顶向杠铃，同时肩胛骨收紧。
屈髋控制重量下放，将杠铃放回地面。

document.name: Sumo Deadlift with Chains
instructions: You can attach the chains to the sleeves of the bar, or just drape the middle over the bar so there is a greater weight increase as you lift. Attempt to keep the ends of the chains away from the plates so you don't hit them when you lower the weight.

Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens your arms.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
instructions_zh: 可将铁链挂在杠铃套筒上，或直接将链子中部搭在杠铃上，这样提起时重量会增加。尽量让链条两端远离杠铃片，以免下放重量时撞到杠铃片。
从地面装有杠铃开始。走近杠铃，使杠铃与双脚中点相交。双脚应站得很宽，接近杠铃片卡箍。屈髋握住杠铃。手臂应位于肩部正下方、双腿内侧，可采用正握、正反握或锁握。放松肩部，这样能有效拉长手臂。
吸气，然后降低髋部，抬头向前看，胸部挺起。蹬地发力，双脚向外撑开，重心放在脚后跟至脚掌后半部。通过伸髋伸膝站起。
当杠铃经过膝盖时，身体后倾，髋部向前顶向杠铃，同时肩胛骨收紧。
屈髋控制重量下放，将杠铃放回地面。

document.name: Wide Stance Stiff Legs
instructions: Begin with a barbell loaded on the floor. Adopt a wide stance, and then bend at the hips to grab the bar. Your hips should be as far back as possible, and your legs nearly straight. Keep your back straight, and your head and chest up. This will be your starting position.

Begin the movement be engaging the hips, driving them forward as you allow the arms to hang straight. Continue until you are standing straight up, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position. For successive reps, the weight need not touch the floor.
instructions_zh: 从地面装好杠铃开始。采用宽站距，然后屈髋握住杠铃。髋部应尽可能后移，双腿几乎伸直。保持背部挺直，头和胸抬起。这是起始位置。
开始动作时启动髋部，向前顶髋，同时让手臂自然下垂。继续直到完全站直，然后缓慢将重量还原至起始位置。连续次数时，重量无需触地。

document.name: Ankle On The Knee
instructions: From a lying position, bend your knees and keep your feet on the floor.
Place your ankle of one foot on your opposite knee.
Grasp the thigh or knee of the bottom leg and pull both of your legs into the chest. Relax your neck and shoulders. Hold for 10-20 seconds and then switch sides.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚踩地。
将一只脚的脚踝放在对侧膝盖上。
抓住下方腿的大腿或膝盖，将双腿拉向胸前。放松颈部与肩部。保持10-20秒，然后换边。

document.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with a loaded barbell over your legs. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise. Roll the bar so that it is directly above your hips, and lay down flat on the floor.
Begin the movement by driving through with your heels, extending your hips vertically through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your upper back and the heels of your feet.
Extend as far as possible, then reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，将装有杠铃片的杠铃放在腿上方。使用粗杠或加杠铃垫可大大减轻该动作带来的不适。将杠铃滚到髋部正上方，然后平躺在地面上。
脚跟发力，向上伸展髋部将杠铃垂直顶起，开始动作。身体重量应由上背部和脚跟支撑。
尽可能伸展到最高点，然后反向动作回到起始位置。

document.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with a bench directly behind you. Have a loaded barbell over your legs. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise.
Roll the bar so that it is directly above your hips, and lean back against the bench so that your shoulder blades are near the top of it.

Begin the movement by driving through your feet, extending your hips vertically through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your shoulder blades and your feet. Extend as far as possible, then reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，身后正对一张训练凳。将装有杠铃片的杠铃放在腿上方。使用粗杠或加杠铃垫可大大减轻该动作带来的不适。
将杠铃滚到髋部正上方，向后靠在训练凳上，使肩胛骨靠近训练凳顶部。
双脚发力，向上伸展髋部将杠铃垂直顶起，开始动作。身体重量应由肩胛骨和双脚支撑。尽可能伸展到最高点，然后反向动作回到起始位置。

document.name: Bottoms Up
instructions: Begin by lying on your back on the ground. Your legs should be straight and your arms at your side. This will be your starting position.

To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest by flexing the hips and knees. Following this, extend your legs directly above you so that they are perpendicular to the ground. Rotate and elevate your pelvis to raise your glutes from the floor.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始仰卧在地上。双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。这将是你的起始姿势。
执行动作时，屈髋屈膝，将膝盖收向胸部。随后，将双腿向上伸直，使其垂直于地面。旋转并抬高骨盆，使臀部离开地面。
短暂停顿后，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Butt-Ups
instructions: Begin a pushup position but with your elbows on the ground and resting on your forearms. Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle.
Arch your back slightly out rather than keeping your back completely straight.

Raise your glutes toward the ceiling, squeezing your abs tightly to close the distance between your ribcage and hips. The end result will be that you'll end up in a high bridge position. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Lower back down slowly to your starting position as you breathe in. Tip: Don't let your back sag downwards.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，但将肘部放在地面上，以前臂支撑。手臂应弯曲成90度角。
背部略微拱起，而不是完全保持平直。
将臀部向天花板抬高，同时收紧腹肌，缩短肋廓与髋部之间的距离。最终会进入高位桥式姿势。做这部分动作时呼气。
吸气，同时慢慢下放回起始姿势。提示：不要让背部向下塌陷。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
instructions: Lie flat on the floor on your back with the hands by your side and your knees bent. Your feet should be placed around shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Pushing mainly with your heels, lift your hips off the floor while keeping your back straight. Breathe out as you perform this part of the motion and hold at the top for a second.
Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺在地面上，双手放在身体两侧，双膝弯曲。双脚约与肩同宽放置。这是起始姿势。
主要用脚跟发力，将髋部抬离地面，同时保持背部挺直。做这部分动作时呼气，并在顶端保持一秒。
吸气，同时慢慢回到起始姿势。

document.name: Double Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin standing with your knees slightly bent.
Quickly squat a short distance, flexing the hips and knees, and immediately extend to jump for maximum vertical height.
As you go up, tuck your heels by flexing the knees, attempting to touch the buttocks.
Finish the motion by landing with the knees only partially bent, using your legs to absorb the impact.
instructions_zh: 开始时站立，膝盖微屈。
快速下蹲一小段距离，屈髋屈膝，并立即伸展起跳，以达到最大垂直高度。
起跳时屈膝收脚跟，尽量触碰臀部。
落地时膝盖仅部分弯曲，用双腿缓冲冲击，完成动作。

document.name: Downward Facing Balance
instructions: Lie facedown on top of an exercise ball.
While resting on your stomach on the ball, walk your hands forward along the floor and lift your legs, extending your elbows and knees.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在健身球上。
腹部贴在球上休息时，双手沿地面向前行走，并抬起双腿，伸直肘部和膝盖。

document.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable.
Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright. If using a partner, they will firmly hold your feet to keep you in position. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by extending at the knee, taking care to NOT flex the hips as you go forward.

Place your hands in front of you as you reach the floor. This movement is very difficult and you may be unable to do it unaided. Use your arms to lightly push off the floor to aid your return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 这个动作可以使用搭档，或将双脚固定在某个稳定物体下。
从跪姿开始，大腿和躯干保持直立。如果使用搭档，搭档会牢牢按住你的双脚以保持姿势。这将是你的起始姿势。
通过伸膝降低身体，注意向前时不要屈髋。
在接近地面时将双手放在身前。这个动作非常困难，你可能无法独立完成。用双臂轻推地面，帮助你回到起始姿势。

document.name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Begin by adjusting the equipment to fit your body. Place your feet against the footplate in between the rollers as you lie facedown. Your knees should be just behind the pad.

Start from the bottom of the movement. Keep your back arched as you begin the movement by flexing the knees. Drive your toes into the foot plate as you do so. Keep your upper body straight, and continue until your body is upright.
Return to the starting position, keeping your descent under control.
instructions_zh: 调整器械以适合身体。俯卧，将双脚抵在滚轮之间的脚踏板上。膝盖应刚好在垫子后侧。
从动作底部开始。保持背部反弓，屈膝启动动作，同时脚趾压向脚踏板。上身保持直立，继续直至身体直立。
有控制地下放，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Glute Kickback
instructions: Kneel on the floor or an exercise mat and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to the torso) in order to get into a kneeling push-up position but with the arms spaced at shoulder width. Your head should be looking forward and the bend of the knees should create a 90-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, lift up your right leg until the hamstrings are in line with the back while maintaining the 90-degree angle bend. Contract the glutes throughout this movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second. Tip: At the end of the movement the upper leg should be parallel to the floor while the calf should be perpendicular to it.
Go back to the initial position as you inhale and now repeat with the left leg.
Continue to alternate legs until all of the recommended repetitions have been performed.
instructions_zh: 跪在地板或训练垫上，屈髋，双臂前伸（与躯干垂直），呈跪姿俯卧撑姿势，双手与肩同宽。头部应朝前看，膝盖弯曲使大腿后侧与小腿成90度。这是起始姿势。
呼气时抬起右腿，直到大腿后侧与背部成一直线，同时保持90度屈膝。整个动作中收紧臀肌，在最高点保持收缩1秒。提示：动作结束时，大腿应与地面平行，小腿应与其垂直。
吸气时回到起始姿势，然后用左腿重复。
继续交替双腿，直到完成所有建议次数。

document.name: Hip Extension with Bands
instructions: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.
Facing the attachment point of the band, hold on to the column to stabilize yourself.
Keeping your head and your chest up, move the resisted leg back as far as you can while keeping the knee straight.
Return the leg to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带一端固定在立柱下部，另一端系在一侧脚踝上。
面对弹力带固定点，扶住立柱以保持身体稳定。
保持抬头挺胸，在膝盖伸直的情况下，将受阻力腿尽可能向后伸。
将腿回到起始位置。

document.name: Hip Lift with Band
instructions: After choosing a suitable band, lay down in the middle of the rack, after securing the band on either side of you. If your rack doesn't have pegs, the band can be secured using heavy dumbbells or similar objects, just ensure they won't move.
Adjust your position so that the band is directly over your hips. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor. Your hands can be on the floor or holding the band in position.
Keeping your shoulders on the ground, drive through your heels to raise your hips, pushing into the band as high as you can.
Pause at the top of the motion, and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 选择合适弹力带后，将其两端固定在身体两侧（可固定在深蹲架上；若架子没有固定销，可用重哑铃等重物固定，确保不会移动），然后躺在架子中间。
调整位置，使弹力带正好位于髋部上方。屈膝，双脚平放地面。双手可放在地上，或扶住弹力带保持位置。
保持肩部贴地，脚跟发力抬起髋部，同时向上顶弹力带至最高。
在动作顶端稍停，然后回到起始位置。

document.name: IT Band and Glute Stretch
instructions: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg across your body to the opposite side, keeping the leg extended as you lay on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your foot off of the floor, pull on the belt, using the tension to pull the toes up. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and repeat on the other side.
instructions_zh: 将腰带、绳子或弹力带套在一只脚上，仰卧地面，保持该腿伸直，将这条腿横跨身体摆向对侧。这是起始姿势。
保持脚离开地面，拉弹力带，利用张力将脚趾向上拉。保持10-20秒，然后换另一侧重复。

document.name: Kneeling Squat
instructions: Set the bar to the proper height in a power rack. Kneel behind the bar; it may be beneficial to put a mat down to pad your knees. Slide under the bar, racking it across the back of your shoulders. Your shoulder blades should be retracted and the bar tight across your back. Unrack the weight.
With your head looking forward, sit back with your butt until you touch your calves.
Reverse the motion, returning the torso to an upright position.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃在力量架中调到合适高度。跪在杠铃后方；可在膝下垫垫子以保护膝盖。滑到杠铃下方，将杠铃架在肩后。肩胛骨后缩，使杠铃紧贴背部。取下杠铃。
头部向前看，臀部向后坐，直到碰到小腿。
反向动作，使躯干回到直立位置。

document.name: Lying Glute
instructions: Lie on your back with your partner kneeling beside you.

Flex the hip of one leg, raising it off of the floor. Rotate the leg so the foot is over the opposite hip, the lower leg perpendicular to your body. Your partner should hold the knee and ankle in place. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to push your leg towards your partner, who should be preventing any actual movement of the leg.

After 10-20 seconds, completely relax as your partner gently pushes the ankle and knee towards your chest. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，搭档跪在身旁。
屈曲一条腿的髋部，将腿抬离地面。旋转腿部，使脚位于对侧髋部上方，小腿垂直于身体。搭档固定膝和踝。这是起始姿势。
尝试将腿推向搭档，搭档应阻止腿部实际移动。
10-20秒后完全放松，让搭档轻轻将踝和膝推向你的胸部。拉伸感合适时务必告知搭档，以防受伤或过度拉伸。

document.name: Natural Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Using the leg pad of a lat pulldown machine or a preacher bench, position yourself so that your ankles are under the pads, knees on the seat, and you are facing away from the machine. You should be upright and maintaining good posture.
This will be your starting position. Lower yourself under control until your knees are almost completely straight.
Remaining in control, raise yourself back up to the starting position.
If you are unable to complete a rep, use a band, a partner, or push off of a box to aid in completing a repetition.
instructions_zh: 使用高位下拉机的腿垫或牧师凳，调整位置，使脚踝位于垫子下方、膝盖跪在座椅上，并背对器械。身体应保持直立、姿势良好。
这将是起始姿势。有控制地下放身体，直到膝盖几乎完全伸直。
保持控制，将身体抬起回到起始姿势。
如果无法完成一次动作，可以使用弹力带、搭档协助，或借助箱子蹬地来完成一次重复。

document.name: Physioball Hip Bridge
instructions: Lay on a ball so that your upper back is on the ball with your hips unsupported. Both feet should be flat on the floor, hip width apart or wider. This will be your starting position.
Begin by extending the hips using your glutes and hamstrings, raising your hips upward as you bridge.
Pause at the top of the motion and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在健身球上，使上背部贴在球上，髋部悬空不受支撑。双脚应平放地面，与髋同宽或更宽。这是起始位置。
开始用臀肌和腘绳肌伸展髋部，在挺髋时向上抬起髋部。
在动作顶端稍作停顿，然后回到起始位置。

document.name: Pin Presses
instructions: Pin presses remove the eccentric phase of the bench press, developing starting strength. They also allow you to train a desired range of motion.

The bench should be set up in a power rack. Set the pins to the desired point in your range of motion, whether it just be lockout or an inch off of your chest. The bar should be moved to the pins and prepared for lifting.

Begin by lying on the bench, with the bar directly above the contact point during your regular bench. Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement.
You can take a standard bench grip, or shoulder width to focus on the triceps. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart.
Drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout.
Return the bar to the pins, pausing before beginning the next repetition.
instructions_zh: 销钉卧推去除了卧推的离心阶段，发展起始力量。它还允许你训练所需的动作幅度。
卧推凳应设置在力量举架内。将销钉调到动作幅度中的目标位置，无论是锁定位置还是离胸部一英寸处。应将杠铃移到销钉上并准备举起。
先仰卧在卧推凳上，使杠铃位于常规卧推时接触点的正上方。将双脚收在身体下方并拱起背部。借助杠铃支撑体重，将肩部抬离卧推凳并后缩，夹紧肩胛骨。用双脚发力将斜方肌压向卧推凳。整个动作过程中保持这种紧绷的身体姿势。
你可以采用标准卧推握距，或采用与肩同宽以侧重肱三头肌。杠铃、手腕和肘部应始终保持在一条直线上。专注于握紧杠铃并尝试将其向外掰开。
尽可能用力将杠铃向上推起。肘部应收紧，直到锁定。
将杠铃放回销钉上，在开始下一次重复前稍作停顿。

document.name: Piriformis-SMR
instructions: Sit with your buttocks on top of a foam roll. Bend your knees, and then cross one leg so that the ankle is over the knee. This will be your starting position.

Shift your weight to the side of the crossed leg, rolling over the buttocks until you feel tension in your upper glute. You may assist the stretch by using one hand to pull the bent knee towards your chest. Hold this position for 10-30 seconds, and then switch sides.
instructions_zh: 坐在泡沫轴上，让臀部位于泡沫轴上方。屈膝，然后将一条腿交叉搭在另一条腿上，使脚踝位于膝盖上方。这是起始姿势。
将身体重心移向交叉腿一侧，在臀部上来回滚动，直到上臀感到紧张。可以用一只手将弯曲的膝盖拉向胸口来辅助拉伸。保持该姿势10-30秒，然后换另一侧。

document.name: Seated Glute
instructions: In a seated position with your knees bent, cross one ankle over the opposite knee. Your partner will stand behind you. Now, lean forward as your partner braces your shoulders with their hands. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to push your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.
Now relax your muscles as your partner increases the stretch by gently pushing your torso forward for 10-20 seconds.
instructions_zh: 坐姿，双膝弯曲，将一侧脚踝交叉放在对侧膝盖上。同伴站在你身后。现在，身体前倾，同伴用双手扶住你的肩膀。这是起始姿势。
尝试将躯干向后推10-20秒，同伴阻止躯干实际移动。
现在放松肌肉，同伴通过轻轻将你的躯干向前推来增加拉伸，保持10-20秒。

document.name: Single Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin by standing on one leg, with the bent knee raised. This will be your start position.
Using a countermovement jump, take off upward by extending the hip, knee, and ankle of the grounded leg.
Immediately flex the knee and attempt to touch your butt with the heel of your jumping leg.
Return the leg to a partially bent position underneath the hips and land. Your opposite leg should stay in relatively the same position throughout the drill.
instructions_zh: 开始时单腿站立，另一侧屈膝抬起，这是起始姿势。
通过反向动作跳跃，支撑腿伸展髋、膝和踝向上起跳。
立即屈膝，尝试用起跳腿的脚跟触碰臀部。
将腿回到髋部下方半屈位置落地；整个练习中另一条腿应基本保持同一位置。

document.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lay on the floor with your feet flat and knees bent.
Raise one leg off of the ground, pulling the knee to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by driving through the heel, extending your hip upward and raising your glutes off of the ground.
Extend as far as possible, pause and then return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地板上，双脚平放，膝盖弯曲。
将一条腿抬离地面，把膝盖拉向胸部，这是起始姿势。
通过脚跟发力，向上伸展髋部，使臀部离开地面完成动作。
尽可能伸展，稍作停顿，然后回到起始姿势。

document.name: Sled Push
instructions: Load your pushing sled with the desired weight.

Take an athletic posture, leaning into the sled with your arms fully extended, grasping the handles. Push the sled as fast as possible, focusing on extending your hips and knees to strengthen your posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 给推动雪橇装上所需重量。
采取运动姿势，身体前倾靠向雪橇，双臂完全伸直握住把手。尽可能快地推动雪橇，重点伸展髋部和膝部以强化后链。

document.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with a loaded barbell over your legs. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise. Roll the bar so that it is directly above your hips, and lay down flat on the floor.
Begin the movement by driving through with your heels, extending your hips vertically through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your upper back and the heels of your feet.
Extend as far as possible, then reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，将装有杠铃片的杠铃放在腿上方。使用粗杠或加杠铃垫可大大减轻该动作带来的不适。将杠铃滚到髋部正上方，然后平躺在地面上。
脚跟发力，向上伸展髋部将杠铃垂直顶起，开始动作。身体重量应由上背部和脚跟支撑。
尽可能伸展到最高点，然后反向动作回到起始位置。

document.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with a bench directly behind you. Have a loaded barbell over your legs. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise.
Roll the bar so that it is directly above your hips, and lean back against the bench so that your shoulder blades are near the top of it.

Begin the movement by driving through your feet, extending your hips vertically through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your shoulder blades and your feet. Extend as far as possible, then reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，身后正对一张训练凳。将装有杠铃片的杠铃放在腿上方。使用粗杠或加杠铃垫可大大减轻该动作带来的不适。
将杠铃滚到髋部正上方，向后靠在训练凳上，使肩胛骨靠近训练凳顶部。
双脚发力，向上伸展髋部将杠铃垂直顶起，开始动作。身体重量应由肩胛骨和双脚支撑。尽可能伸展到最高点，然后反向动作回到起始位置。

document.name: Butt-Ups
instructions: Begin a pushup position but with your elbows on the ground and resting on your forearms. Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle.
Arch your back slightly out rather than keeping your back completely straight.

Raise your glutes toward the ceiling, squeezing your abs tightly to close the distance between your ribcage and hips. The end result will be that you'll end up in a high bridge position. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Lower back down slowly to your starting position as you breathe in. Tip: Don't let your back sag downwards.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，但将肘部放在地面上，以前臂支撑。手臂应弯曲成90度角。
背部略微拱起，而不是完全保持平直。
将臀部向天花板抬高，同时收紧腹肌，缩短肋廓与髋部之间的距离。最终会进入高位桥式姿势。做这部分动作时呼气。
吸气，同时慢慢下放回起始姿势。提示：不要让背部向下塌陷。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
instructions: Lie flat on the floor on your back with the hands by your side and your knees bent. Your feet should be placed around shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Pushing mainly with your heels, lift your hips off the floor while keeping your back straight. Breathe out as you perform this part of the motion and hold at the top for a second.
Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺在地面上，双手放在身体两侧，双膝弯曲。双脚约与肩同宽放置。这是起始姿势。
主要用脚跟发力，将髋部抬离地面，同时保持背部挺直。做这部分动作时呼气，并在顶端保持一秒。
吸气，同时慢慢回到起始姿势。

document.name: Double Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin standing with your knees slightly bent.
Quickly squat a short distance, flexing the hips and knees, and immediately extend to jump for maximum vertical height.
As you go up, tuck your heels by flexing the knees, attempting to touch the buttocks.
Finish the motion by landing with the knees only partially bent, using your legs to absorb the impact.
instructions_zh: 开始时站立，膝盖微屈。
快速下蹲一小段距离，屈髋屈膝，并立即伸展起跳，以达到最大垂直高度。
起跳时屈膝收脚跟，尽量触碰臀部。
落地时膝盖仅部分弯曲，用双腿缓冲冲击，完成动作。

document.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable.
Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright. If using a partner, they will firmly hold your feet to keep you in position. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by extending at the knee, taking care to NOT flex the hips as you go forward.

Place your hands in front of you as you reach the floor. This movement is very difficult and you may be unable to do it unaided. Use your arms to lightly push off the floor to aid your return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 这个动作可以使用搭档，或将双脚固定在某个稳定物体下。
从跪姿开始，大腿和躯干保持直立。如果使用搭档，搭档会牢牢按住你的双脚以保持姿势。这将是你的起始姿势。
通过伸膝降低身体，注意向前时不要屈髋。
在接近地面时将双手放在身前。这个动作非常困难，你可能无法独立完成。用双臂轻推地面，帮助你回到起始姿势。

document.name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Begin by adjusting the equipment to fit your body. Place your feet against the footplate in between the rollers as you lie facedown. Your knees should be just behind the pad.

Start from the bottom of the movement. Keep your back arched as you begin the movement by flexing the knees. Drive your toes into the foot plate as you do so. Keep your upper body straight, and continue until your body is upright.
Return to the starting position, keeping your descent under control.
instructions_zh: 调整器械以适合身体。俯卧，将双脚抵在滚轮之间的脚踏板上。膝盖应刚好在垫子后侧。
从动作底部开始。保持背部反弓，屈膝启动动作，同时脚趾压向脚踏板。上身保持直立，继续直至身体直立。
有控制地下放，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Glute Kickback
instructions: Kneel on the floor or an exercise mat and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to the torso) in order to get into a kneeling push-up position but with the arms spaced at shoulder width. Your head should be looking forward and the bend of the knees should create a 90-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, lift up your right leg until the hamstrings are in line with the back while maintaining the 90-degree angle bend. Contract the glutes throughout this movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second. Tip: At the end of the movement the upper leg should be parallel to the floor while the calf should be perpendicular to it.
Go back to the initial position as you inhale and now repeat with the left leg.
Continue to alternate legs until all of the recommended repetitions have been performed.
instructions_zh: 跪在地板或训练垫上，屈髋，双臂前伸（与躯干垂直），呈跪姿俯卧撑姿势，双手与肩同宽。头部应朝前看，膝盖弯曲使大腿后侧与小腿成90度。这是起始姿势。
呼气时抬起右腿，直到大腿后侧与背部成一直线，同时保持90度屈膝。整个动作中收紧臀肌，在最高点保持收缩1秒。提示：动作结束时，大腿应与地面平行，小腿应与其垂直。
吸气时回到起始姿势，然后用左腿重复。
继续交替双腿，直到完成所有建议次数。

document.name: Hip Lift with Band
instructions: After choosing a suitable band, lay down in the middle of the rack, after securing the band on either side of you. If your rack doesn't have pegs, the band can be secured using heavy dumbbells or similar objects, just ensure they won't move.
Adjust your position so that the band is directly over your hips. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor. Your hands can be on the floor or holding the band in position.
Keeping your shoulders on the ground, drive through your heels to raise your hips, pushing into the band as high as you can.
Pause at the top of the motion, and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 选择合适弹力带后，将其两端固定在身体两侧（可固定在深蹲架上；若架子没有固定销，可用重哑铃等重物固定，确保不会移动），然后躺在架子中间。
调整位置，使弹力带正好位于髋部上方。屈膝，双脚平放地面。双手可放在地上，或扶住弹力带保持位置。
保持肩部贴地，脚跟发力抬起髋部，同时向上顶弹力带至最高。
在动作顶端稍停，然后回到起始位置。

document.name: IT Band and Glute Stretch
instructions: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg across your body to the opposite side, keeping the leg extended as you lay on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your foot off of the floor, pull on the belt, using the tension to pull the toes up. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and repeat on the other side.
instructions_zh: 将腰带、绳子或弹力带套在一只脚上，仰卧地面，保持该腿伸直，将这条腿横跨身体摆向对侧。这是起始姿势。
保持脚离开地面，拉弹力带，利用张力将脚趾向上拉。保持10-20秒，然后换另一侧重复。

document.name: Lying Glute
instructions: Lie on your back with your partner kneeling beside you.

Flex the hip of one leg, raising it off of the floor. Rotate the leg so the foot is over the opposite hip, the lower leg perpendicular to your body. Your partner should hold the knee and ankle in place. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to push your leg towards your partner, who should be preventing any actual movement of the leg.

After 10-20 seconds, completely relax as your partner gently pushes the ankle and knee towards your chest. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，搭档跪在身旁。
屈曲一条腿的髋部，将腿抬离地面。旋转腿部，使脚位于对侧髋部上方，小腿垂直于身体。搭档固定膝和踝。这是起始姿势。
尝试将腿推向搭档，搭档应阻止腿部实际移动。
10-20秒后完全放松，让搭档轻轻将踝和膝推向你的胸部。拉伸感合适时务必告知搭档，以防受伤或过度拉伸。

document.name: One-Legged Cable Kickback
instructions: Hook a leather ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and then attach the cuff to your ankle.
Face the weight stack from a distance of about two feet, grasping the steel frame for support.

While keeping your knees and hips bent slightly and your abs tight, contract your glutes to slowly "kick" the working leg back in a semicircular arc as high as it will comfortably go as you breathe out. Tip: At full extension, squeeze your glutes for a second in order to achieve a peak contraction.
Now slowly bring your working leg forward, resisting the pull of the cable until you reach the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the movement for the other side.
instructions_zh: 将皮质脚踝绑带挂到低位绳索滑轮上，然后将绑带固定到脚踝。
面向重量片堆约两英尺距离站立，抓住钢架以支撑身体。
保持膝盖和髋部微屈、腹肌收紧，呼气时收缩臀肌，将工作腿以半圆形轨迹向后缓慢“踢”到舒适的最高位置。提示：在完全伸展时挤压臀肌一秒，以达到顶峰收缩。
现在缓慢将工作腿向前收回，对抗绳索拉力，直到回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。
换另一条腿重复该动作。

document.name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
instructions: Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach.
To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双脚踩地，脚跟位于膝盖正下方。
只将尾骨抬向天花板以拉伸下背部。（暂时不要抬起整个脊柱。）收紧腹部。
进入桥式时，抬起整个脊柱，但不要抬起颈部。

document.name: Physioball Hip Bridge
instructions: Lay on a ball so that your upper back is on the ball with your hips unsupported. Both feet should be flat on the floor, hip width apart or wider. This will be your starting position.
Begin by extending the hips using your glutes and hamstrings, raising your hips upward as you bridge.
Pause at the top of the motion and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在健身球上，使上背部贴在球上，髋部悬空不受支撑。双脚应平放地面，与髋同宽或更宽。这是起始位置。
开始用臀肌和腘绳肌伸展髋部，在挺髋时向上抬起髋部。
在动作顶端稍作停顿，然后回到起始位置。

document.name: Pull Through
instructions: Begin standing a few feet in front of a low pulley with a rope or handle attached. Face away from the machine, straddling the cable, with your feet set wide apart.

Begin the movement by reaching through your legs as far as possible, bending at the hips. Keep your knees slightly bent. Keeping your arms straight, extend through the hip to stand straight up. Avoid pulling upward through the shoulders; all of the motion should originate through the hips.
instructions_zh: 站在低位滑轮前几英尺处，滑轮上装有绳索或把手。背对器械，双腿跨在钢缆两侧，双脚分开较宽。
开始动作时，屈髋尽可能远地从双腿之间向后伸。保持膝盖微屈，手臂伸直，通过髋部伸展站直。避免用肩部向上拉；所有动作都应源自髋部。

document.name: Single Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin by standing on one leg, with the bent knee raised. This will be your start position.
Using a countermovement jump, take off upward by extending the hip, knee, and ankle of the grounded leg.
Immediately flex the knee and attempt to touch your butt with the heel of your jumping leg.
Return the leg to a partially bent position underneath the hips and land. Your opposite leg should stay in relatively the same position throughout the drill.
instructions_zh: 开始时单腿站立，另一侧屈膝抬起，这是起始姿势。
通过反向动作跳跃，支撑腿伸展髋、膝和踝向上起跳。
立即屈膝，尝试用起跳腿的脚跟触碰臀部。
将腿回到髋部下方半屈位置落地；整个练习中另一条腿应基本保持同一位置。

document.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lay on the floor with your feet flat and knees bent.
Raise one leg off of the ground, pulling the knee to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by driving through the heel, extending your hip upward and raising your glutes off of the ground.
Extend as far as possible, pause and then return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地板上，双脚平放，膝盖弯曲。
将一条腿抬离地面，把膝盖拉向胸部，这是起始姿势。
通过脚跟发力，向上伸展髋部，使臀部离开地面完成动作。
尽可能伸展，稍作停顿，然后回到起始姿势。

document.name: 90/90 Hamstring
instructions: Lie on your back, with one leg extended straight out.
With the other leg, bend the hip and knee to 90 degrees. You may brace your leg with your hands if necessary. This will be your starting position.
Extend your leg straight into the air, pausing briefly at the top. Return the leg to the starting position.
Repeat for 10-20 repetitions, and then switch to the other leg.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，一条腿伸直。
另一条腿屈髋屈膝至90度，必要时可用手扶住腿。这是起始姿势。
将腿向空中伸直，在顶端稍作停顿，然后回到起始姿势。
重复10-20次，然后换另一条腿。

document.name: Air Bike
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. For this exercise, you will need to put your hands beside your head. Be careful however to not strain with the neck as you perform it. Now lift your shoulders into the crunch position.
Bring knees up to where they are perpendicular to the floor, with your lower legs parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now simultaneously, slowly go through a cycle pedal motion kicking forward with the right leg and bringing in the knee of the left leg. Bring your right elbow close to your left knee by crunching to the side, as you breathe out.
Go back to the initial position as you breathe in.
Crunch to the opposite side as you cycle your legs and bring closer your left elbow to your right knee and exhale.
Continue alternating in this manner until all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.
instructions_zh: 平躺在地面上，下背部贴紧地面。双手放在头两侧。动作时注意不要使颈部过度受力。将肩膀抬离地面进入卷腹姿势。
屈膝抬起双腿，使大腿与地面垂直、小腿与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
现在同时缓慢做蹬车动作：右腿向前蹬出，左膝收向身体。向侧方卷腹，使右肘靠近左膝，同时呼气。
吸气并回到初始姿势。
继续蹬腿并向另一侧卷腹，使左肘靠近右膝，同时呼气。
继续交替进行，直到每侧完成所有建议次数。

document.name: Barbell Side Split Squat
instructions: Stand up straight while holding a barbell placed on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck). Your feet should be placed wide apart with the foot of the lead leg angled out to the side. This will be your starting position.
Lower your body towards the side of your angled foot by bending the knee and hip of your lead leg and while keeping the opposite leg only slightly bent. Breathe in as you lower your body.
Return to the starting position by extending the hip and knee of the lead leg. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
After performing the recommended amount of reps, repeat the movement with the opposite leg.
instructions_zh: 直立，将杠铃置于肩后（略低于颈部）。双脚大幅分开，前导腿的脚向外侧展开。这是起始姿势。
弯曲前导腿的膝和髋，使身体朝外展脚的一侧下移，同时另一条腿仅微屈。下移时吸气。
伸展前导腿的髋和膝回到起始姿势。做此动作时呼气。
完成建议次数后，换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Cable Hip Adduction
instructions: Stand in front of a low pulley facing forward with one leg next to the pulley and the other one away.
Attach the ankle cuff to the cable and also to the ankle of the leg that is next to the pulley.
Now step out and away from the stack with a wide stance and grasp the bar of the pulley system.
Stand on the foot that does not have the ankle cuff (the far foot) and allow the leg with the cuff to be pulled towards the low pulley. This will be your starting position.
Now perform the movement by moving the leg with the ankle cuff in front of the far leg by using the inner thighs to abduct the hip. Breathe out during this portion of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then repeat the same movement with the opposite leg.
instructions_zh: 面向低位滑轮站立，一条腿靠近滑轮，另一条腿远离滑轮。
将踝套连接到绳索，并套在靠近滑轮那条腿的脚踝上。
向外跨步远离配重架，采用宽站距，并握住滑轮系统的把手。
用没有戴踝套的那只脚（较远的脚）站立，让戴踝套的腿被拉向低位滑轮。这是起始姿势。
现在执行动作：用大腿内侧发力使髋部内收，将戴踝套的腿移动到较远腿的前方。此阶段呼气。
吸气的同时缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复，然后换另一条腿重复相同动作。

document.name: Calf Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.
instructions_zh: 调整座椅，使起始时双腿仅轻微弯曲。前脚掌应稳稳踩在踏板上。
选择合适重量，并握住把手。这是起始姿势。
通过伸展膝关节伸直双腿，仅将重量从配重堆上稍微抬起。踝关节应完全屈曲，脚尖向上。随后通过前脚掌尽可能向下踩来完成动作。
短暂停顿后，反向运动并重复。

document.name: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance.

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you without locking your knees. (Note: In some leg press units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your leg press unit allows for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the legs should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place your toes and balls of your feet on the lower portion of the platform with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Press on the platform by raising your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 使用腿举机，坐下后将双腿以中等（与肩同宽）站距放在正前方的踏板上。
放下固定负重踏板的保险杆，并将踏板一直推起，直到双腿在身前完全伸直，但不要锁死膝盖。（注：部分腿举机可保留保险杆以增加安全性；如果你的器械允许，建议采用这种方式。）躯干与双腿应成标准90度角。然后小心地将脚尖和前脚掌放在踏板下缘，脚跟悬空。脚尖可朝前、朝外或朝内，如本章开头所述。这是起始姿势。
呼气，通过尽可能高地伸展踝关节并收缩小腿，以抬起脚跟的方式踩压踏板。确保膝盖始终固定不动，任何时候都不应弯曲。保持收缩姿势1秒后再开始下放。
吸气，缓慢回到起始位置，放下脚跟并屈曲踝关节，直到小腿被拉伸。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，背部平贴凳子，双腿在凳子末端前方伸直。
双手放在臀部下方且掌心向下，或放在身体两侧抓住凳子。这将是你的起始姿势。
保持双腿伸直、尽可能绷直，膝盖微屈但锁定，抬起双腿直到与地面成90度角。做这部分动作时呼气，并在顶端保持收缩一秒。
现在吸气，缓慢将双腿放回起始姿势。

document.name: Front Leg Raises
instructions: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand.
Swing your leg forward, keeping the leg straight. Continue with a downward swing, bringing the leg as far back as your flexibility allows. Repeat 5-10 times, and then switch legs.
instructions_zh: 站在椅子或其他支撑物旁，用一只手扶住支撑物。
保持腿伸直，向前摆腿。然后向后下方摆动，在柔韧性允许的范围内尽量把腿向后摆。重复5-10次，然后换腿。

document.name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
instructions: To begin, first set the bar in a rack slightly below shoulder level. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids, pushing into the clavicles, and lightly touching the throat. Your hands should be in a clean grip, touching the bar only with your fingers to help keep it in position.

Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head and elbows up at all times. This will be your starting position.

Bend at the knees, sitting down between your legs. Continue down until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your knees aligned with your feet by consciously using your abductors to push your knees out as you squat.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the heel or middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 先将杠铃置于略低于肩部的深蹲架上。杠铃放在三角肌上，压向锁骨，并轻触喉部。双手采用翻站握法，仅用手指接触杠铃以帮助固定。
先蹬腿并同时伸直躯干，将杠铃从架上取下。离开深蹲架，双脚采用肩宽中等站距，脚尖略外展。始终抬头、抬肘。这是起始姿势。
屈膝，臀部向下坐于两腿之间。继续下蹲，直至腘绳肌贴到小腿。下蹲时主动用外展肌将膝盖向外推，使膝盖与双脚对齐。
呼气，主要用脚跟或脚中部蹬地伸腿起身，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Iliotibial Tract-SMR
instructions: Lay on your side, with the bottom leg placed onto a foam roller between the hip and the knee. The other leg can be crossed in front of you.
Place as much of your weight as is tolerable onto your bottom leg; there is no need to keep your bottom leg in contact with the ground. Be sure to relax the muscles of the leg you are stretching.
Roll your leg over the foam from you hip to your knee, pausing for 10-30 seconds at points of tension. Repeat with the opposite leg.
instructions_zh: 侧卧，将下方腿放在泡沫轴上，位置在髋部与膝盖之间。另一条腿可交叉放在身前。
将尽可能多且可承受的体重压到下方腿上；无需让下方腿接触地面。确保放松正在拉伸的腿部肌肉。
让腿从髋部到膝盖在泡沫轴上滚动，在紧张点停留10-30秒。换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars
instructions: Position your body on the vertical leg raise bench so that your forearms are resting on the pads next to the torso and holding on to the handles. Your arms will be bent at a 90 degree angle.
The torso should be straight with the lower back pressed against the pad of the machine and the legs extended pointing towards the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now as you breathe out, lift your legs up as you keep them extended. Continue this movement until your legs are roughly parallel to the floor and then hold the contraction for a second. Tip: Do not use any momentum or swinging as you perform this exercise.
Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 在垂直举腿凳上调整身体，使前臂放在躯干两侧的垫子上并握住把手。双臂弯曲约90度。
躯干保持正直，下背部贴紧器械垫子，双腿向地面方向伸展。这是起始位置。
呼气时保持双腿伸直向上抬起，直到双腿大致与地面平行，然后保持收缩一秒。提示：动作过程中不要借助惯性或摆动。
吸气时缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Leg-Over Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with one kettlebell in place on your chest, holding it by the handle. Extend leg on working side over leg on non-working side.Your free arm can be extended out to your side for support.
Press the kettlebll into a locked out position.
Lower the weight until the elbow touches the ground, keeping the kettlebell above the elbow. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，将一个壶铃放在胸前，握住壶铃把手。将训练侧腿跨过非训练侧腿伸直。空闲手臂可向体侧伸展以支撑。
将壶铃向上推至手臂完全伸直锁定。
缓慢下放重量，直到肘部触地，并保持壶铃位于肘部上方。按目标次数重复。

document.name: Leg Lift
instructions: While standing up straight with both feet next to each other at around shoulder width, grab a sturdy surface such as the sides of a squat rack or the top of a chair to brace yourself and keep balance.
With or without an ankle weight, lift one leg behind you as if performing a leg curl but standing up while keeping the other leg straight. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
Slowly bring the raised leg back to the floor as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Repeat the movement with the opposite leg.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立，间距约与肩同宽，抓住稳固表面（如深蹲架两侧或椅背）支撑身体并保持平衡。
可在踝部负重或不负重，向后抬起一条腿，像站立做腿弯举一样，同时另一条腿伸直。执行此动作时呼气。
吸气时缓慢将抬起的腿放回地面。
按建议次数重复。
换另一条腿重复该动作。

document.name: Leg Press
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.
instructions_zh: 使用腿举机，坐下，将双腿放在正前方踏板上，采用中等（与肩同宽）站距。（注：本说明采用上述中等站距，以促进整体发展；也可选择脚位部分所述的三种站距之一。）
放下固定负重踏板的安全杆，将踏板推至最高，直到双腿在身前完全伸直。提示：确保不要锁死膝关节。躯干与双腿应呈标准90度角。这是起始姿势。
吸气时缓慢下放踏板，直到大腿与小腿呈90度角。
主要用脚跟发力，并借助股四头肌，呼气时回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复，完成后务必正确锁好安全销。不要让满载踏板压到自己。

document.name: Lying Crossover
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.

Cross one leg over your body with the knee bent, attempting to touch the knee to the ground. Your partner should kneel beside you, holding your shoulder down with one hand and controlling the crossed leg with the other. this will be your starting position.
Attempt to raise the bent knee off of the ground as your partner prevents any actual movement.
After 10-20 seconds, relax the leg as your partner gently presses the knee towards the floor. Repeat with the other side.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直。
将一条腿屈膝跨过身体，尝试让膝盖触地。同伴应跪在你身旁，一只手按住你的肩膀，另一只手控制交叉的腿。这是起始姿势。
尝试将弯曲的膝盖抬离地面，同时让同伴阻止任何实际移动。
10-20秒后放松腿部，同伴轻轻将膝盖向地面下压。换另一侧重复。

document.name: Lying Hamstring
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Your partner should be kneeling beside you. Raise one leg up towards the ceiling and have your partner hold the ankle. Your partner can use their shoulder to brace your leg if necessary. This will be your starting position.
With your partner holding your leg in place, attempt to flex the knee, contracting the hamstrings for 10-20 seconds.

Then relax your leg, allowing your partner to gently push the leg towards your head. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching. Switch sides once complete.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直，搭档跪在身旁。抬起一条腿朝向天花板，让搭档握住脚踝。必要时搭档可用肩部抵住你的腿。这是起始姿势。
搭档固定腿后，尝试屈膝，收紧腘绳肌10-20秒。
然后放松腿，让搭档轻轻将腿推向头部。拉伸感合适时务必告知搭档，以防受伤或过度拉伸。完成后换边。

document.name: Lying Leg Curls
instructions: Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad of the lever on the back of your legs (just a few inches under the calves). Tip: Preferably use a leg curl machine that is angled as opposed to flat since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment.

Keeping the torso flat on the bench, ensure your legs are fully stretched and grab the side handles of the machine. Position your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances described on the foot positioning section). This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting the upper legs from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second.
As you inhale, bring the legs back to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 调整器械杠杆至适合身高，俯卧在腿弯举机上，杠杆垫位于腿后侧，约在小腿下方几英寸处。提示：尽量使用有角度的腿弯举机而非平放式，因为倾斜姿势更利于腘绳肌发力。
保持躯干平贴凳面，双腿完全伸直，握住器械两侧把手。脚尖朝前，也可采用脚位部分所述其他两种站姿之一。这是起始姿势。
呼气，将小腿向上弯举至尽可能高，同时大腿不从垫上抬起。到达完全收缩位后停顿1秒。
吸气，将腿放回起始位置。按建议次数重复。

document.name: Lying Machine Squat
instructions: Adjust the leg machine to a height that will allow you to get inside it with your knees bent and the thighs slightly below parallel.

Once you select the weight, position yourself inside the machine face up with the knees bent and thighs slightly below parallel to the platform. Make sure that the knees do not go past the toes. The angle created between the hamstrings and the calves should be one that is slightly less than 90 degrees (since your starting position requires you to start slightly below parallel). Your back and your head should be resting on the machine while your shoulders are pressed under the shoulder pads.
