instructions: Sit down at the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in both arms using a neutral grip (palms of the hand facing you).
Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Make sure that you keep the head up.

The upper arms with the dumbbells should be close to the torso and aligned with it (lifted up until they are parallel to the floor while the forearms are pointing towards the floor as the hands hold the weights). Tip: There should be a 90-degree angle between the forearms and the upper arm. This is your starting position.

Keeping the upper arms stationary, use the triceps to lift the weight as you exhale until the forearms are parallel to the floor and the whole arm is extended. Like many other arm exercises, only the forearm moves.
After a second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
document.name_zh: 坐姿俯身双臂哑铃臂屈伸
aliases_zh: 坐姿俯身双臂哑铃三头肌伸展
坐姿双臂俯身哑铃臂屈伸
instructions_zh: 坐在平凳一端，双手各持哑铃，采用中立握（掌心朝向自己）。
膝盖微屈，保持背部挺直，从腰部向前俯身，直到躯干几乎与地面平行。确保抬头。
持哑铃的上臂应贴近躯干并与躯干对齐（上抬至与地面平行，同时前臂朝下，手握住重物）。提示：前臂与上臂之间应成90度。这是起始姿势。
保持上臂固定，呼气时用肱三头肌抬起重量，直到前臂与地面平行且整条手臂伸直。与许多手臂练习一样，只有前臂移动。
在顶端收缩一秒后，吸气时缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Seated Triceps Press
instructions: Sit down on a bench with back support and grasp a dumbbell with both hands and hold it overhead at arm's length. Tip: a better way is to have somebody hand it to you especially if it is very heavy. The resistance should be resting in the palms of your hands with your thumbs around it. The palm of the hand should be facing inward. This will be your starting position.

Keeping your upper arms close to your head (elbows in) and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semi-circular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在有靠背的训练凳上，双手握住一只哑铃，将其举过头顶至手臂伸直。提示：尤其重量很大时，最好请人把哑铃递给你。阻力应置于掌心，拇指环绕哑铃，掌心朝内。这是起始姿势。
上臂贴近头部（肘部内收）并垂直于地面，以半圆动作将阻力向头后下放，直到前臂接触肱二头肌。提示：上臂应保持不动，只有前臂移动。执行此步时吸气。
用肱三头肌将哑铃举起，回到起始位置。执行此步时呼气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Standing Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: With a dumbbell in one hand and the palm facing your torso, bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Make sure that you keep the head up.

The upper arm should be close to the torso and parallel to the floor while the forearm is pointing towards the floor as the hand holds the weight. Tip: There should be a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm. This is your starting position.

Keeping the upper arms stationary, use the triceps to lift the weights as you exhale until the forearms are parallel to the floor and the whole arm is extended. Like many other arm exercises, only the forearm moves.
After a second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
document.name_zh: 站姿俯身单臂哑铃臂屈伸
aliases_zh: 俯身单臂哑铃三头肌伸展
instructions_zh: 一只手持哑铃，掌心朝向躯干，双膝微屈，屈髋使躯干前倾，保持背部挺直，直到躯干几乎与地面平行。确保抬头。
上臂应贴近躯干并与地面平行，前臂向下，手握住重量。提示：前臂与上臂之间应呈90度角。这是起始姿势。
保持上臂不动，呼气，用肱三头肌抬起重量，直到前臂与地面平行且整条手臂伸直。与许多其他手臂练习一样，只有前臂移动。
在顶端收缩1秒后，吸气，缓慢将哑铃放回起始姿势。
按规定次数重复该动作。
换另一只手臂重复练习。

document.name: Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: With a dumbbell in each hand and the palms facing your torso, bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Make sure that you keep the head up. The upper arms should be close to the torso and parallel to the floor while the forearms are pointing towards the floor as the hands hold the weights. Tip: There should be a 90-degree angle between the forearms and the upper arm. This is your starting position.

Keeping the upper arms stationary, use the triceps to lift the weights as you exhale until the forearms are parallel to the floor and the whole arms are extended. Like many other arm exercises, only the forearm moves.
After a second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbells back to their starting position as you inhale.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
document.name_zh: 站姿俯身双臂哑铃臂屈伸
aliases_zh: 双臂俯身哑铃三头肌伸展
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，掌心朝向躯干，双膝微屈，屈髋使躯干前倾，保持背部挺直，直到躯干几乎与地面平行。确保抬头。上臂应贴近躯干并与地面平行，前臂向下，双手握住重量。提示：前臂与上臂之间应呈90度角。这是起始姿势。
保持上臂不动，呼气，用肱三头肌抬起重量，直到前臂与地面平行且整条手臂伸直。与许多其他手臂练习一样，只有前臂移动。
在顶端收缩1秒后，吸气，缓慢将哑铃放回起始姿势。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: To begin, stand up with a dumbbell held by both hands. Your feet should be about shoulder width apart from each other. Slowly use both hands to grab the dumbbell and lift it over your head until both arms are fully extended.
The resistance should be resting in the palms of your hands with your thumbs around it. The palm of the hands should be facing up towards the ceiling. This will be your starting position.

Keeping your upper arms close to your head with elbows in and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 开始前站直，双手共握一只哑铃。双脚约与肩同宽。缓慢用双手握住哑铃并举过头顶，直到双臂完全伸直。
阻力应放在掌心中，拇指环绕住哑铃。掌心朝上，朝向天花板。这是起始姿势。
保持上臂靠近头部，肘部内收并垂直于地面，以半圆形轨迹将重量向头后下方放，直到前臂接触肱二头肌。提示：上臂应保持不动，只有前臂移动。执行此步骤时吸气。
用肱三头肌将哑铃举回起始姿势。执行此步骤时呼气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: To begin, stand up with a dumbbell held in one hand. Your feet should be about shoulder width apart from each other. Now fully extend the arm with the dumbbell over your head. Tip: The small finger of your hand should be facing the ceiling and the palm of your hand should be facing forward. The dumbbell should be above your head.
This will be your starting position.

Keeping your upper arm close to your head (elbows in) and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearm touch your bicep. Tip: The upper arm should remain stationary and only the forearm should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
document.name_zh: 站姿单臂哑铃肱三头肌伸展
aliases_zh: 站姿单臂哑铃颈后臂屈伸
instructions_zh: 开始时站立，一手持哑铃，双脚与肩同宽。将持哑铃的手臂完全伸直举过头顶。提示：小指朝上，掌心朝前，哑铃位于头顶上方。
这是起始姿势。
保持上臂贴近头部（肘部内收）并与地面垂直，吸气，将阻力沿半圆轨迹向头后下方放，直到前臂触及肱二头肌。提示：上臂应保持不动，只有前臂移动。
呼气，用肱三头肌将哑铃举回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。
换另一侧手臂重复练习。

document.name: Tricep Dumbbell Kickback
instructions: Start with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing your torso. Keep your back straight with a slight bend in the knees and bend forward at the waist. Your torso should be almost parallel to the floor. Make sure to keep your head up. Your upper arms should be close to your torso and parallel to the floor. Your forearms should be pointed towards the floor as you hold the weights. There should be a 90-degree angle formed between your forearm and upper arm. This is your starting position.
Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and use your triceps to lift the weights until the arm is fully extended. Focus on moving the forearm.
After a brief pause at the top contraction, inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，掌心朝向躯干。保持背部挺直，膝盖微屈，从髋部向前俯身。躯干应几乎与地面平行。确保抬头。上臂贴近躯干并与地面平行。持哑铃时，前臂应指向地面。前臂与上臂之间应呈90度角。这是起始姿势。
现在，保持上臂不动，呼气并用三头肌抬起哑铃，直到手臂完全伸直。专注于移动前臂。
在顶部收缩处短暂停顿后，吸气并缓慢将哑铃放回起始姿势。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Alternating Renegade Row
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor about shoulder width apart. Position yourself on your toes and your hands as though you were doing a pushup, with the body straight and extended. Use the handles of the kettlebells to support your upper body. You may need to position your feet wide for support.
Push one kettlebell into the floor and row the other kettlebell, retracting the shoulder blade of the working side as you flex the elbow, pulling it to your side.
Then lower the kettlebell to the floor and begin the kettlebell in the opposite hand. Repeat for several reps.
instructions_zh: 将两个壶铃放在地上，间距约与肩同宽。以脚尖和双手支撑，像做俯卧撑一样，身体保持平直伸展。用壶铃把手支撑上半身。可能需要双脚分开更宽以保持稳定。
将一只壶铃向地面压稳，另一只壶铃做划船：工作侧肩胛骨后缩，同时屈肘，将壶铃拉向身体侧方。
将壶铃下放至地面，再换另一只手进行划船。重复数次。

document.name: Barbell Step Ups
instructions: Stand up straight while holding a barbell placed on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) and stand upright behind an elevated platform (such as the one used for spotting behind a flat bench). This is your starting position.

Place the right foot on the elevated platform. Step on the platform by extending the hip and the knee of your right leg. Use the heel mainly to lift the rest of your body up and place the foot of the left leg on the platform as well. Breathe out as you execute the force required to come up.

Step down with the left leg by flexing the hip and knee of the right leg as you inhale. Return to the original standing position by placing the right foot of to next to the left foot on the initial position.
Repeat with the right leg for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
instructions_zh: 直立，将杠铃置于肩后（略低于颈部），站在抬高平台后方（例如平板凳后用于保护的平台）。这是起始姿势。
将右脚放在抬高平台上。伸展右腿的髋和膝踏上平台。主要用脚跟发力将身体其余部分抬起，并将左脚也放到平台上。发力站起时呼气。
吸气时弯曲右腿的髋和膝，左腿先下踏。将右脚放回左脚旁，回到最初的站立姿势。
用右腿按建议次数重复，然后换左腿进行。

document.name: Body-Up
instructions: Assume a plank position on the ground. You should be supporting your bodyweight on your toes and forearms, keeping your torso straight. Your forearms should be shoulder-width apart. This will be your starting position.
Pressing your palms firmly into the ground, extend through the elbows to raise your body from the ground. Keep your torso rigid as you perform the movement.
Slowly lower your forearms back to the ground by allowing the elbows to flex.
Repeat.
instructions_zh: 在地面上呈平板支撑姿势。以脚趾和前臂支撑体重，保持躯干挺直。前臂与肩同宽。这是起始姿势。
手掌用力压地，伸展肘部将身体从地面撑起。动作过程中保持躯干稳定。
缓慢屈肘，将前臂放回地面。
重复。

document.name: Chest Push from 3 point stance
instructions: Begin in a three point stance, squatted down with your back flat and one hand on the ground. Place the medicine ball directly in front of you.
To begin, take your first step as you pull the ball to your chest, positioning both hands to prepare for the throw.
As you execute the second step, explosively release the ball forward as hard as possible.
instructions_zh: 从三点支撑姿势开始：下蹲，背部保持平直，一只手撑地。将药球放在身体正前方。
开始时迈出第一步，同时将球拉向胸前，双手就位准备投掷。
迈出第二步时，尽全力爆发性地将球向前推出。

document.name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Begin by having a platform or weight plates that you can stand on, usually 1-3 inches in height. Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets.

With your feet, and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and bend the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
instructions_zh: 先准备一个可站立的平台或杠铃片，通常高度为1至3英寸。走近杠铃，使其位于双脚正中上方。双脚约与髋同宽。屈髋握住杠铃，握距与肩同宽，让肩胛骨前伸。较重组通常采用正握或正反握。
双脚和握法就位后，深吸一口气，然后降低髋部并屈膝，直到小腿接触杠铃。头部向前看，挺胸并保持背部反弓，开始通过脚跟发力将重量向上移动。杠铃过膝后，积极将杠铃向后拉，同时肩胛骨收紧，髋部向前顶向杠铃。
屈髋下放杠铃，并引导其回到地面。

document.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. The dumbbells should be just to the sides of your chest, with your upper arm and forearm creating a 90 degree angle. Be sure to maintain full control of the dumbbells at all times. This will be your starting position.

Then, as you breathe out, use your chest to push the dumbbells up. Lock your arms at the top of the lift and squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then begin coming down slowly. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，哑铃放在大腿上方。掌心相对。
然后借助大腿将哑铃逐只抬起，使你能在身前以肩宽握持哑铃。
到达肩宽后，向前旋转手腕，使掌心朝向远离你的方向。哑铃应位于胸部两侧，上臂与前臂约呈90度角。始终确保完全控制哑铃。此为起始姿势。
然后呼气，用胸部发力将哑铃向上推起。在动作顶端锁臂并挤压胸部，停顿一秒后开始缓慢下放。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所用时间约为上推时间的两倍。
按训练计划规定的重复次数重复该动作。

document.name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
instructions: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, your chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys.
Lay flat on the bench and keep your feet on the ground.
Have someone hand you the handles on each hand. You will grab each single handle attachment with a palms up grip.

Extend your arms by your side with a slight bend on your elbows. Tip: You will keep this bend constant through the whole movement. Your arms should be parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.

Now start lifting the arms in a semi-circle motion directly in front of you by pulling the cables together until both hands meet at the top of the movement. Squeeze your chest as you perform this motion and breathe out during this movement. Also, hold the contraction for a second at the top. Tip: When performed correctly, at the top position of this movement, your arms should be perpendicular to your torso and the floor touching above your chest.
Slowly come back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将一张平板凳放在两个低位滑轮之间，使你躺在凳上时胸部与绳索滑轮对齐。
平躺在凳上，双脚保持踩地。
请人把两侧把手递给你。你用掌心向上的握法抓住每个单把手附件。
双臂向身体两侧伸展，肘部微屈。提示：整个动作过程中保持这个弯曲角度不变。你的手臂应平行于地面。这是你的起始姿势。
现在开始将手臂在身体正前方做半圆形运动，把两侧绳索拉在一起，直到动作顶端双手相遇。做这个动作时收紧胸部，并在动作过程中呼气。同时，在顶端保持收缩一秒。提示：动作正确时，在顶端位置你的手臂应垂直于躯干和地面，并在胸部上方相触。
缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with your legs off the end.

Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench (or with palms down by the side on an exercise mat). Also extend your legs straight out. This will be your starting position.
Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out. Continue this movement until your knees are near your chest. Hold the contracted position for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在训练垫或平板凳上，双腿伸出凳子末端。
双手放在臀部下方且掌心向下，或放在身体两侧抓住凳子（在训练垫上则掌心向下放在身体两侧）。双腿也完全伸直。这将是你的起始姿势。
呼气时屈膝，将大腿上部拉向腹部。继续该动作，直到膝盖接近胸部。在收缩位置保持一秒。
吸气时缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，背部平贴凳子，双腿在凳子末端前方伸直。
双手放在臀部下方且掌心向下，或放在身体两侧抓住凳子。这将是你的起始姿势。
保持双腿伸直、尽可能绷直，膝盖微屈但锁定，抬起双腿直到与地面成90度角。做这部分动作时呼气，并在顶端保持收缩一秒。
现在吸气，缓慢将双腿放回起始姿势。

document.name: Front Leg Raises
instructions: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand.
Swing your leg forward, keeping the leg straight. Continue with a downward swing, bringing the leg as far back as your flexibility allows. Repeat 5-10 times, and then switch legs.
instructions_zh: 站在椅子或其他支撑物旁，用一只手扶住支撑物。
保持腿伸直，向前摆腿。然后向后下方摆动，在柔韧性允许的范围内尽量把腿向后摆。重复5-10次，然后换腿。

document.name: Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension Bench
instructions: With someone holding down your legs, slide yourself down to the edge a flat bench until your hips hang off the end of the bench. Tip: Your entire upper body should be hanging down towards the floor. Also, you will be in the same position as if you were on a hyperextension bench but the range of motion will be shorter due to the height of the flat bench vs. that of the hyperextension bench.

With your body straight, cross your arms in front of you (my preference) or behind your head. This will be your starting position. Tip: You can also hold a weight plate for extra resistance in front of you under your crossed arms.

Start bending forward slowly at the waist as far as you can while keeping your back flat. Inhale as you perform this movement. Keep moving forward until you almost touch the floor or you feel a nice stretch on the hamstrings (whichever comes first). Tip: Never round the back as you perform this exercise.

Slowly raise your torso back to the initial position as you exhale. Tip: Avoid the temptation to arch your back past a straight line. Also, do not swing the torso at any time in order to protect the back from injury.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 让人按住你的双腿，将身体沿平板凳向前滑到边缘，直到髋部悬在凳子末端之外。提示：整个上半身应朝地面下垂。此时姿势与在罗马椅上相同，但由于平板凳高度较低，动作幅度会更短。
身体保持挺直，双臂交叉放在胸前（我的偏好）或放在脑后。这是起始姿势。提示：也可在交叉双臂下胸前抱杠铃片增加阻力。
保持背部平直，从腰部开始缓慢前屈到最大幅度，同时吸气。继续前屈，直到几乎触地或腘绳肌有明显拉伸感（以先出现者为准）。提示：做此动作时切勿弓背。
呼气的同时，缓慢将躯干抬回起始位置。提示：避免腰部反弓超过直线；任何时候都不要甩动躯干，以保护背部免受伤害。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance
instructions: Lie face down with your whole body straight on a flat bench while holding a weight plate behind your head. Tip: You will need to position yourself so that your shoulders are slightly above the end of a flat bench in order for the upper chest, neck and face to be off the bench. This will be your starting position.
While keeping the plate secure on the back of your head slowly lower your head (as in saying "yes") as you breathe in.
Raise your head back up to the starting position in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold the contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在平板凳上，全身伸直，双手将杠铃片固定在头后。提示：调整位置，使肩部略高于凳端，让上胸、颈部和面部离开凳面。这是起始姿势。
保持杠铃片固定在头后，吸气时缓慢低头，像点头说“是”一样。
呼气时以半圆形轨迹抬头回到起始位置，顶峰收缩1秒。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: One-Arm Flat Bench Dumbbell Flye
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand resting on top of your thigh. The palm of your hand with the dumbbell in it should be at a neutral grip.

By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbell up, clean the dumbbell so that you can hold it in front of you with your lifting arm being fully extended. Remember to maintain a neutral grip with this exercise. Your non lifting hand should be to the side holding the flat bench for better support. This will be your starting position.

Your arm with the weight should have a slight bend on your elbow in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon. Begin by lowering your arm with the weight in it out in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on your chest. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout the movement, your lifting arm should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the shoulder joint.
Return your lifting arm back to the starting position as you squeeze your chest muscles and breathe out. Tip: Make sure to use the same arc of motion used to lower the weights.
Hold for a second at the contracted position and repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，一只手握住哑铃置于大腿上方。持铃手掌应呈中立握（掌心相对）。
借助大腿把哑铃向上带起，将哑铃提至身前，持铃手臂完全伸直。记住本练习保持中立握。非持铃手应放在身体一侧抓住平凳以提供更好支撑。这是起始姿势。
持铃手臂肘部应略微弯曲，以避免肱二头肌腱受力。开始时，将持铃手臂沿宽弧线向外下方落下，直到胸部有拉伸感。执行动作这一部分时吸气。提示：记住整个动作过程中，持铃手臂应保持固定；动作只应发生在肩关节。
将持铃手臂回到起始位置，同时挤压胸肌并呼气。提示：确保沿与下放时相同的弧线运动。
在收缩位置停留一秒，并按规定次数重复动作。
换手臂重复练习。

document.name: Plank
instructions: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.
instructions_zh: 俯卧于地面，用脚趾和前臂支撑体重。手臂弯曲，位于肩膀正下方。
始终保持身体挺直，并尽可能长时间保持该姿势。要增加难度，可以抬起一只手臂或一条腿。

document.name: Push-Up Wide
instructions: With your hands wide apart, support your body on your toes and hands in a plank position. Your elbows should be extended and your body straight. Do not allow your hips to sag. This will be your starting position.
To begin, allow the elbows to flex, lowering your chest to the floor as you inhale.
Using your pectoral muscles, press your upper body back up to the starting position by extending the elbows. Exhale as you perform this step.
After pausing at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手大幅分开，以脚尖和双手支撑身体呈平板姿势。肘部伸直，身体保持笔直。不要让髋部下沉。这是起始姿势。
开始时，让肘部弯曲，吸气的同时将胸部下放至地面。
使用胸肌，通过伸直肘部将上半身推回起始姿势。做这一步时呼气。
在收缩位置稍作停顿后，按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Push Up to Side Plank
instructions: Get into pushup position on the toes with your hands just outside of shoulder width.
Perform a pushup by allowing the elbows to flex. As you descend, keep your body straight.
Do one pushup and as you come up, shift your weight on the left side of the body, twist to the side while bringing the right arm up towards the ceiling in a side plank.
Lower the arm back to the floor for another pushup and then twist to the other side.
Repeat the series, alternating each side, for 10 or more reps.
instructions_zh: 进入俯卧撑姿势，脚尖撑地，双手略宽于肩。
做俯卧撑，允许肘部弯曲。下降时保持身体挺直。
做一个俯卧撑，起身时将重心移到身体左侧，向侧面转体，同时将右臂向上举向天花板，进入侧平板支撑。
将手臂放回地面，再做一次俯卧撑，然后转向另一侧。
重复该组合，左右交替，做10次或更多。

document.name: Single-Arm Push-Up
instructions: Begin laying prone on the ground. Move yourself into a position supporting your weight on your toes and one arm. Your working arm should be placed directly under the shoulder, fully extended. Your legs should be extended, and for this movement you may need a wider base, placing your feet further apart than in a normal push-up.
Maintain good posture, and place your free hand behind your back. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by allowing the elbow to flex until you touch the ground.
Descend slowly, and reverse direction be extending the arm to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 先俯卧在地。将身体撑起，用脚趾和一只手臂支撑体重。发力臂应位于肩部正下方并完全伸直。双腿伸直；此动作可能需要更宽的支撑面，双脚间距比普通俯卧撑更宽。
保持良好姿势，将非支撑手放在背后。这是起始姿势。
屈肘降低身体，直到接触地面。
缓慢下放，然后反向伸臂回到起始位置。

document.name: Snatch from Blocks
instructions: Begin with a loaded barbell on boxes or stands of the desired height. A wide grip should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed. Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward. The shoulders should be just in front of the bar, with the elbows pointed out. This will be the starting position.
Begin the first pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the boxes.

Transition into the second pull by extending through the hips knees and ankles, driving the bar up as quickly as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. The feet should move to just outside the hips, turned out as necessary. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Keeping the bar aligned over the front of the heels, your head and chest up, drive through heels of the feet to move to a standing position. Carefully return the weight to the boxes.
instructions_zh: 开始时将加好杠铃片的杠铃放在所需高度的箱子或支架上。采用宽握抓举握距握住杠铃。双脚应位于髋部正下方，必要时脚尖外展。降低髋部，胸部抬起，头部朝前。肩部应略在杠铃前方，肘部朝外。这是起始姿势。
通过脚跟前部蹬地，将杠铃从箱子上拉起，开始第一次拉拽。
通过伸髋、伸膝和伸踝过渡到第二次拉拽，尽可能快地将杠铃向上带动。杠铃应贴近身体。在伸展顶点耸肩，并让肘部向两侧弯曲。
当双脚移动到接杠位置时，在将杠铃举过头顶的同时，用力将身体拉到杠铃下方。双脚应移动到略宽于髋部的位置，必要时脚尖外展。以尽可能低的深蹲姿势接住杠铃，双臂完全伸直举过头顶。
保持杠铃对齐在脚跟前部上方，头部和胸部抬起，通过脚跟蹬地站起。然后小心地将重量放回箱子上。

document.name: Standing Hip Circles
instructions: Begin standing on one leg, holding to a vertical support.
Raise the unsupported knee to 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Open the hip as far as possible, attempting to make a big circle with your knee.
Perform this movement slowly for a number of repetitions, and repeat on the other side.
instructions_zh: 开始时单腿站立，扶住垂直支撑物。
将无支撑腿的膝盖抬至90度。这是起始姿势。
尽可能打开髋部，尝试用膝盖画一个大圆。
缓慢进行该动作若干次，然后换另一侧重复。

document.name: Standing Palms-Up Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Start by standing straight and holding a barbell behind your glutes at arm's length while using a pronated grip (palms will be facing back away from the glutes) and having your hands shoulder width apart from each other.
You should be looking straight forward while your feet are shoulder width apart from each other. This is the starting position.
While exhaling, slowly elevate the barbell up by curling your wrist in a semi-circular motion towards the ceiling. Note: Your wrist should be the only body part moving for this exercise.
Hold the contraction for a second and lower the barbell back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
When finished, lower the barbell down to the squat rack or the floor by bending the knees. Tip: It is easiest to either pick it up from a squat rack or have a partner hand it to you.
document.name_zh: 站姿掌心向上杠铃背后腕弯举
instructions_zh: 站直，双臂自然下垂，在臀部后方以手臂伸直的状态握住杠铃，采用旋前握法（掌心朝后、背离臀部），双手与肩同宽。
目视前方，双脚与肩同宽。此为起始姿势。
呼气，通过手腕向天花板方向做半圆形弯举，慢慢将杠铃向上抬起。注意：本动作中只有手腕移动。
保持收缩1秒，吸气将杠铃下放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。
完成后，屈膝将杠铃放回深蹲架或地面。提示：从深蹲架上拿起或让同伴递给你最省力。

document.name: Suspended Push-Up
instructions: Anchor your suspension straps securely to the top of a rack or other object.

Leaning into the straps, take a handle in each hand and move into a push-up plank position. You should be as close to parallel to the ground as you can manage with your arms fully extended, maintaining good posture.
Maintaining a straight, rigid torso, descend slowly by allowing the elbows to flex.
Continue until your elbows break 90 degrees, pausing before you extend to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将悬吊带牢固固定在架子或其他物体的顶部。
身体向悬吊带倾斜，每只手握住一个手柄，进入俯卧撑平板姿势。在双臂完全伸直且保持良好姿态的情况下，尽量让身体与地面平行。
保持躯干平直、僵硬，屈肘并缓慢下降。
继续下降直到肘部超过90度，稍作停顿后再伸展手臂返回起始姿势。

document.name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
instructions: Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles hanging about a foot off of the ground. Move yourself into a pushup plank position facing away from the rack.
Place your feet into the handles. You should maintain a straight posture, not allowing the hips to sag. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the knees and hips, drawing the knees to your torso. As you do so, anteriorly tilt your pelvis, allowing your spine to flex.
At the top of the controlled motion, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 固定一组悬吊带，使手柄悬垂在离地约一英尺的位置。身体进入俯卧撑平板姿势，背对固定架。
将双脚放入手柄中。应保持身体平直，不要让髋部下沉。这是起始姿势。
开始时屈膝屈髋，将膝盖拉向躯干。同时骨盆前倾，使脊柱屈曲。
在有控制的动作顶端，返回起始姿势。

document.name: Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench with feet firm on the floor. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away from shoulder width (for each hand), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双脚牢牢踩在地面。采用宽握正握（掌心朝前），每只手比肩宽向外约3英寸（约7.6厘米），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定将杠铃保持在身体正上方。杠铃应垂直于躯干和地面。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放，直到感觉杠铃触到胸部中部。
停顿一秒后，呼气并用胸肌将杠铃推回起始姿势。在收缩位置锁定双臂并挤压胸部，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应是上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: Select a light resistance and sit down on the ab machine placing your feet under the pads provided and grabbing the top handles. Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle as you rest the triceps on the pads provided. This will be your starting position.

At the same time, begin to lift the legs up as you crunch your upper torso. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Tip: Be sure to use a slow and controlled motion. Concentrate on using your abs to move the weight while relaxing your legs and feet.
After a second pause, slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 选择较轻阻力，坐在卷腹机上，双脚放在下方护垫下，双手握住上方把手。双臂弯曲约90度，将肱三头肌靠在护垫上。这是起始姿势。
同时开始抬起双腿，并卷曲上躯干。动作时呼气。提示：动作要缓慢可控，专注于用腹肌发力移动重量，同时放松双腿和双脚。
停顿约1秒后，吸气并缓慢回到起始姿势。
按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Air Bike
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. For this exercise, you will need to put your hands beside your head. Be careful however to not strain with the neck as you perform it. Now lift your shoulders into the crunch position.
Bring knees up to where they are perpendicular to the floor, with your lower legs parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now simultaneously, slowly go through a cycle pedal motion kicking forward with the right leg and bringing in the knee of the left leg. Bring your right elbow close to your left knee by crunching to the side, as you breathe out.
Go back to the initial position as you breathe in.
Crunch to the opposite side as you cycle your legs and bring closer your left elbow to your right knee and exhale.
Continue alternating in this manner until all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.
instructions_zh: 平躺在地面上，下背部贴紧地面。双手放在头两侧。动作时注意不要使颈部过度受力。将肩膀抬离地面进入卷腹姿势。
屈膝抬起双腿，使大腿与地面垂直、小腿与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
现在同时缓慢做蹬车动作：右腿向前蹬出，左膝收向身体。向侧方卷腹，使右肘靠近左膝，同时呼气。
吸气并回到初始姿势。
继续蹬腿并向另一侧卷腹，使左肘靠近右膝，同时呼气。
继续交替进行，直到每侧完成所有建议次数。

document.name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel below a high pulley that contains a rope attachment.
Grasp cable rope attachment and lower the rope until your hands are placed next to your face.
Flex your hips slightly and allow the weight to hyperextend the lower back. This will be your starting position.

With the hips stationary, flex the waist as you contract the abs so that the elbows travel towards the middle of the thighs. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction for a second.

Slowly return to the starting position as you inhale. Tip: Make sure that you keep constant tension on the abs throughout the movement. Also, do not choose a weight so heavy that the lower back handles the brunt of the work.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 跪在高位滑轮下方，滑轮上装有绳索附件。
抓住绳索附件，将绳索下拉，直到双手位于面部两侧。
髋部稍微弯曲，让重量使下背部略微过伸。这是起始姿势。
保持髋部不动，收缩腹肌并屈曲腰部，使肘部向大腿中段移动。此阶段呼气，并保持收缩一秒。
吸气的同时缓慢回到起始姿势。提示：整个动作过程中确保腹肌持续紧张。另外，不要选择过重的重量，以免下背部承担主要工作。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Cable Reverse Crunch
instructions: Connect an ankle strap attachment to a low pulley cable and position a mat on the floor in front of it.
Sit down with your feet toward the pulley and attach the cable to your ankles.
Lie down, elevate your legs and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle. Your legs and the cable should be aligned. If not, adjust the pulley up or down until they are.
With your hands behind your head, bring your knees inward to your torso and elevate your hips off the floor.
Pause for a moment and in a slow and controlled manner drop your hips and bring your legs back to the starting 90-degree angle. You should still have tension on your abs in the resting position.
Repeat the same movement to failure.
instructions_zh: 将脚踝绑带连接到低位滑轮绳索，并在其前方地面铺好垫子。
坐下，双脚朝向滑轮，将绳索固定在脚踝处。
躺下，抬高双腿并屈膝成90度角。双腿应与绳索在同一直线上；若不是，上下调整滑轮直至对齐。
双手放在头后，将膝盖向躯干方向收回，并把臀部抬离地面。
停顿片刻，然后缓慢可控地放下臀部，双腿回到起始90度角。在还原位置仍应保持腹部张力。
重复同样动作至力竭。

document.name: Cable Seated Crunch
instructions: Seat on a flat bench with your back facing a high pulley.

Grasp the cable rope attachment with both hands (with the palms of the hands facing each other) and place your hands securely over both shoulders. Tip: Allow the weight to hyperextend the lower back slightly. This will be your starting position.
With the hips stationary, flex the waist so the elbows travel toward the hips. Breathe out as you perform this step.
As you inhale, go back to the initial position slowly.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在平凳上，背对高位滑轮。
双手握住绳索手柄（掌心相对），将双手稳妥地置于两侧肩部上方。提示：让配重使下背部略微过伸。此为起始姿势。
保持臀部不动，屈曲腰部，使肘部向髋部方向移动。做这一步时呼气。
吸气时缓慢回到起始位置。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Cocoons
instructions: Begin by lying on your back on the ground. Your legs should be straight and your arms extended behind your head. This will be your starting position.

To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest, rotating your pelvis to lift your glutes from the floor. As you do so, flex the spine, bringing your arms back over your head to perform a simultaneous crunch motion.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始时仰卧在地面上。双腿伸直，双臂向后伸过头顶。这是起始姿势。
执行动作时，将膝盖收向胸部，旋转骨盆使臀部离开地面。同时屈曲脊柱，将双臂从头后方向前带回，完成同步卷腹动作。
稍作停顿后，回到起始位置。

document.name: Cross-Body Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back and bend your knees about 60 degrees.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and place your hands loosely behind your head. This will be your starting position.

Now curl up and bring your right elbow and shoulder across your body while bring your left knee in toward your left shoulder at the same time. Reach with your elbow and try to touch your knee. Exhale as you perform this movement. Tip: Try to bring your shoulder up towards your knee rather than just your elbow and remember that the key is to contract the abs as you perform the movement; not just to move the elbow.
Now go back down to the starting position as you inhale and repeat with the left elbow and the right knee.
Continue alternating in this manner until all prescribed repetitions are done.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝约60度。
双脚平放地面，双手轻放于脑后。这是起始姿势。
卷腹起身，将右肘和右肩向身体对侧移动，同时左膝向左肩方向抬起。用肘去够膝。动作时呼气。提示：尽量让肩膀向膝盖靠近，而不只是移动肘部；关键是动作时收缩腹肌，而不只是移动肘部。
吸气回到起始位置，换左肘和右膝重复。
交替进行，直到完成规定次数。

document.name: Crunch - Hands Overhead
instructions: Lie on the floor with your back flat and knees bent with around a 60-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and stretch your arms overhead with your palms crossed. This will be your starting position.

Curl your upper body forward and bring your shoulder blades just off the floor. At all times, keep your arms aligned with your head, neck and shoulder. Don't move them forward from that position. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction for a second.
Slowly lower down to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧地面，背部平贴，屈膝，使腘绳肌与小腿之间约呈60度。
双脚平放地面，双臂向头顶伸展，双手交叉。这是起始姿势。
将上体向前卷起，使肩胛骨刚离开地面。全程保持手臂与头、颈、肩成一直线，不要使其向前移动。动作这一部分呼气，并保持收缩一秒。
吸气，缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Crunch - Legs On Exercise Ball
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your feet resting on an exercise ball and your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Place your feet three to four inches apart and point your toes inward so they touch.
Place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
Push the small of your back down in the floor in order to better isolate your abdominal muscles. This will be your starting position.

Begin to roll your shoulders off the floor and continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back. Your shoulders should come up off the floor only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the floor. Breathe out as you execute this portion of the movement. Squeeze your abdominals hard at the top of the contraction and hold for a second. Tip: Focus on a slow, controlled movement. Refrain from using momentum at any time.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双脚放在健身球上，膝盖弯曲90度。
双脚分开三到四英寸，脚尖内转使脚趾相触。
双手轻放于头部两侧，肘部内收。提示：不要将手指交叉扣在脑后。
将下背部向下压向地面，以更好地孤立腹肌。这是起始姿势。
开始将肩膀卷离地面，同时用下背部尽可能用力向下压。肩膀只应抬离地面约四英寸，下背部应保持在地面上。执行这一部分时呼气。在收缩顶端用力挤压腹肌并保持一秒。提示：专注于缓慢、可控的动作，任何时候都不要借助惯性。
吸气，缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground, or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle. If you are resting your feet on a bench, place them three to four inches apart and point your toes inward so they touch.
Now place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down in the floor to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off the floor.

Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale. Your shoulders should come up off the floor only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the floor. At the top of the movement, contract your abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
After the one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双脚平放地面，或放在长凳上、膝盖弯曲约90度。若双脚放在长凳上，双脚相距约3至4英寸，脚尖内扣使两脚尖相触。
双手轻放头部两侧，肘部内收。提示：不要将手指交叉扣在脑后。
将下背部压向地面，以更好地孤立腹肌，开始将肩膀卷离地面。
在收缩腹肌并呼气时，用下背部尽可能用力压向地面。肩膀离地仅约4英寸，下背部应保持贴地。动作顶端用力收紧腹肌，并保持收缩1秒。提示：专注于缓慢、可控的动作，不要借助惯性自欺。
保持收缩1秒后，一边吸气一边缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Decline Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back on a decline bench and hold on to the top of the bench with both hands. Don't let your body slip down from this position.

Hold your legs parallel to the floor using your abs to hold them there while keeping your knees and feet together. Tip: Your legs should be fully extended with a slight bend on the knee. This will be your starting position.
While exhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the bench. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在下斜凳上，双手抓住凳子上端。不要让身体从这个位置向下滑。
用腹肌将双腿保持在平行于地面的位置，膝盖和双脚并拢。提示：双腿应完全伸直，膝盖轻微弯曲。这将是你的起始位置。
呼气时，将双腿移向躯干，同时骨盆向后卷动，并将臀部抬离凳面。动作结束时，膝盖应触及胸部。
保持收缩1秒，吸气并将双腿回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Exercise Ball Crunch
instructions: Lie on an exercise ball with your lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball. Your feet should be bent at the knee and pressed firmly against the floor. The upper torso should be hanging off the top of the ball. The arms should either be kept alongside the body or crossed on top of your chest as these positions avoid neck strains (as opposed to the hands behind the back of the head position).
Lower your torso into a stretch position keeping the neck stationary at all times. This will be your starting position.

With the hips stationary, flex the waist by contracting the abdominals and curl the shoulders and trunk upward until you feel a nice contraction on your abdominals. The arms should simply slide up the side of your legs if you have them at the side or just stay on top of your chest if you have them crossed. The lower back should always stay in contact with the ball. Exhale as you perform this movement and hold the contraction for a second.
As you inhale, go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在健身球上，使下背部弧度贴紧球的球面。双脚屈膝并稳稳踩在地面上。上半身应悬在球顶外。双臂可放在身体两侧或交叉放在胸前，因为这些姿势能避免颈部拉伤（不要采用双手抱在头后的姿势）。
将躯干下放至拉伸位置，全程保持颈部不动。这将是起始姿势。
保持髋部不动，通过收缩腹肌屈曲腰部，将肩部和躯干向上卷起，直到腹肌有明显收缩感。若双臂在体侧，应沿大腿两侧向上滑动；若双臂交叉，则保持在胸前。下背部应始终与球接触。执行动作时呼气，并在收缩位保持1秒。
吸气时回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Gorilla Chin/Crunch
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar using an underhand grip (palms facing you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width.
Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle so that the calves are parallel to the floor while the thighs remain perpendicular to it. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, pull yourself up while crunching your knees up at the same time until your knees are at chest level. You will stop going up as soon as your nose is at the same level as the bar. Tip: When you get to this point you should also be finishing the crunch at the same time.
Slowly start to inhale as you return to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 用反握（掌心朝向自己）悬挂在引体向上杆上，握距略宽于肩。
现在屈膝90度，使小腿与地面平行，大腿仍与其垂直。这是起始姿势。
呼气时向上拉起身体，同时卷腹屈膝上抬，直到膝盖到达胸部高度。当鼻子与杆同高时停止上升。提示：到达该位置时，你也应同时完成卷腹。
缓慢吸气，同时回到起始姿势。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Oblique Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. For this exercise, you will need to put one hand beside your head and the other to the side against the floor.
Make sure your feet are elevated and resting on a flat surface.
Now lift the shoulder in which your hand is touching your head.

Simply elevate your shoulder and body upward until you touch your knee. For example, if you have your right hand besides your head, then you want to elevate your body upwards until your right elbow touches your left knee. The same variation can be applied doing the inverse and using your left elbow to touch your right knee.
After your knee touches your elbow, lower your body until you have reached the starting position.
Remember to breathe in during the eccentric (lowering) part of the exercise and to breathe out during the concentric (upward) part of the exercise.
Continue alternating in this manner until all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.
instructions_zh: 平躺在地面上，下背部压向地面。此练习需要一只手放在头侧，另一只手放在身体侧面的地面上。
确保双脚抬高并放在平坦表面上。
现在抬起手放头侧那一侧的肩部。
只需将肩部和身体向上抬起，直到触及膝盖。例如，如果右手放在头侧，就向上抬起身体，直到右肘触及左膝。反向做同样变化，用左肘触及右膝。
膝盖触及肘部后，放下身体直至回到起始姿势。
记住在离心（下放）阶段吸气，在向心（上抬）阶段呼气。
继续以这种方式交替进行，直到每侧完成所有建议次数。

document.name: Oblique Crunches - On The Floor
instructions: Start out by lying on your right side with your legs lying on top of each other. Make sure your knees are bent a little bit.
Place your left hand behind your head.
Once you are in this set position, begin by moving your left elbow up as you would perform a normal crunch except this time the main emphasis is on your obliques.
Crunch as high as you can, hold the contraction for a second and then slowly drop back down into the starting position.
Remember to breathe in during the eccentric (lowering) part of the exercise and to breathe out during the concentric (elevation) part of the exercise.
instructions_zh: 先向右侧卧，双腿叠放。确保膝盖略微弯曲。
将左手放在脑后。
进入该准备姿势后，开始将左肘向上移动，就像做普通卷腹一样，但这次重点放在腹斜肌上。
尽可能卷起，保持收缩一秒，然后缓慢下放回到起始姿势。
记住在离心（下放）阶段吸气，在向心（抬起）阶段呼气。

document.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie down on the floor with your legs fully extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on the floor. Your arms should be stationary for the entire exercise.
Move your legs up so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to the floor. This is the starting position.
While inhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the floor. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，双腿完全伸直，双臂放在躯干两侧，掌心贴地。整个动作过程中双臂应保持不动。
将双腿抬起，使大腿与地面垂直，双脚并拢且与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
吸气时，将双腿向躯干方向移动，同时骨盆向后卷动，并将臀部抬离地面。动作结束时膝盖应接触胸部。
保持收缩1秒，呼气时将双腿放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Rope Crunch
instructions: Kneel 1-2 feet in front of a cable system with a rope attached.
After selecting an appropriate weight, grasp the rope with both hands reaching overhead. Your torso should be upright in the starting position.
To begin, flex at the spine, attempting to bring your rib cage to your legs as you pull the cable down.
Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return to the starting position.
These can be done with twists or to the side to hit the obliques.
instructions_zh: 在装有绳索把手的龙门架前1–2英尺（约30–60厘米）处跪姿。
选择合适重量后，双手过头握住绳索。起始姿势中躯干应保持直立。
开始时屈曲脊柱，下拉绳索，尽量让胸廓靠近腿部。
在动作底部稍停，然后缓慢回到起始姿势。
也可以加入转体或向侧方完成，以刺激腹斜肌。

document.name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
instructions: Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles hanging about a foot off of the ground. Move yourself into a pushup plank position facing away from the rack.
Place your feet into the handles. You should maintain a straight posture, not allowing the hips to sag. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the knees and hips, drawing the knees to your torso. As you do so, anteriorly tilt your pelvis, allowing your spine to flex.
At the top of the controlled motion, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 固定一组悬吊带，使手柄悬垂在离地约一英尺的位置。身体进入俯卧撑平板姿势，背对固定架。
将双脚放入手柄中。应保持身体平直，不要让髋部下沉。这是起始姿势。
开始时屈膝屈髋，将膝盖拉向躯干。同时骨盆前倾，使脊柱屈曲。
在有控制的动作顶端，返回起始姿势。

document.name: Tuck Crunch
instructions: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your arms should be lying across your sides with the palms facing down.

Your legs should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around the other. Slowly elevate your legs up in the air until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. Note: Your knees and toes should be parallel to the floor as opposed to the thighs.
Move your arms from the floor and cross them so they are resting on your chest. This is the starting position.
While keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise.
Slowly begin to lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 开始时仰卧在地板或瑜伽垫上，背部贴紧地面。双臂放在身体两侧，掌心向下。
双腿交叉，一只脚踝搭在另一只脚踝上。缓慢将双腿抬离地面，直至大腿与地面垂直，膝盖微屈。注意：膝盖和脚尖应平行于地面，而不是与大腿保持一条直线。
将双臂从地面抬起并交叉放在胸前。此为起始姿势。
保持下背部贴紧地面，缓慢抬起躯干。注意在此阶段呼气。
缓慢将躯干还原至起始姿势，同时吸气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Weighted Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Hold a weight to your chest, or you may hold it extended above your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, exhale and slowly begin to roll your shoulders off the floor. Your shoulders should come up off the floor about 4 inches while your lower back remains on the floor.
At the top of the movement, flex your abdominals and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双脚平放地面，或放在长凳上、膝盖屈曲90度。
将重物抱在胸前，或伸直双臂举于躯干上方。这是起始姿势。
呼气，缓慢将肩膀卷离地面。肩膀应离地约4英寸，下背部保持贴地。
动作顶端收紧腹肌并短暂停顿。
然后吸气，缓慢下降回起始位置。

document.name: Alternating Hang Clean
instructions: Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.

Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell in a hanging position. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrist as you do so.
Lower the cleaned kettlebell to a hanging position and clean the alternate kettlebell. Repeat.
instructions_zh: 将两个壶铃放在双脚之间。进入起始姿势时，臀部后推，目视正前方。
将一个壶铃翻至肩部，另一个壶铃保持悬垂。翻起时通过伸展腿部和髋部，将壶铃拉向肩部，同时旋转手腕。
将已翻起的壶铃放回悬垂位置，再翻另一只壶铃。重复。

document.name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position
instructions: Initiate the exercise by standing upright with a kettlebell in one hand.
Swing the kettlebell back forcefully and then reverse the motion forcefully. Crush the kettlebell handle as hard as possible and raise the kettlebell to your shoulder.
instructions_zh: 开始练习时，单手持壶铃直立站立。
将壶铃有力地向后摆，然后有力反向摆动。尽可能用力握紧壶铃把手，将壶铃举至肩部。

document.name: Bottoms Up
instructions: Begin by lying on your back on the ground. Your legs should be straight and your arms at your side. This will be your starting position.

To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest by flexing the hips and knees. Following this, extend your legs directly above you so that they are perpendicular to the ground. Rotate and elevate your pelvis to raise your glutes from the floor.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始仰卧在地上。双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。这将是你的起始姿势。
执行动作时，屈髋屈膝，将膝盖收向胸部。随后，将双腿向上伸直，使其垂直于地面。旋转并抬高骨盆，使臀部离开地面。
短暂停顿后，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
instructions: Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell.
With a fluid motion, lower the top kettlebell while driving the bottom kettlebell up.
instructions_zh: 将两个壶铃放在双脚之间。进入起始姿势时，臀部向后推，目视前方。
将一个壶铃翻至肩部，同时握住另一个壶铃。
以流畅的动作，下放上方的壶铃，同时将下方的壶铃向上驱动。

document.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，背部平贴凳子，双腿在凳子末端前方伸直。
双手放在臀部下方且掌心向下，或放在身体两侧抓住凳子。这将是你的起始姿势。
保持双腿伸直、尽可能绷直，膝盖微屈但锁定，抬起双腿直到与地面成90度角。做这部分动作时呼气，并在顶端保持收缩一秒。
现在吸气，缓慢将双腿放回起始姿势。

document.name: Hang Clean
instructions: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging at the mid thigh position. Your back should be straight and inclined slightly forward.
Begin by aggressively extending through the hips, knees and ankles, driving the weight upward. As you do so, shrug your shoulders towards your ears.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.
instructions_zh: 以与肩同宽的双正握或钩握开始，杠铃悬垂于大腿中部位置。背部应挺直并略向前倾。
开始主动伸髋、伸膝和伸踝，将重量向上驱动。同时耸肩向耳朵方向。
立即通过脚跟发力恢复，保持躯干直立、肘部向上。继续直到站直。

document.name: Hang Clean - Below the Knees
instructions: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging just below the knees. Your back should be straight and inclined slightly forward.

Begin by aggressively extending through the hips, knees and ankles, driving the weight upward. As you do so, shrug your shoulders towards your ears. As full extension is achieved, transition into the third pull by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the elbows up and out.

At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating your elbows under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat position, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third pull. The bar should be racked onto the protracted shoulders, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat position, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.
instructions_zh: 以与肩同宽的双正握或钩握开始，杠铃悬垂于膝盖下方。背部应挺直并略向前倾。
开始主动伸髋、伸膝和伸踝，将重量向上驱动。同时耸肩向耳朵方向。达到完全伸展时，积极耸肩并屈臂、肘部向上向外，过渡到第三拉。
在最高伸展时，积极向下拉身体，同时将肘部旋转到杠铃下方。以前蹲姿势接杠，其深度取决于第三拉结束时杠铃的高度。杠铃应架在前伸的肩上，轻触喉部，双手放松。继续下蹲至底部深蹲位置，这有助于起身恢复。
立即通过脚跟发力恢复，保持躯干直立、肘部向上。继续直到站直。

document.name: Hang Snatch
instructions: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. The feet should be directly below the hips with the feet turned out. Your knees should be slightly bent, and the torso inclined forward. The spine should be fully extended and the head facing forward. The bar should be at the hips. This will be your starting position.
Aggressively extend through the legs and hips. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Return to a standing position with the weight overhead. Follow by returning the weight to the ground under control.
instructions_zh: 以宽握距正握或钩握杠铃开始。双脚应位于髋部正下方，脚尖外展。膝盖微屈，躯干前倾。脊柱完全伸展，头部朝前。杠铃应位于髋部。这是起始姿势。
主动伸腿伸髋。在最高伸展时，耸肩并允许肘部向两侧弯曲。
当双脚移动到接杠位置时，用力将身体拉到杠铃下方，同时将杠铃举过头顶。以尽可能低的身体姿势接杠，双臂完全伸直举过头顶。
在重量举过头顶的情况下回到站立姿势。随后有控制地将重量放回地面。

document.name: Hang Snatch - Below Knees
instructions: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. The feet should be directly below the hips with the feet turned out. Your knees should be slightly bent, and the torso inclined forward. The spine should be fully extended and the head facing forward. The bar should be just below the knees. This will be your starting position.
Aggressively extend through the legs and hips. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Return to a standing position with the weight overhead, and then return the weight to the floor under control.
instructions_zh: 采用宽握距握杠，使用正握或锁握。双脚位于髋部正下方，脚尖外展。膝盖微屈，躯干前倾。脊柱完全伸展，头部朝前。杠铃应位于膝盖下方稍低处。这是起始姿势。
积极伸展双腿和髋部。在伸展峰值时耸肩，并让肘部向两侧弯曲。
双脚移动到接杠位置时，用力将身体拉到杠下，同时把杠铃举过头顶。以尽可能低的身体姿势接杠，双臂在头顶完全伸直。
以杠铃过顶姿势回到站立位，然后控制杠铃回到地面。

document.name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Suspend the bar using chains or suspension straps.

Bend over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your traps. At the proper height, you should be near parallel to the floor when bent over. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Begin the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings, and you are standing with the weight.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position, where it is supported by the chains.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放在与腹部大致同高的架子上，用链条或悬吊带悬挂杠铃。
在杠下俯身，将杠铃置于肩后，如力量深蹲那样，不要放在斜方肌顶部。高度合适时，俯身应接近与地面平行。保持背部绷紧、肩胛骨夹紧、膝盖微屈。保持背部拱起，颈椎保持正确对齐。
通过臀部和腘绳肌伸展髋部开始动作，直至负重站立。
缓慢将重量降回起始位置，由链条支撑。

document.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar with both arms extended at arms length in top of you using either a wide grip or a medium grip. The legs should be straight down with the pelvis rolled slightly backwards. This will be your starting position.
Raise your legs until the torso makes a 90-degree angle with the legs. Exhale as you perform this movement and hold the contraction for a second or so.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手以宽握或中握距伸直悬挂在引体向上杠上。双腿笔直向下，骨盆略微后倾。这是起始姿势。
抬起双腿，直到躯干与双腿成90度角。动作过程中呼气，并在收缩位保持约1秒。
吸气时缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Hanging Pike
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar with your legs and feet together using an overhand grip (palms facing away from you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width. Tip: You may use wrist wraps in order to facilitate holding on to the bar.

Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle and bring the upper legs forward so that the calves are perpendicular to the floor while the thighs remain parallel to it. This will be your starting position.
Pull your legs up as you exhale until you almost touch your shins with the bar above you. Tip: Try to straighten your legs as much as possible while at the top.
Lower your legs as slowly as possible until you reach the starting position. Tip: Avoid swinging and using momentum at all times.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 以略宽于肩的overhand正握（掌心朝外）悬挂在引体向上杠上，双腿并拢。提示：可使用护腕帮助握杠。
屈膝成90度，并将大腿向前抬，使小腿与地面垂直，同时大腿与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
呼气时将双腿向上拉，直到小腿几乎碰到上方的杠。提示：在最高点尽量伸直双腿。
尽可能缓慢地放下双腿，直到回到起始位置。提示：始终避免摆动和借助惯性。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
instructions: Place kettlebell between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.

Clean kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
Lower kettlebell to a hanging position between your legs while keeping the hamstrings loaded. Keep your head up at all times.
instructions_zh: 将壶铃放在双脚之间。进入起始姿势时，臀部向后推，目视前方。
将壶铃翻至肩部。通过伸展腿部和髋部，同时将壶铃向上提至肩部，完成向肩部的翻铃。过程中手腕应随之转动。
将壶铃下放至双腿之间的悬垂位置，同时保持腘绳肌受力。全程保持抬头。

document.name: Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars
instructions: Position your body on the vertical leg raise bench so that your forearms are resting on the pads next to the torso and holding on to the handles. Your arms will be bent at a 90 degree angle.
The torso should be straight with the lower back pressed against the pad of the machine and the legs extended pointing towards the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now as you breathe out, lift your legs up as you keep them extended. Continue this movement until your legs are roughly parallel to the floor and then hold the contraction for a second. Tip: Do not use any momentum or swinging as you perform this exercise.
Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 在垂直举腿凳上调整身体，使前臂放在躯干两侧的垫子上并握住把手。双臂弯曲约90度。
躯干保持正直，下背部贴紧器械垫子，双腿向地面方向伸展。这是起始位置。
呼气时保持双腿伸直向上抬起，直到双腿大致与地面平行，然后保持收缩一秒。提示：动作过程中不要借助惯性或摆动。
吸气时缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Leg Press
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.
instructions_zh: 使用腿举机，坐下，将双腿放在正前方踏板上，采用中等（与肩同宽）站距。（注：本说明采用上述中等站距，以促进整体发展；也可选择脚位部分所述的三种站距之一。）
放下固定负重踏板的安全杆，将踏板推至最高，直到双腿在身前完全伸直。提示：确保不要锁死膝关节。躯干与双腿应呈标准90度角。这是起始姿势。
吸气时缓慢下放踏板，直到大腿与小腿呈90度角。
主要用脚跟发力，并借助股四头肌，呼气时回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复，完成后务必正确锁好安全销。不要让满载踏板压到自己。

document.name: One Handed Hang
instructions: Grab onto a chinup bar with one hand, using a pronated grip. Keep your feet on the floor or a step. Allow the majority of your weight to hang from that hand, while keeping your feet on the ground. Hold for 10-20 seconds and switch sides.
instructions_zh: 用正握单手抓住引体向上杆，双脚保持在地面或台阶上。
让大部分体重悬垂于该手，同时双脚保持在地面。保持10-20秒后换侧。

document.name: Seated Leg Tucks
instructions: Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and your arms holding on to the sides of the bench. Your torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench. This will be your starting position.
Bring the knees in toward you as you move your torso closer to them at the same time. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
After a second pause, go back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳上，双腿向前伸直并略低于水平，双手抓住长凳两侧。躯干应向后倾斜，与长凳约呈45度。这是起始姿势。
将膝盖收向身体，同时躯干也向膝盖靠近。完成此动作时呼气。
停顿一秒钟后，吸气并回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Smith Machine Hang Power Clean
instructions: Position the bar at knee height and load it to an appropriate weight.

Take a pronated grip on the bar outside of shoulder width and unhook the bar from the machine. Your arms should be fully extended with your head and chest up. Your elbows should be pointed out with your shoulders back and down. Your hips should be back, loading the tension into the hamstrings. This will be your starting position.
Initate the movement by forcefully extending the hips and knees, accelerating into the bar. Ensure that you keep your arms straight during this part of the motion.
Upon full extension, rebend the hips and knees to lower your receiving position.
Allow the arms to flex at this point, rotating the elbows around the bar to receive it on your shoulders.
Extend through the hips and knees to come to a standing position with the bar racked on your shoulders to complete the movement.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃杆置于膝盖高度并加载合适重量。
采用宽于肩的正握握住杠铃杆，从机器上解锁。双臂应完全伸直，抬头挺胸。肘部外展，肩部后收下沉。髋部后移，使腘绳肌产生张力。这是起始姿势。
通过爆发性伸展髋部和膝部启动动作，加速向上带动杠铃杆。确保在此阶段保持双臂伸直。
完全伸展后，重新屈髋屈膝，降低接杠位置。
此时让手臂屈曲，肘部绕杠铃杆旋转，将杆接在肩部。
伸展髋部和膝部站起，使杠铃杆架于肩上，完成动作。

document.name: Split Snatch
instructions: Begin with a loaded barbell on the floor. The bar should be close to or touching the shins, and a wide grip should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed. Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward. The shoulders should be just in front of the bar. This will be the starting position.
Begin the first pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the ground. The back angle should stay the same until the bar passes the knees.

Transition into the second pull by extending through the hips knees and ankles, driving the bar up as quickly as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. The feet should move forcefully to a split position, one foot forward one foot back. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Keeping the bar aligned over the front of the heels, your head and chest up, drive through heels of the feet to move to a standing position, bringing your feet together.
Carefully return the weight to floor.
instructions_zh: 从地面上的杠铃开始。杠铃应贴近或接触小腿，采用宽握距握杠。双脚位于髋部正下方，按需外展。降低髋部，胸部抬起，目视前方。肩部应略在杠铃前方。这是起始姿势。
通过脚跟前端发力开始第一次提拉，将杠铃从地面拉起。杠铃过膝前背部角度保持不变。
过渡到第二次提拉，伸展髋、膝和踝，尽可能快速地把杠铃向上带。杠铃应贴近身体。在伸展最高点耸肩，并让肘部向两侧弯曲。
当双脚移动到接铃位置时，在将杠铃举过头顶的同时用力将自己拉到杠铃下方。双脚应有力移动成分腿姿势，一脚前一脚后。身体尽可能低地接住杠铃，双臂在头顶完全伸直。
保持杠铃对准脚跟前端上方，头胸抬起，通过脚跟发力站起，双脚并拢。
小心地将重量放回地面。

document.name: Suspended Push-Up
instructions: Anchor your suspension straps securely to the top of a rack or other object.

Leaning into the straps, take a handle in each hand and move into a push-up plank position. You should be as close to parallel to the ground as you can manage with your arms fully extended, maintaining good posture.
Maintaining a straight, rigid torso, descend slowly by allowing the elbows to flex.
Continue until your elbows break 90 degrees, pausing before you extend to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将悬吊带牢固固定在架子或其他物体的顶部。
身体向悬吊带倾斜，每只手握住一个手柄，进入俯卧撑平板姿势。在双臂完全伸直且保持良好姿态的情况下，尽量让身体与地面平行。
保持躯干平直、僵硬，屈肘并缓慢下降。
继续下降直到肘部超过90度，稍作停顿后再伸展手臂返回起始姿势。

document.name: Suspended Split Squat
instructions: Suspend your straps so the handles are 18-30 inches from the floor.
Facing away from the setup, place your rear foot into the handle behind you. Keep your head looking forward and your chest up, with your knee slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Descend by flexing the knee and hips, lowering yourself to the ground. Keep your weight on the heel of your foot and maintain your posture throughout the exercise.
At the bottom of the movement, reverse the motion, extending through the hip and knee to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 调整悬吊带，使把手距离地面18–30英寸。
背对悬吊装置，将后脚放入身后的把手中。头部保持目视前方，胸部挺起，膝盖微屈。这是起始姿势。
通过屈膝和屈髋下蹲，降低身体至地面。将重心放在支撑脚脚后跟上，并在整个动作中保持身体姿态。
在动作最低点，反向运动，伸展髋部和膝盖，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Wind Sprints
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Your arms and legs should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by quickly raising one knee as high as you can. Do not swing your body or your legs. 3
Immediately reverse the motion, returning that leg to the starting position. Simultaneously raise the opposite knee as high as possible.
Continue alternating between legs until the set is complete.
instructions_zh: 正握引体向上杆悬垂，双臂和双腿伸直。这是起始位置。
开始快速将一侧膝盖尽可能抬高。不要摆动身体或腿。
立即反向动作，将该腿回到起始位置，同时尽可能抬高对侧膝盖。
继续交替双腿，直到完成该组。

document.name: Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral
instructions: Select a weight and hold the handle of the low pulley with your right hand.

Bend at the waist until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. Your legs should be slightly bent with your left hand placed on your lower left thigh. Your right arm should be hanging from your shoulder in front of you and with a slight bend at the elbow. This will be your starting position.
Raise your right arm, elbow slightly bent, to the side until the arm is parallel to the floor and in line with your right ear. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and repeat the movement with the other arm.
instructions_zh: 选择重量，用右手握住低位滑轮把手。
屈髋前倾，直到躯干几乎与地面平行。双腿微屈，左手放在左大腿下部。右臂自然下垂于身前，肘部微屈。这是起始姿势。
将右臂向侧抬起，肘部微屈，直到手臂与地面平行并与右耳成一直线。完成这一步时呼气。
吸气，缓慢将重量放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复，然后换另一只手臂重复该动作。

document.name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
instructions: Lie flat on the floor on your back with the hands by your side and your knees bent. Your feet should be placed around shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Pushing mainly with your heels, lift your hips off the floor while keeping your back straight. Breathe out as you perform this part of the motion and hold at the top for a second.
Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺在地面上，双手放在身体两侧，双膝弯曲。双脚约与肩同宽放置。这是起始姿势。
主要用脚跟发力，将髋部抬离地面，同时保持背部挺直。做这部分动作时呼气，并在顶端保持一秒。
吸气，同时慢慢回到起始姿势。

document.name: Cable Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand in the middle of two low pulleys that are opposite to each other and place a flat bench right behind you (in perpendicular fashion to you; the narrow edge of the bench should be the one behind you). Select the weight to be used on each pulley.
Now sit at the edge of the flat bench behind you with your feet placed in front of your knees.
Bend forward while keeping your back flat and rest your torso on the thighs.

Have someone give you the single handles attached to the pulleys. Grasp the left pulley with the right hand and the right pulley with the left after you select your weight. The pulleys should run under your knees and your arms will be extended with palms facing each other and a slight bend at the elbows. This will be the starting position.

While keeping the arms stationary, raise the upper arms to the sides until they are parallel to the floor and at shoulder height. Exhale during the execution of this movement and hold the contraction for a second.
Slowly lower your arms to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Tip: Maintain upper arms perpendicular to torso and a fixed elbow position (10 degree to 30 degree angle) throughout exercise.
instructions_zh: 站在两个相对的低位滑轮中间，并在身后放置一张平凳（与身体垂直；平凳的窄边朝向背后）。选择每个滑轮要使用的重量。
现在坐在身后平凳边缘，双脚置于膝盖前方。
保持背部挺直向前俯身，将躯干靠在双腿上。
让别人把连接滑轮的单手柄递给你。选好重量后，右手握左侧滑轮手柄，左手握右侧滑轮手柄。绳索应从膝盖下方穿过，双臂伸展，掌心相对，肘部微屈。此为起始姿势。
保持手臂姿势不变，将上臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行并达到肩部高度。动作过程中呼气，并在顶端保持收缩一秒。
吸气时缓慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复建议次数。提示：整个练习中保持上臂与躯干垂直，并固定肘部位置（10至30度角）。

document.name: External Rotation
instructions: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.
Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the arm parallel to your torso.

Now bend the elbow while keeping the upper arm stationary. In this manner, the forearm will be parallel to the floor and perpendicular to your torso (Tip: So the forearm will be directly in front of you). The upper arm will be stationary by your torso and should be parallel to the floor (aligned with your torso at all times). This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, externally rotate your forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm. You will continue this external rotation until the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the torso pointing towards the ceiling. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.
instructions_zh: 侧卧在平凳上，一只手臂持哑铃，另一只手叠放在凳面上，以便头靠在上面。
弯曲持哑铃手臂的肘部，使上臂与前臂成90度角。提示：保持手臂与躯干平行。
现在保持上臂不动，弯曲肘部。这样前臂将与地面平行，并与躯干垂直（提示：前臂会正对前方）。上臂应固定在躯干旁，并与地面平行（始终与躯干对齐）。这将是起始姿势。
呼气时，前臂外旋，使哑铃以半圆形轨迹抬起，同时保持上臂与前臂之间90度弯曲。继续外旋，直到前臂与地面垂直、躯干朝向天花板。此时保持收缩1秒。
吸气时缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复，然后换另一只手臂。

document.name: Lateral Bound
instructions: Assume a half squat position facing 90 degrees from your direction of travel. This will be your starting position.
Allow your lead leg to do a countermovement inward as you shift your weight to the outside leg.
Immediately push off and extend, attempting to bound to the side as far as possible.
Upon landing, immediately push off in the opposite direction, returning to your original start position.
Continue back and forth for several repetitions.
instructions_zh: 呈半蹲姿势，面朝与行进方向成90度的方向。这是起始姿势。
将重心移向外侧腿时，让前导腿向内做反向预摆。
立即蹬地伸展，尽量向侧方跳远。
落地后立即向相反方向蹬地，回到原来的起始位置。
继续来回进行多次重复。

document.name: London Bridges
instructions: Attach a climbing rope to a high beam or cross member. Below it, ensure that the smith machine bar is locked in place with the safeties and cannot move. Alternatively, a secure box could also be utilized.
Stand on the bar, using the rope to balance yourself. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your body straight, lean back and lower your body by slowly going hand over hand with the rope. Continue until you are perpendicular to the ground.
Keeping your body straight, reverse the motion, going hand over hand back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将攀爬绳固定在高处的横梁或横杆上。在其下方，确保史密斯机横杆已用安全锁固定牢靠、无法移动；也可以改用稳固的箱子。
站在横杆上，借助绳索保持平衡。这是起始姿势。
保持身体挺直，向后仰，并通过双手交替抓绳缓慢下放身体，直到身体与地面垂直。
保持身体挺直，反向做动作，双手交替抓绳回到起始姿势。

document.name: One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie down sideways on an incline bench press with a dumbbell in the hand. Make sure the shoulder is pressing against the incline bench and the arm is lying across your body with the palm around your navel.
Hold a dumbbell in your uppermost arm while keeping it extended in front of you parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.

While keeping the dumbbell parallel to the floor at all times, perform a lateral raise. Your arm should travel straight up until it is pointing at the ceiling. Tip: Exhale as you perform this movement. Hold the dumbbell in the position and feel the contraction in the shoulders for a second.
While inhaling lower the weight across your body back into the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
instructions_zh: 侧卧在上斜卧推凳上，一只手握哑铃。确保肩部贴紧上斜凳，手臂横放在身体前方，手掌位于肚脐附近。
用位于上方的手臂握住哑铃，并保持手臂向前伸直、与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
始终保持哑铃与地面平行，做侧平举。手臂应笔直向上移动，直到指向天花板。提示：执行此动作时呼气。在最高位置保持哑铃并感受肩部收缩一秒。
吸气的同时，将重量沿身体前方下放回起始位置。
按指定次数重复该动作。
换手臂重复该动作。

document.name: One-Arm Side Laterals
instructions: Pick a dumbbell and place it in one of your hands. Your non lifting hand should be used to grab something steady such as an incline bench press. Lean towards your lifting arm and away from the hand that is gripping the incline bench as this will allow you to keep your balance.
Stand with a straight torso and have the dumbbell by your side at arm's length with the palm of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbell to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and your hand slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arm is parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
instructions_zh: 选择一只哑铃放在一只手中。非持铃手应抓住稳固物体，如上斜卧推凳。身体向持铃臂一侧倾斜，并远离抓握上斜凳的手，以保持平衡。
站直，躯干保持正直，哑铃垂于体侧，手臂伸直，掌心朝向自己。这是起始姿势。
保持躯干不动（不要摆动），肘部微屈，将哑铃向侧面举起，手部略微向前倾斜，如同向玻璃杯中倒水。继续上举直至手臂与地面平行。执行此动作时呼气，并在顶部停顿一秒。
吸气的同时缓慢将哑铃放回起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。
换另一侧手臂重复该练习。

document.name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
instructions: Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach.
To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双脚踩地，脚跟位于膝盖正下方。
只将尾骨抬向天花板以拉伸下背部。（暂时不要抬起整个脊柱。）收紧腹部。
进入桥式时，抬起整个脊柱，但不要抬起颈部。

document.name: Physioball Hip Bridge
instructions: Lay on a ball so that your upper back is on the ball with your hips unsupported. Both feet should be flat on the floor, hip width apart or wider. This will be your starting position.
Begin by extending the hips using your glutes and hamstrings, raising your hips upward as you bridge.
Pause at the top of the motion and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在健身球上，使上背部贴在球上，髋部悬空不受支撑。双脚应平放地面，与髋同宽或更宽。这是起始位置。
开始用臀肌和腘绳肌伸展髋部，在挺髋时向上抬起髋部。
在动作顶端稍作停顿，然后回到起始位置。

document.name: Seated Side Lateral Raise
instructions: Pick a couple of dumbbells and sit at the end of a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing in and your arms straight down at your sides at arms' length. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 选一对哑铃，坐在平凳一端，双脚踩实地面。掌心相对握哑铃，手臂自然伸直垂于体侧。这是起始姿势。
保持躯干不动（不要摆动），将哑铃向身体两侧抬起，肘部微屈，双手略微前倾，如同往杯中倒水。持续上抬至手臂与地面平行。执行时呼气，在顶端停顿1秒。
吸气，缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Side Hop-Sprint
instructions: Stand to the side of a cone or hurdle.
Begin this drill by hopping sideways over the obstacle, rebounding out of your landing to hop back to where you started.
Hop for a prescribed number or repetitions as quickly as possible, and finish this drill by sprinting a short distance upon landing the last hop.
instructions_zh: 站在标志锥或栏架的一侧。
开始这项练习时，先侧向跳过障碍物，落地后借助反弹力跳回起点位置。
以尽可能快的速度完成规定次数，并在最后一次跳跃落地后以短距离冲刺结束该练习。

document.name: Side Lateral Raise
instructions: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells by your side at arms length with the palms of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso in a stationary position (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 选一对哑铃，站直并保持躯干挺直，双臂自然下垂于身体两侧、手臂伸直，掌心朝向身体。这是起始姿势。
保持躯干稳定不动（不要借助摆动），向身体两侧举起哑铃，肘部微屈，双手略微前倾，如同往杯中倒水。继续上举，直到手臂与地面平行。执行该动作时呼气，并在顶部停顿一秒。
吸气时缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Side Laterals to Front Raise
instructions: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the weights directly in front of you to shoulder height, avoiding any swinging or cheating.
At the top of the exercise move the weights out in front of you, keeping your arms extended.
Lower the weights with a controlled motion.
On the next repetition, raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height before moving the weights laterally to your sides.
Lower the weights to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于身体两侧。这是起始姿势。
保持肘部微屈，将哑铃向正前方举至肩高，避免摆动或借力。
在动作顶端，将哑铃向前方移出，保持手臂伸直。
控制动作，将哑铃放下。
下一次重复时，先将哑铃在身前举至肩高，再将哑铃向身体两侧外展。
将哑铃放回起始位置。

document.name: Side Standing Long Jump
instructions: Begin standing with your feet hip width apart in an athletic stance. Your head and chest should be up, knees and hips slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Leaning to your right, extend through your hips, knees, and ankles to jump into the air. Block with the arms to lead the movement, jumping as far to your right as you can.
Land facing the same direction with your feet hip width apart, absorbing the impact through your lower body.
instructions_zh: 以运动站姿开始，双脚与髋同宽。头部和胸部抬起，膝和髋微屈。这是起始姿势。
向右侧倾斜，通过髋、膝和踝伸展发力跳向空中。双臂配合摆动引领动作，尽可能向右跳远。
面向同一方向落地，双脚与髋同宽，通过下肢缓冲吸收冲击。

document.name: Side To Side Chins
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip.
