instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand resting on top of your thigh. The palm of your hand with the dumbbell in it should be at a neutral grip.

By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbell up, clean the dumbbell so that you can hold it in front of you with your lifting arm being fully extended. Remember to maintain a neutral grip with this exercise. Your non lifting hand should be to the side holding the flat bench for better support. This will be your starting position.

Your arm with the weight should have a slight bend on your elbow in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon. Begin by lowering your arm with the weight in it out in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on your chest. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout the movement, your lifting arm should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the shoulder joint.
Return your lifting arm back to the starting position as you squeeze your chest muscles and breathe out. Tip: Make sure to use the same arc of motion used to lower the weights.
Hold for a second at the contracted position and repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，一只手握住哑铃置于大腿上方。持铃手掌应呈中立握（掌心相对）。
借助大腿把哑铃向上带起，将哑铃提至身前，持铃手臂完全伸直。记住本练习保持中立握。非持铃手应放在身体一侧抓住平凳以提供更好支撑。这是起始姿势。
持铃手臂肘部应略微弯曲，以避免肱二头肌腱受力。开始时，将持铃手臂沿宽弧线向外下方落下，直到胸部有拉伸感。执行动作这一部分时吸气。提示：记住整个动作过程中，持铃手臂应保持固定；动作只应发生在肩关节。
将持铃手臂回到起始位置，同时挤压胸肌并呼气。提示：确保沿与下放时相同的弧线运动。
在收缩位置停留一秒，并按规定次数重复动作。
换手臂重复练习。

document.name: One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand on top of your thigh.

By using your thigh to help you get the dumbbell up, clean the dumbbell up so that you can hold it in front of you at shoulder width. Use the hand you are not lifting with to help position the dumbbell over you properly.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrist forward so that the palm of your hand is facing away from you. This will be your starting position.

Bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbell at all times. Tip: Use the hand that you are not lifting with to help keep the dumbbell balance as you may struggle a bit at first. Only use your non-lifting hand if it is needed. Otherwise, keep it resting to the side.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上，一只手持哑铃置于大腿上方。
借助大腿将哑铃向上送到肩宽位置，使其能在身前握住。用未持铃的手帮助将哑铃摆放到身体正上方。
到达肩宽后，向前转腕，使掌心背向自己。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢将哑铃下放至身体一侧。始终完全控制哑铃。提示：初练时可能有些不稳，可用未持铃的手辅助保持哑铃平衡；仅在需要时使用，否则放在体侧休息。
呼气，用胸肌将哑铃向上推起。在收缩位置伸直手臂，挤压胸部，停留一秒，然后开始缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间应至少是上推时间的两倍。
按训练计划规定次数重复动作。
换手臂重复。

document.name: Back Flyes - With Bands
instructions: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack.
Grab the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises.

Extend and lift the arms straight in front of you. Tip: Your arms should be straight and parallel to the floor while perpendicular to your torso. Your feet should be firmly planted on the floor spread at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, move your arms to the sides and back. Keep your arms extended and parallel to the floor. Continue the movement until the arms are extended to your sides.
After a pause, go back to the original position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕过深蹲架等固定立柱。
握住弹力带把手，向后站远，使弹力带张力增加。
双臂伸直并抬至身体正前方。提示：手臂应伸直、与地面平行，并与躯干垂直。双脚与肩同宽，稳稳踩地。这是起始姿势。
呼气时，将双臂向两侧后方移动。保持手臂伸直并与地面平行。继续动作，直到双臂向两侧展开。
稍作停顿后，吸气回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Band Pull Apart
instructions: Begin with your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding the band with both hands.
Initiate the movement by performing a reverse fly motion, moving your hands out laterally to your sides.
Keep your elbows extended as you perform the movement, bringing the band to your chest. Ensure that you keep your shoulders back during the exercise.
Pause as you complete the movement, returning to the starting position under control.
instructions_zh: 双臂向前伸直，双手握住弹力带开始。
以反向飞鸟动作启动，双手向身体两侧横向打开。
动作过程中保持肘部伸直，将弹力带拉向胸前。确保肩膀始终向后收。
完成动作时稍作停顿，然后有控制地回到起始姿势。

document.name: External Rotation with Band
instructions: Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕在立柱上固定，弹力带应与肘部同高。身体左侧朝向弹力带站立，距离约几英尺。
用右手抓住弹力带末端，肘部紧贴身体侧面。建议用垫子或泡沫轴抵住肘部，使其保持固定位置。
上臂就位后，肘部应屈曲90度，手横过躯干前方。这将是起始姿势。
通过以反手动作旋转手臂来执行动作，保持肘部位置不变。
尽可能继续旋转，稍作停顿，然后回到起始姿势。

document.name: Internal Rotation with Band
instructions: Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your right side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching away from your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a forehand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕在立柱上并收紧固定。弹力带应与肘部同高。身体右侧朝向弹力带站立，距离约60厘米。
右手握住弹力带末端，肘部紧贴身体侧面。建议用肘部夹住垫子或泡沫轴，以保持肘部固定到位。
保持上臂位置不变，屈肘90度，手远离躯干。这是起始姿势。
保持肘部固定，以正手挥拍的方式旋转手臂来完成动作。
尽可能旋转到最大幅度，稍作停顿，然后回到起始姿势。

document.name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
instructions: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The handles should be resting on the sides of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.

Use your side shoulders to lift the handles to the sides as you exhale. Continue to lift the handles until they are slightly above parallel. Tip: As you lift the handles, slightly tilt the hand as if you were pouring water and keep your arms extended. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the handles back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 首先双脚踩住弹力带，使手臂伸直时弹力带开始产生张力。用正握（掌心朝向大腿）握住手柄，握距略窄于肩宽。手柄应置于大腿两侧。双臂伸直，肘部微屈，背部挺直。这是起始姿势。
呼气时用侧肩将手柄向两侧抬起，抬至略高于与地面平行的位置。提示：抬起手柄时，手部略微倾斜，如同倒水一样，并保持手臂伸直。同时保持躯干稳定，在动作顶端停顿一秒。
缓慢将手柄放回起始位置。完成这一阶段时吸气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Shoulder Press - With Bands
instructions: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles and lift them so that the hands are at shoulder height at each side.
Rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. Your elbows should be bent, with the upper arms and forearms in line to the torso. This is your starting position.
As you exhale, lift the handles up until your arms are fully extended overhead.
instructions_zh: 首先，双脚踩住弹力带，使张力从手臂完全伸展的姿势开始产生。握住把手并向上提起，让双手分别位于身体两侧、与肩同高。
转动手腕，使掌心朝前。肘部应保持弯曲，上臂和前臂与躯干对齐。这是起始姿势。
呼气时，向上推起把手，直到手臂在头顶完全伸直。

document.name: Front Squats With Two Kettlebells
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.

Looking straight ahead at all times, squat as low as you can and pause at the bottom. As you squat down, push your knees out. You should squat between your legs, keeping an upright torso, with your head and chest up.
Rise back up by driving through your heels and repeat.
instructions_zh: 将两只壶铃翻至肩部：伸展腿和髋，将壶铃拉向肩部，同时转动手腕。
始终目视前方，尽可能下蹲并在底部停顿。下蹲时膝盖向外推。应在两腿之间下蹲，保持躯干直立，头和胸抬起。
用脚跟发力起身，重复。

document.name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand holding a light kettlebell by the horns close to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Squat down between your legs until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your chest and head up and your back straight.
At the bottom position, pause and use your elbows to push your knees out. Return to the starting position, and repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手握住轻壶铃的把手两侧，将其靠近胸前。这是起始姿势。
在两腿之间下蹲，直到大腿后侧贴到小腿上。保持胸部和头部抬起，背部挺直。
在最低点稍作停顿，用肘部将膝盖向外推。回到起始姿势，重复10-20次。

document.name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell with two hands and hold it by the horns. Hold one leg off of the floor and squat down on the other.
Squat down by flexing the knee and sitting back with the hips, holding the kettlebell up in front of you.
Hold the bottom position for a second and then reverse the motion, driving through the heel and keeping your head and chest up.
Lower yourself again and repeat.
instructions_zh: 双手握住壶铃把手拿起壶铃。一条腿抬离地面，用另一条腿下蹲。
屈膝并向后坐髋下蹲，同时将壶铃保持在身前。
在最低点保持一秒，然后反向动作，通过脚跟发力起身，并保持头部和胸部抬起。
再次下蹲并重复。

document.name: One-Arm Overhead Kettlebell Squats
instructions: Clean and press a kettlebell with one arm. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so. Press the weight overhead by extending through the elbow.This will be your starting position.
Looking straight ahead and keeping a kettlebell locked out above you, flex the knees and hips and lower your torso between your legs, keeping your head and chest up.
Pause at the bottom position for a second before rising back to the top, driving through the heels of your feet.
instructions_zh: 用单臂完成壶铃翻站和推举。通过伸展腿部和髋部，将壶铃拉向肩部完成翻站，同时转动手腕。通过伸展肘部将重量推举过头顶。这是起始姿势。
目视前方，保持壶铃锁定在头顶上方，屈膝屈髋，将躯干下蹲至双腿之间，保持头部和胸部抬起。
在底部停顿一秒，然后通过脚跟发力回到顶部。

document.name: Calf Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.
instructions_zh: 调整座椅，使起始时双腿仅轻微弯曲。前脚掌应稳稳踩在踏板上。
选择合适重量，并握住把手。这是起始姿势。
通过伸展膝关节伸直双腿，仅将重量从配重堆上稍微抬起。踝关节应完全屈曲，脚尖向上。随后通过前脚掌尽可能向下踩来完成动作。
短暂停顿后，反向运动并重复。

document.name: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance.

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you without locking your knees. (Note: In some leg press units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your leg press unit allows for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the legs should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place your toes and balls of your feet on the lower portion of the platform with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Press on the platform by raising your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 使用腿举机，坐下后将双腿以中等（与肩同宽）站距放在正前方的踏板上。
放下固定负重踏板的保险杆，并将踏板一直推起，直到双腿在身前完全伸直，但不要锁死膝盖。（注：部分腿举机可保留保险杆以增加安全性；如果你的器械允许，建议采用这种方式。）躯干与双腿应成标准90度角。然后小心地将脚尖和前脚掌放在踏板下缘，脚跟悬空。脚尖可朝前、朝外或朝内，如本章开头所述。这是起始姿势。
呼气，通过尽可能高地伸展踝关节并收缩小腿，以抬起脚跟的方式踩压踏板。确保膝盖始终固定不动，任何时候都不应弯曲。保持收缩姿势1秒后再开始下放。
吸气，缓慢回到起始位置，放下脚跟并屈曲踝关节，直到小腿被拉伸。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the machine and place your toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off. Choose the toe positioning of your choice (forward, in, or out) as per the beginning of this chapter.

Place your lower thighs under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of your thighs. Now place your hands on top of the lever pad in order to prevent it from slipping forward.
Lift the lever slightly by pushing your heels up and release the safety bar. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower your heels by bending at the ankles until the calves are fully stretched. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Raise the heels by extending the ankles as high as possible as you contract the calves and breathe out. Hold the top contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在器械上，将脚趾放在踏板下缘，脚跟悬空。按本章开头所述选择脚趾朝向（朝前、朝内或朝外）。
将大腿下段置于杠杆垫下方，杠杆垫需根据大腿高度调整。然后将双手放在杠杆垫上方，防止其向前滑动。
脚跟向上推，将杠杆稍微抬起并松开安全杆。这是起始位置。
踝关节弯曲，缓慢下放脚跟，直到小腿完全拉伸。做此动作时吸气。
收缩小腿并呼气，尽可能高地伸展踝关节抬起脚跟。在顶部收缩处保持1秒。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Place a block or weight plate below the bar on the Smith machine. Set the bar to a position that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step onto the plates with the balls of your feet and place the bar on the back of your shoulders.
Take the bar with both hands facing forward. Rotate the bar to unrack it. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing off of the balls of your feet, flexing your calf at the top of the contraction. Your knees should remain extended. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Return slowly to the starting position as you breathe in while lowering your heels.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 在史密斯机杠铃杆下方放置木块或杠铃片。将杆调到最适合你身高的位置。选定高度并加载重量后，以前脚掌踩在杠铃片上，将杆置于肩后。
双手朝前握住杠铃杆。旋转杠铃杆将其从架上解锁。这是起始姿势。
以前脚掌发力，尽量抬高脚跟，在收缩顶点收紧小腿。膝盖应保持伸直。保持收缩位一秒后开始下放。
吸气，缓慢降下脚跟回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raises
instructions: Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to fit your height and align a raised platform right under the bar.
Stand on the platform with the heels of your feet secured on top of it with the balls of your feet extending off it. Position your toes facing forward with a shoulder width stance.

Now, place your shoulders under the barbell while maintaining the foot positioning described and push the barbell up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: The barbell on your back is only for balance purposes.

Raise the balls of your feet as you breathe out by extending your toes as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering the balls of your feet and toes.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将史密斯机杠铃调整到适合你的高度，并在杠铃正下方对齐一个抬高的平台。
站在平台上，脚跟固定在平台上方，前脚掌伸出平台边缘。脚尖朝前，采用与肩同宽的站距。
现在，在保持上述脚部位置的同时，将肩部置于杠铃下方，通过伸展髋部和膝盖将杠铃向上顶起，直到躯干直立。膝盖应保持微屈，绝不能锁死。这是起始姿势。提示：背上的杠铃仅用于保持平衡。
呼气时，尽可能伸展脚趾并收缩小腿，抬起前脚掌。确保膝盖始终固定不动，任何时候都不应弯曲。在收缩位置保持一秒，然后开始下放。
吸气时，缓慢下放前脚掌和脚趾，回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Adjust the padded lever of the calf raise machine to fit your height.

Place your shoulders under the pads provided and position your toes facing forward (or using any of the two other positions described at the beginning of the chapter). The balls of your feet should be secured on top of the calf block with the heels extending off it. Push the lever up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 调整提踵机的带垫杠杆以适合你的身高。
将肩膀置于提供的垫下，脚尖朝前（或采用本章开头描述的另外两种位置之一）。前脚掌应稳稳踩在提踵台上，脚跟悬空。通过伸髋伸膝将杠杆向上推，直到躯干直立。膝盖应保持微屈，切勿锁死。脚尖按本章开头所述朝前、朝外或朝内。这是起始姿势。
呼气时踮起脚跟，通过尽可能高地伸踝并收缩小腿。确保膝盖始终固定不动，任何时候都不应弯曲。在收缩位保持一秒，然后开始下放。
吸气时缓慢回到起始姿势，通过屈踝放低脚跟，直到小腿有拉伸感。
按建议次数重复。

query: 不做普通俯卧撑，换个徒手胸部动作

document.name: Clock Push-Up
instructions: Move into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and toes.
Your arms should be fully extended with the hands around shoulder width. Keep your body straight throughout the movement. This will be your starting position.
Descend by flexing at the elbow, lowering your chest toward the ground.
At the bottom, reverse the motion by pushing yourself up through elbow extension as quickly as possible until you are air borne. Aim to "jump" 12-18 inches to one side.
As you accelerate up, move your outside foot away from your direction of travel. Leaving the ground, shift your body about 30 degrees for the next repetition.
Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise, working all the way around until you are back where you started.
instructions_zh: 俯卧于地面，用手和脚趾支撑体重。
双臂完全伸直，双手约与肩同宽。整个动作过程中保持身体笔直。这是起始姿势。
屈肘下降，将胸部朝地面降低。
在底部反向运动，尽快通过伸肘将自己推起直到腾空。目标是向一侧跳出12–18英寸（约30–45厘米）。
加速向上时，将外侧脚向移动方向的反方向移开。离地时，将身体转动约30度，为下一次重复做准备。
回到起始姿势并重复练习，沿一圈方向进行，直到回到起点。

document.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform. Place hands on edge of bench or platform, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Position forefoot back from bench or platform with arms and body straight. Arms should be perpendicular to body. Keeping body straight, lower chest to edge of box or platform by bending arms.
Push body up until arms are extended. Repeat.
instructions_zh: 面向长凳或稳固的高台站立。将双手放在长凳或平台边缘，略宽于肩宽。
将前脚掌向后移动，手臂和身体保持伸直。手臂应垂直于身体。保持身体挺直，屈臂将胸部下降至箱子或平台边缘。
将身体向上推起，直到手臂伸直。重复。

document.name: Incline Push-Up Medium
instructions: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height.
Place your hands on the bar, with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Position your feet back from the bar with arms and body straight. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your body straight, lower your chest to the bar by bending the arms.
Return to the starting position by extending the elbows, pressing yourself back up.
instructions_zh: 面向高度合适的史密斯机横杆或稳固的高台站立。
双手放在横杆上，间距约与肩同宽。
双脚向后移动远离横杆，手臂和身体保持伸直。这是起始姿势。
保持身体挺直，屈臂将胸部下放至横杆。
伸肘将自己推回起始姿势。

document.name: Incline Push-Up Reverse Grip
instructions: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height.
Place your hands on the bar palms up, with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Position your feet back from the bar with arms and body straight. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your body straight, lower your chest to the bar by bending the arms.
Return to the starting position by extending the elbows, pressing yourself back up.
instructions_zh: 面向高度合适的史密斯机横杆或稳固的高台站立。
双手掌心朝上放在横杆上，间距约与肩同宽。
双脚向后移动远离横杆，手臂和身体保持伸直。这是起始姿势。
保持身体挺直，屈臂将胸部下放至横杆。
伸肘将自己推回起始姿势。

document.name: Incline Push-Up Wide
instructions: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height.
Place your hands on the bar, with your hands wider than shoulder width.
Position your feet back from the bar with arms and body straight. Your arms should be perpendicular to the body. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your body straight, lower your chest to the bar by bending the arms.
Return to the starting position by extending the elbows, pressing yourself back up.
instructions_zh: 面向高度合适的史密斯机横杆或稳固的高台站立。
双手放在横杆上，间距宽于肩宽。
双脚向后移动远离横杆，手臂和身体保持伸直。手臂应垂直于身体。这是起始姿势。
保持身体挺直，屈臂将胸部下放至横杆。
伸肘将自己推回起始姿势。

document.name: Isometric Chest Squeezes
instructions: While either seating or standing, bend your arms at a 90-degree angle and place the palms of your hands together in front of your chest. Tip: Your hands should be open with the palms together and fingers facing forward (perpendicular to your torso).
Push both hands against each other as you contract your chest. Start with slow tension and increase slowly. Keep breathing normally as you execute this contraction.
Hold for the recommended number of seconds.
Now release the tension slowly.
Rest for the recommended amount of time and repeat.
instructions_zh: 坐姿或站姿均可，屈肘呈90度，双手掌心在胸前合拢。提示：双手应张开、掌心相贴，手指朝前（与躯干垂直）。
双手相互用力推压，同时收缩胸部。从缓慢发力开始，逐渐增加力量。执行该收缩时保持正常呼吸。
保持推荐秒数。
现在缓慢释放张力。
休息推荐时间后重复。

document.name: Isometric Wipers
instructions: Assume a push-up position, supporting your weight on your hands and toes while keeping your body straight. Your hands should be just outside of shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Begin by shifting your body weight as far to one side as possible, allowing the elbow on that side to flex as you lower your body.
Reverse the motion by extending the flexed arm, pushing yourself up and then dropping to the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 采取俯卧撑姿势，用手和脚趾支撑体重，同时保持身体笔直。双手应略宽于肩宽。这将是你的起始姿势。
开始将体重尽可能移向一侧，同时让该侧肘部弯曲，使身体下降。
通过伸展弯曲的手臂反向运动，将自己推起，然后倒向另一侧。
按所需次数重复。

document.name: Plyo Push-up
instructions: Move into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and toes.
Your arms should be fully extended with the hands around shoulder width. Keep your body straight throughout the movement. This will be your starting position.
Descend by flexing at the elbow, lowering your chest towards the ground.
At the bottom, reverse the motion by pushing yourself up through elbow extension as quickly as possible. Attempt to push your upper body up until your hands leave the ground.
Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
For added difficulty, add claps into the movement while you are air borne.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在地面上，用手和脚尖支撑体重。
手臂完全伸直，双手约与肩同宽。整个动作过程中保持身体挺直。这是起始姿势。
屈肘下降，将胸部向地面降低。
在最低点，尽快通过伸肘将自己推起以反向动作。尽量将上半身推起，直到双手离开地面。
回到起始姿势并重复练习。
若要增加难度，可在腾空时加入击掌。

document.name: Push-Up Wide
instructions: With your hands wide apart, support your body on your toes and hands in a plank position. Your elbows should be extended and your body straight. Do not allow your hips to sag. This will be your starting position.
To begin, allow the elbows to flex, lowering your chest to the floor as you inhale.
Using your pectoral muscles, press your upper body back up to the starting position by extending the elbows. Exhale as you perform this step.
After pausing at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手大幅分开，以脚尖和双手支撑身体呈平板姿势。肘部伸直，身体保持笔直。不要让髋部下沉。这是起始姿势。
开始时，让肘部弯曲，吸气的同时将胸部下放至地面。
使用胸肌，通过伸直肘部将上半身推回起始姿势。做这一步时呼气。
在收缩位置稍作停顿后，按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Push-Ups With Feet Elevated
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart from each other holding your torso up at arms length.
Place your toes on top of a flat bench. This will allow your body to be elevated. Note: The higher the elevation of the flat bench, the higher the resistance of the exercise is.
Lower yourself until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.
Using your pectoral muscles, press your upper body back up to the starting position and squeeze your chest. Breathe out as you perform this step.
After a second pause at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 俯卧地面，双手间距约36英寸（约91厘米），双臂伸直将躯干撑起。
将脚尖放在平凳上，使身体抬高。注意：平凳越高，动作阻力越大。
吸气，下降至胸部几乎触地。
使用胸肌将上身推回起始位置并挤压胸部，此步骤呼气。
在收缩位置停顿一秒后，按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Push Up to Side Plank
instructions: Get into pushup position on the toes with your hands just outside of shoulder width.
Perform a pushup by allowing the elbows to flex. As you descend, keep your body straight.
Do one pushup and as you come up, shift your weight on the left side of the body, twist to the side while bringing the right arm up towards the ceiling in a side plank.
Lower the arm back to the floor for another pushup and then twist to the other side.
Repeat the series, alternating each side, for 10 or more reps.
instructions_zh: 进入俯卧撑姿势，脚尖撑地，双手略宽于肩。
做俯卧撑，允许肘部弯曲。下降时保持身体挺直。
做一个俯卧撑，起身时将重心移到身体左侧，向侧面转体，同时将右臂向上举向天花板，进入侧平板支撑。
将手臂放回地面，再做一次俯卧撑，然后转向另一侧。
重复该组合，左右交替，做10次或更多。

document.name: Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions)
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and body straight with your toes on the floor and the hands wider than shoulder width for a wide hand position and closer than shoulder width for a close hand position. Make sure you are holding your torso up at arms length.
Lower yourself until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.
Using your pectoral muscles, press your upper body back up to the starting position and squeeze your chest. Breathe out as you perform this step.
After a second pause at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
document.name_zh: 俯卧撑（窄距和宽距手位）
instructions_zh: 俯卧地面，身体挺直，脚尖撑地；宽手位时双手宽于肩，窄手位时双手窄于肩。确保双臂伸直将躯干撑起。
吸气，下降至胸部几乎触地。
使用胸肌将上身推回起始位置并挤压胸部，此步骤呼气。
在收缩位置停顿一秒后，按规定次数重复该动作。

document.name: Single-Arm Push-Up
instructions: Begin laying prone on the ground. Move yourself into a position supporting your weight on your toes and one arm. Your working arm should be placed directly under the shoulder, fully extended. Your legs should be extended, and for this movement you may need a wider base, placing your feet further apart than in a normal push-up.
Maintain good posture, and place your free hand behind your back. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by allowing the elbow to flex until you touch the ground.
Descend slowly, and reverse direction be extending the arm to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 先俯卧在地。将身体撑起，用脚趾和一只手臂支撑体重。发力臂应位于肩部正下方并完全伸直。双腿伸直；此动作可能需要更宽的支撑面，双脚间距比普通俯卧撑更宽。
保持良好姿势，将非支撑手放在背后。这是起始姿势。
屈肘降低身体，直到接触地面。
缓慢下放，然后反向伸臂回到起始位置。

document.name: 90/90 Hamstring
instructions: Lie on your back, with one leg extended straight out.
With the other leg, bend the hip and knee to 90 degrees. You may brace your leg with your hands if necessary. This will be your starting position.
Extend your leg straight into the air, pausing briefly at the top. Return the leg to the starting position.
Repeat for 10-20 repetitions, and then switch to the other leg.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，一条腿伸直。
另一条腿屈髋屈膝至90度，必要时可用手扶住腿。这是起始姿势。
将腿向空中伸直，在顶端稍作停顿，然后回到起始姿势。
重复10-20次，然后换另一条腿。

document.name: Chair Leg Extended Stretch
instructions: Sit upright in a chair and grip the seat on the sides.
Raise one leg, extending the knee, flexing the ankle as you do so.
Slowly move that leg outward as far as you can, and then back to the center and down.
Repeat for your other leg.
instructions_zh: 坐直在椅子上，双手抓住座椅两侧。
抬起一条腿，伸直膝盖，同时勾脚屈踝。
缓慢将腿向外侧移到最大幅度，然后回到中间并放下。
换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Hamstring-SMR
instructions: In a seated position, extend your legs over a foam roll so that it is position on the back of the upper legs. Place your hands to the side or behind you to help support your weight. This will be your starting position.
Using your hands, lift your hips off of the floor and shift your weight on the foam roll to one leg. Relax the hamstrings of the leg you are stretching.
Roll over the foam from below the hip to above the back of the knee, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for the other leg.
document.name_zh: 腘绳肌自我肌筋膜放松
instructions_zh: 坐姿，将双腿伸在泡沫轴上，使泡沫轴位于大腿后侧。双手放在身体两侧或身后以帮助支撑体重。这是起始姿势。
用双手将臀部抬离地面，将重心移到泡沫轴上并偏向一条腿。放松正在拉伸的那条腿的腘绳肌。
从髋部下方到膝后上方在泡沫轴上滚动，在紧张点停顿10-30秒。另一条腿重复。

document.name: Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended above you, with the hip at ninety degrees. Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Loop a belt, band, or rope over the ball of your foot. This will be your starting position.
Pull on the belt to create tension in the calves and hamstrings. Hold this stretch for 10-30 seconds, and repeat with the other leg.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，一条腿向上伸直，髋部成90度。另一条腿平放于地面。
将腰带、弹力带或绳子套在脚掌前部。这是起始姿势。
拉腰带以在小腿和腘绳肌产生张力。保持拉伸10-30秒，换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand with your feet close together. Keeping your legs straight, stretch down and put your hands on the floor directly in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Begin by walking your hands forward slowly, alternating your left and your right. As you do so, bend only at the hip, keeping your legs straight.
Keep going until your body is parallel to the ground in a pushup position.
Now, keep your hands in place and slowly take short steps with your feet, moving only a few inches at a time.
Continue walking until your feet are by hour hands, keeping your legs straight as you do so.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立。保持双腿伸直，向下俯身，将双手放在正前方地面。这是起始姿势。
开始双手缓慢向前爬行，左右手交替。过程中只在髋部弯曲，保持双腿伸直。
继续向前，直到身体呈与地面平行的俯卧撑姿势。
现在双手固定不动，双脚缓慢小步向前移动，每次只移动几英寸。
继续向前走，直到双脚来到双手旁边，过程中保持双腿伸直。

document.name: Intermediate Groin Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg as far to the side as you can. This will be your starting position.
Pull gently on the belt to create tension in your groin and hamstring muscles. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and repeat on the other side.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直。将腰带、绳子或弹力带套在一只脚上，并将该腿尽可能向侧方打开。这是起始姿势。
轻拉腰带，使腹股沟和大腿后侧肌群产生牵拉感。保持10-20秒，然后换另一侧重复。

document.name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie flat on your back, bend one knee, and put that foot flat on the floor to stabilize your spine.

Extend the other leg in the air. If you're tight, you wont be able to straighten it. That's okay. Extend the knee so that the sole of the lifted foot faces the ceiling (or as close as you can get it).
Slowly straighten the legs as much as possible and then pull the leg toward your nose. Switch sides.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈曲一侧膝盖，将该脚平放在地面上以稳定脊柱。
将另一条腿向上抬起伸展。如果柔韧性不足，可能无法伸直，这没关系。伸直膝盖，使抬起脚的脚底朝向天花板（或尽可能接近）。
尽可能缓慢伸直腿部，然后将抬起的腿拉向鼻子方向。换侧。

document.name: Lying Hamstring
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Your partner should be kneeling beside you. Raise one leg up towards the ceiling and have your partner hold the ankle. Your partner can use their shoulder to brace your leg if necessary. This will be your starting position.
With your partner holding your leg in place, attempt to flex the knee, contracting the hamstrings for 10-20 seconds.

Then relax your leg, allowing your partner to gently push the leg towards your head. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching. Switch sides once complete.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直，搭档跪在身旁。抬起一条腿朝向天花板，让搭档握住脚踝。必要时搭档可用肩部抵住你的腿。这是起始姿势。
搭档固定腿后，尝试屈膝，收紧腘绳肌10-20秒。
然后放松腿，让搭档轻轻将腿推向头部。拉伸感合适时务必告知搭档，以防受伤或过度拉伸。完成后换边。

document.name: Runner's Stretch
instructions: It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start standing up, put one leg behind you, and slowly lower your torso down to the floor.
Keep the front heel on the floor (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).

Place your hands on either side of your front leg. To get more out of this stretch, push your butt up toward the ceiling, and then gradually lower it back toward the floor. You'll Stretch the hip flexor of the back leg and the hamstring and buttocks of the front.
instructions_zh: 最容易进入这个拉伸的方法是先站立，将一条腿放在身后，然后慢慢将躯干向地面下压。
保持前脚脚跟在地面上（如果它抬起，就把另一条腿再往后挪）。
将双手放在前腿两侧。要从这个拉伸中获得更多效果，将臀部向天花板方向推，然后逐渐放低回地面。你会拉伸后腿的髋屈肌以及前腿的腘绳肌和臀部。

document.name: Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit on a mat with your right leg extended in front of you and your left leg bent with your foot against your right inner thigh.
Lean forward from your hips and reach for your ankle until you feel a stretch in your hamstring. Hold for 15 seconds, then repeat for your other side.
instructions_zh: 坐在垫子上，右腿向前伸直，左腿弯曲，左脚脚掌抵住右大腿内侧。
从髋部向前倾，伸手去够右脚踝，直到感到腘绳肌有拉伸感。保持15秒，然后换另一侧重复。

document.name: Seated Hamstring
instructions: In a seated position with your legs extended, have your partner stand behind you. Now, lean forward as your partner braces your shoulders with their hands. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to push your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.
Now relax your muscles as your partner increases the stretch by gently pushing your torso forward for 10-20 seconds.
aliases_zh: 同伴辅助坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_zh: 坐姿，双腿伸直，同伴站在你身后。现在，身体前倾，同伴用双手扶住你的肩膀。这是起始姿势。
尝试将躯干向后推10-20秒，同伴阻止躯干实际移动。
现在放松肌肉，同伴通过轻轻将你的躯干向前推来增加拉伸，保持10-20秒。

document.name: Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch
instructions: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. Sit down with both legs extended . This will be your starting position.
Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of your foot back. Hold this position for 10-20 seconds and then repeat with the other leg.
document.name_zh: 坐姿腘绳肌与小腿拉伸
aliases_zh: 坐姿腿后侧和小腿拉伸
instructions_zh: 将腰带、绳子或弹力带套在一只脚上。坐下，双腿伸直，这将是你的起始姿势。
稍微向前倾，拉带子使脚尖向回勾。保持10-20秒，然后换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch
instructions: Being by looping a belt, band, or rope around one foot. While standing, place that foot forward.
Bend your back leg, while keeping the front one straight. Now raise the toes of your front foot off of the ground and lean forward.
Using the belt, pull on the top of the foot to increase the stretch in the calf. Hold for 10-20 seconds and repeat with the other foot.
document.name_zh: 站姿腘绳肌与小腿拉伸
instructions_zh: 先用腰带、弹力带或绳子套住一只脚。站立时，将该脚向前放置。
弯曲后腿，同时保持前腿伸直。然后将前脚脚趾抬离地面，身体前倾。
用带子拉住脚背以增强小腿拉伸。保持10-20秒，然后换另一只脚重复。

document.name: Standing Toe Touches
instructions: Stand with some space in front and behind you.
Bend at the waist, keeping your legs straight, until you can relax and let your upper body hang down in front of you. Let your arms and hands hang down naturally. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
instructions_zh: 站立，身前和身后留出一些空间。
保持双腿伸直，从腰部向前屈身，直到能够放松并让上半身自然下垂在身前。让双臂和双手自然下垂。保持10至20秒。

document.name: The Straddle
instructions: Begin in a seated, upright position. Start by extending your legs in front of you in a V.
With your hands on the floor, lean forward as far as possible. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
instructions_zh: 以坐姿、身体直立开始。先将双腿向前伸展成V形。
双手放在地面上，尽量向前俯身。保持10至20秒。

document.name: Upper Back-Leg Grab
instructions: While seated, bend forward to hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.
Keep your knees together and your legs extended out as you bring your chest down to your knees. You can also stretch your middle back by pulling your back away from your knees as your hugging them.
instructions_zh: 坐姿，向前屈身，用双臂从下方抱住大腿。
保持双膝并拢、双腿伸直，同时将胸部下压向膝盖。抱腿时也可将背部远离膝盖以拉伸中背部。

document.name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your front foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your back foot. With your knees bent, squat down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds.

Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. Your other hand should be placed on the ground, parallel to your lead leg, to help support you during this portion of the stretch.

After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either side of your front foot. Raise the toes of the front foot off of the ground, and straighten your leg. You may need to reposition your rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other side.
instructions_zh: 这是一个由三部分组成的拉伸。先向前弓步，前脚全脚掌着地，后脚以脚尖支撑。双膝弯曲下蹲，直到膝盖几乎触地。保持躯干直立，保持该姿势10-20秒。
然后，将与前腿同侧的手臂放在地上，肘部靠近前脚。另一只手放在地上，与前方腿平行，以帮助在此阶段支撑身体。
10-20秒后，将双手放在前脚两侧。将前脚脚趾抬离地面，并伸直前腿。你可能需要调整后腿位置。保持10-20秒，然后换另一侧重复整个序列。

document.name: Ankle Circles
instructions: Use a sturdy object like a squat rack to hold yourself.

Lift the right leg in the air (just around 2 inches from the floor) and perform a circular motion with the big toe. Pretend that you are drawing a big circle with it. Tip: One circle equals 1 repetition. Breathe normally as you perform the movement.
When you are done with the right foot, then repeat with the left leg.
instructions_zh: 使用深蹲架等稳固物体支撑自己。
抬起右腿（距地面约2英寸），用大脚趾做绕圈动作，想象用大脚趾画一个大圆。提示：一圈算1次重复。动作过程中正常呼吸。
右脚完成后，换左腿重复。

document.name: Anterior Tibialis-SMR
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with your legs bent and your feet on the floor.

Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to the muscles on the outside of your shins. Work from just below the knee to above the ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other leg.
document.name_zh: 胫骨前肌自我肌筋膜放松
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，屈膝，双脚踩地。
使用泡沫轴或擀面杖，对小腿前外侧肌群施加压力。从膝盖下方到脚踝上方来回滚动，在紧张点停留10-30秒。换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Calf Stretch Elbows Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall from a couple feet away.
Lean against the wall, placing your weight on your forearms.
Attempt to keep your heels on the ground. Hold for 10-20 seconds. You may move further or closer the wall, making it more or less difficult, respectively.
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，距离墙约几英尺。
身体前倾靠墙，将体重放在前臂上。
尽量保持脚跟贴地。保持10-20秒。你可以将脚离墙更远或更近来分别增加或降低难度。

document.name: Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall from several feet away. Stagger your stance, placing one foot forward.
Lean forward and rest your hands on the wall, keeping your heel, hip and head in a straight line.
Attempt to keep your heel on the ground. Hold for 10-20 seconds and then switch sides.
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，距离墙数英尺。采用前后错步站姿，一只脚在前。
身体前倾，双手扶墙，保持脚跟、髋部和头部成一直线。
尽量保持脚跟贴地。保持10-20秒，然后换另一侧。

document.name: Calves-SMR
instructions: Begin seated on the floor. Place a foam roller underneath your lower leg. Your other leg can either be crossed over the opposite or be placed on the floor, supporting some of your weight. This will be your starting position.

Place your hands to your side or just behind you, and press down to raise your hips off of the floor, placing much of your weight against your calf muscle. Roll from below the knee to above the ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for the other leg.
instructions_zh: 先坐在地面上，将泡沫轴垫在小腿下方。另一条腿可以交叉叠在对侧腿上，也可以放在地面上支撑部分体重。这是起始姿势。
双手放在身体两侧或稍靠身后，向下按压把臀部抬离地面，将大部分体重压在小腿肌肉上。从膝盖下方一直滚到脚踝上方，在紧张酸痛处停留10-30秒。换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Foot-SMR
instructions: This exercise stretches the fascia of the muscles in the feet. Start off seated with your shoes removed. Using a foot roller or a similar object, such as a small section of pvc pipe, place your foot against the roller across the arch of your foot. This will be your starting position.
Press down firmly, rolling across the arch of your foot. Hold for 10-30 seconds, and then switch feet.
instructions_zh: 此练习可拉伸足部肌肉的筋膜。先坐下并脱鞋。使用足底滚轴或类似物体（如一小段PVC管），将脚掌足弓部位压在滚轴上。这将是起始姿势。
用力下压，沿足弓来回滚动。保持10-30秒，然后换脚。

document.name: Knee Circles
instructions: Stand with your legs together and hands by your waist.
Now move your knees in a circular motion as you breathe normally.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立，双手放在腰侧。
正常呼吸，双膝做绕环运动。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Peroneals-SMR
instructions: Lay on your side, supporting your weight on your forearm and on a foam roller placed on the outside of your lower leg. Your upper leg can either be on top of your lower leg, or you can cross it in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Raise your hips off of the ground and begin to roll from below the knee to above the ankle on the side of your leg, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other leg.
instructions_zh: 侧卧，用前臂和放在小腿外侧的泡沫轴支撑身体。上侧腿可叠放在下侧腿上，也可交叉放在身前。这是起始位置。
将髋部抬离地面，沿小腿外侧从膝下滚至踝上，在紧张点停留10-30秒。换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Peroneals Stretch
instructions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be your starting position.

With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is inverted, with the inside of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch sides.
instructions_zh: 坐姿，将腰带、绳子或弹力带套在一只脚上。这是起始位置。
腿伸直且脚跟离地，拉动带子使足部内翻，将脚内侧拉向自己。保持10-20秒，然后换边。

document.name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
instructions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be your starting position.

With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is everted, with the outside of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch sides.
instructions_zh: 坐姿，将皮带、绳子或弹力带套在一只脚上。这是起始姿势。
保持腿伸直、脚跟离地，拉动带子使脚外翻，将脚外侧拉向自己。保持10-20秒，然后换边。

document.name: Seated Calf Stretch
instructions: Sit up straight on an exercise mat.
Bend one knee and put that foot on the floor to stabilize the torso.
Straighten your other leg and flex your ankle.
Using a band, towel, or your hand if you can reach, pull the toes toward you. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.
instructions_zh: 在瑜伽垫上坐直。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将该脚踩在地面上以稳定躯干。
伸直另一条腿，并勾起脚踝。
使用弹力带、毛巾，或如果能够到就用手，将脚趾拉向自己。保持10至20秒，然后换侧。

document.name: Standing Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch
instructions: Place your right heel on a step with your knee extended and lean forward to grab your right toe with your right hand. Your left knee should be slightly bent and your back should be straight.
Support your weight on your left leg and place your left hand on your left thigh.
Pull your right toes toward your knee until you feel a stretch in your calf.
instructions_zh: 将右脚跟放在台阶上，膝盖伸直，身体前倾，用右手抓住右脚趾。左膝应微屈，背部保持挺直。
将体重支撑在左腿上，左手放在左大腿上。
将右脚趾向膝盖方向拉，直到感觉小腿有拉伸感。

document.name: Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other.
Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor. Switch sides.
document.name_zh: 站姿比目鱼肌和跟腱拉伸
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，一只脚稍微向前。
弯曲双膝，保持后脚跟贴地。换边重复。

document.name: Bicycling, Stationary
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.

Select the desired option from the menu. You may have to start pedaling to turn it on. You can use the manual setting, or you can select a program to use. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. The level of resistance can be changed throughout the workout. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.
instructions_zh: 首先，坐在自行车上并根据身高调整座垫高度。
从菜单中选择所需模式。可能需要开始踩踏板才能开启。可使用手动设置，也可选择程序。通常可输入年龄和体重以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。整个锻炼过程中可调整阻力等级。握把可用于监测心率，帮助保持适当强度。

document.name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: To begin, step onto the elliptical and select the desired option from the menu. Most ellipticals have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.
The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.
instructions_zh: 开始前，踏上椭圆机，并从菜单中选择所需模式。大多数椭圆机有手动设置，也可以选择程序运行。通常可以输入年龄和体重来估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。可调节坡度以改变训练强度。
可以使用扶手监测心率，帮助保持适当强度。

document.name: Jogging, Treadmill
instructions: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than jogging outside. A 150 lb person will burn almost 250 calories jogging for 30 minutes, compared to more than 450 calories running. Maintain proper posture as you jog, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上跑步机，从菜单中选择所需选项。大多数跑步机都有手动模式，也可以选择程序进行跑步。通常可以输入年龄和体重，以估算运动过程中消耗的卡路里。可通过调节坡度来改变训练强度。
跑步机方便、有益心血管，而且通常比户外慢跑对关节的冲击更小。体重150磅的人慢跑30分钟约消耗250卡路里，而跑步则超过450卡路里。慢跑时保持正确姿势，只有在必要时（如下跑步机或检查心率时）才握住扶手。

document.name: Recumbent Bike
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.

Select the desired option from the menu. You may have to start pedaling to turn it on. You can use the manual setting, or you can select a program to use. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. The level of resistance can be changed throughout the workout. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Recumbent bikes offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and have less impact than other activities. A 150 lb person will burn about 230 calories cycling at a moderate rate for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories or more running.
instructions_zh: 首先，坐上健身车并根据身高调节座椅。
从菜单中选择所需模式。可能需要开始踩踏才能开机。可使用手动模式，也可选择程序。通常可输入年龄和体重来估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。整个锻炼过程中可调节阻力级别。扶手可用于监测心率，帮助保持合适强度。
卧式健身车方便、有益心血管，且冲击比其它活动小。体重150磅的人以中等速度骑行30分钟约消耗230卡路里，而跑步可消耗450卡路里或更多。

document.name: Rowing, Stationary
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on the rower. Make sure that your heels are resting comfortably against the base of the foot pedals and that the straps are secured. Select the program that you wish to use, if applicable. Sit up straight and bend forward at the hips.

There are three phases of movement when using a rower. The first phase is when you come forward on the rower. Your knees are bent and against your chest. Your upper body is leaning slightly forward while still maintaining good posture. Next, push against the foot pedals and extend your legs while bringing your hands to your upper abdominal area, squeezing your shoulders back as you do so. To avoid straining your back, use primarily your leg and hip muscles.
The recovery phase simply involves straightening your arms, bending the knees, and bringing your body forward again as you transition back into the first phase.
instructions_zh: 开始时，坐在划船机上。确保脚跟舒适地抵住脚踏板底部，并系紧绑带。如适用，选择你想使用的程序。坐直，在髋部前屈。
使用划船机时动作分为三个阶段。第一阶段是向前回到划船机前方。双膝弯曲并贴近胸部。上身略前倾，同时保持良好姿态。接下来，蹬踏脚踏板并伸展双腿，同时将双手拉向上腹部，并在过程中向后收肩。为避免背部拉伤，主要使用腿部和髋部肌肉。
恢复阶段就是伸直手臂、弯曲膝盖，并在过渡回第一阶段时再次将身体向前带。

document.name: Running, Treadmill
instructions: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. A 150 lb person will burn over 450 calories running 8 miles per hour for 30 minutes. Maintain proper posture as you run, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上跑步机并从菜单中选择所需选项。大多数跑步机都有手动设置，或者你可以选择程序进行跑步。通常，你可以输入年龄和体重来估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。可以调节坡度来改变训练强度。
跑步机提供便利、心血管益处，而且通常比户外跑步冲击更小。一个150磅的人以每小时8英里的速度跑30分钟将消耗超过450卡路里。跑步时保持正确姿势，只在必要时握住扶手，例如下跑步机或检查心率时。

document.name: Stairmaster
instructions: To begin, step onto the stairmaster and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

Pump your legs up and down in an established rhythm, driving the pedals down but not all the way to the floor. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Stairmasters offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上楼梯机，从菜单中选择所需选项。可选择手动模式，也可选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重，以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。
双腿以稳定节奏上下踩踏，向下驱动踏板，但不要一直踩到底。建议始终握住扶手，以免摔倒。扶手可用于监测心率，帮助你保持合适强度。
楼梯机使用方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小。它们通常比其他有氧器械更费力。体重150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Step Mill
instructions: To begin, step onto the stepmill and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Use caution so that you don't trip as you climb the stairs. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall.

Stepmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside while offering a similar rate of calories burned. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上台阶机并从菜单中选择所需选项。可以选择手动设置，或选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。爬楼梯时要注意不要绊倒。建议始终握住扶手，以防摔倒。
台阶机方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小，同时消耗卡路里速度相近。它们通常比其他有氧器械难得多。一个150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Walking, Treadmill
instructions: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than walking outside. When walking, you should move at a moderate to fast pace, not a leisurely one. Being an activity of lower intensity, walking doesn't burn as many calories as some other activities, but still provides great benefit. A 150 lb person will burn about 175 calories walking 4 miles per hour for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories running twice as fast. Maintain proper posture as you walk, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.
instructions_zh: 开始时踏上跑步机，从菜单中选择所需选项。大多数跑步机有手动模式，也可选择程序。通常可输入年龄和体重以估算运动消耗的卡路里。可调节坡度改变训练强度。
跑步机便捷、有益心血管，通常比户外步行冲击更小。步行时应以中等至较快速度，不要过于悠闲。作为低强度活动，步行消耗卡路里不如某些运动多，但仍很有益。体重150磅的人以每小时4英里步行30分钟约消耗175卡路里，而以两倍速度跑步约消耗450卡路里。步行时保持正确姿势，仅在必要时（如上下跑步机或检查心率）握住扶手。

instructions_zh: 首先，坐在自行车上并根据身高调整座垫高度。

document.name: Prowler Sprint
instructions: Place your sled on an appropriate surface, loaded to a suitable weight. The sled should provide enough resistance to require effort, but not so heavy that you are significantly slowed down.
You may use the upright or the low handles for this exercise. Place your hands on the handles with your arms extended, leaning into the implement.
With good posture, drive through the ground with alternating, short steps. Move as fast as you can for a short distance.
instructions_zh: 将雪橇放在合适的场地上，加载适当重量。雪橇应提供足够阻力让你需要用力，但不要重到明显拖慢你的速度。
可以使用高位或低位把手进行此练习。双手握住把手，手臂伸直，身体前倾压向器械。
保持良好姿势，以交替的小步快速蹬地。在短距离内尽可能快地移动。

Select the desired option from the menu. You may have to start pedaling to turn it on. You can use the manual setting, or you can select a program to use. document.name: Rope Jumping
instructions: Hold an end of the rope in each hand. Position the rope behind you on the ground. Raise your arms up and turn the rope over your head bringing it down in front of you. When it reaches the ground, jump over it. Find a good turning pace that can be maintained. Different speeds and techniques can be used to introduce variation.
Rope jumping is exciting, challenges your coordination, and requires a lot of energy. A 150 lb person will burn about 350 calories jumping rope for 30 minutes, compared to over 450 calories running.
instructions_zh: 双手各握绳子一端，将绳置于身后地面。抬起双臂，把绳从头顶向前甩，当绳到达地面时跳过去。找到能持续保持的良好摇绳节奏。可通过不同速度和技巧增加变化。
跳绳富有乐趣、能挑战协调性，并且消耗大量能量。体重150磅（约68公斤）的人跳绳30分钟约消耗350千卡，而跑步则超过450千卡。

There are three phases of movement when using a rower. The first phase is when you come forward on the rower. Your knees are bent and against your chest. Your upper body is leaning slightly forward while still maintaining good posture. Next, push against the foot pedals and extend your legs while bringing your hands to your upper abdominal area, squeezing your shoulders back as you do so. To avoid straining your back, use primarily your leg and hip muscles.
The recovery phase simply involves straightening your arms, bending the knees, and bringing your body forward again as you transition back into the first phase.
instructions_zh: 开始时，坐在划船机上。确保脚跟舒适地抵住脚踏板底部，并系紧绑带。如适用，选择你想使用的程序。坐直，在髋部前屈。
使用划船机时动作分为三个阶段。第一阶段是向前回到划船机前方。双膝弯曲并贴近胸部。上身略前倾，同时保持良好姿态。接下来，蹬踏脚踏板并伸展双腿，同时将双手拉向上腹部，并在过程中向后收肩。为避免背部拉伤，主要使用腿部和髋部肌肉。
恢复阶段就是伸直手臂、弯曲膝盖，并在过渡回第一阶段时再次将身体向前带。

document.name: Running, Treadmill
instructions: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. A 150 lb person will burn over 450 calories running 8 miles per hour for 30 minutes. Maintain proper posture as you run, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上跑步机并从菜单中选择所需选项。大多数跑步机都有手动设置，或者你可以选择程序进行跑步。通常，你可以输入年龄和体重来估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。可以调节坡度来改变训练强度。
跑步机提供便利、心血管益处，而且通常比户外跑步冲击更小。一个150磅的人以每小时8英里的速度跑30分钟将消耗超过450卡路里。跑步时保持正确姿势，只在必要时握住扶手，例如下跑步机或检查心率时。

document.name: Skating
instructions: Roller skating is a fun activity which can be effective in improving cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular endurance. It requires relatively good balance and coordination. It is necessary to learn the basics of skating including turning and stopping and to wear protective gear to avoid possible injury.

You can skate at a comfortable pace for 30 minutes straight. If you want a cardio challenge, do interval skating — speed skate two minutes of every five minutes, using the remaining three minutes to recover. A 150 lb person will typically burn about 175 calories in 30 minutes skating at a comfortable pace, similar to brisk walking.
instructions_zh: 轮滑是一项有趣的活动，可有效改善心肺适能和肌肉耐力。它需要相对良好的平衡与协调能力。有必要学习轮滑的基本技巧（包括转弯和停止），并佩戴防护装备，以避免可能的受伤。
你可以以舒适的速度连续滑行30分钟。如果想增加有氧挑战，可进行间歇轮滑——每5分钟中有2分钟快速滑行，剩余3分钟用于恢复。体重150磅的人以舒适速度滑行30分钟通常约消耗175卡路里，与快走相似。

document.name: Stairmaster
instructions: To begin, step onto the stairmaster and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

Pump your legs up and down in an established rhythm, driving the pedals down but not all the way to the floor. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Stairmasters offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上楼梯机，从菜单中选择所需选项。可选择手动模式，也可选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重，以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。
双腿以稳定节奏上下踩踏，向下驱动踏板，但不要一直踩到底。建议始终握住扶手，以免摔倒。扶手可用于监测心率，帮助你保持合适强度。
楼梯机使用方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小。它们通常比其他有氧器械更费力。体重150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Step Mill
instructions: To begin, step onto the stepmill and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Use caution so that you don't trip as you climb the stairs. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall.

Stepmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside while offering a similar rate of calories burned. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上台阶机并从菜单中选择所需选项。可以选择手动设置，或选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。爬楼梯时要注意不要绊倒。建议始终握住扶手，以防摔倒。
台阶机方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小，同时消耗卡路里速度相近。它们通常比其他有氧器械难得多。一个150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Trail Running/Walking
instructions: Running or hiking on trails will get the blood pumping and heart beating almost immediately. Make sure you have good shoes. While you use the muscles in your calves and buttocks to pull yourself up a hill, the knees, joints and ankles absorb the bulk of the pounding coming back down. Take smaller steps as you walk downhill, keep your knees bent to reduce the impact and slow down to avoid falling.
A 150 lb person can burn over 200 calories for 30 minutes walking uphill, compared to 175 on a flat surface. If running the trail, a 150 lb person can burn well over 500 calories in 30 minutes.
instructions_zh: 在越野小径上跑步或徒步几乎会立刻让血液循环加快、心跳上升。确保穿合适的鞋子。上坡时，你用小 腿和臀部肌肉发力把自己拉上坡；下坡时，膝盖、关节和脚踝要承受大部分冲击。下坡行走时步幅要小，保持膝盖弯曲以减少冲击，并放慢速度以免摔倒。
一个体重150磅（约68公斤）的人上坡步行30分钟可消耗超过200卡路里，而在平地上为175卡路里。若在小径上跑步，体重150磅的人30分钟可消耗远超500卡路里。

document.name: Walking, Treadmill
instructions: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than walking outside. When walking, you should move at a moderate to fast pace, not a leisurely one. Being an activity of lower intensity, walking doesn't burn as many calories as some other activities, but still provides great benefit. A 150 lb person will burn about 175 calories walking 4 miles per hour for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories running twice as fast. Maintain proper posture as you walk, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.
instructions_zh: 开始时踏上跑步机，从菜单中选择所需选项。大多数跑步机有手动模式，也可选择程序。通常可输入年龄和体重以估算运动消耗的卡路里。可调节坡度改变训练强度。
跑步机便捷、有益心血管，通常比户外步行冲击更小。步行时应以中等至较快速度，不要过于悠闲。作为低强度活动，步行消耗卡路里不如某些运动多，但仍很有益。体重150磅的人以每小时4英里步行30分钟约消耗175卡路里，而以两倍速度跑步约消耗450卡路里。步行时保持正确姿势，仅在必要时（如上下跑步机或检查心率）握住扶手。

query: 膝盖不舒服，先找不屈伸膝关节的徒手核心动作

document.name: 3/4 Sit-Up
instructions: Lie down on the floor and secure your feet. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind or to the side of your head. You will begin with your back on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Flex your hips and spine to raise your torso toward your knees.
At the top of the contraction your torso should be perpendicular to the ground. Reverse the motion, going only ¾ of the way down.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上并固定双脚，双腿屈膝。
双手放在脑后或头两侧。背部贴地作为起始姿势。
屈髋并屈曲脊柱，将躯干抬向膝盖。
收缩顶点时躯干应与地面垂直。然后反向还原，只下放约3/4行程。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Alternate Heel Touchers
instructions: Lie on the floor with the knees bent and the feet on the floor around 18-24 inches apart. Your arms should be extended by your side. This will be your starting position.
Crunch over your torso forward and up about 3-4 inches to the right side and touch your right heel as you hold the contraction for a second. Exhale while performing this movement.
Now go back slowly to the starting position as you inhale.

Now crunch over your torso forward and up around 3-4 inches to the left side and touch your left heel as you hold the contraction for a second. Exhale while performing this movement and then go back to the starting position as you inhale. Now that both heels have been touched, that is considered 1 repetition.
Continue alternating sides in this manner until all prescribed repetitions are done.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，屈膝，双脚踩地，间距约18-24英寸。双臂应放在身体两侧伸直。这是起始姿势。
将躯干向前上方卷起约3-4英寸并向右侧移动，触碰右脚跟，同时保持收缩一秒。进行该动作时呼气。
吸气时慢慢回到起始位置。
将躯干向前上方卷起约3-4英寸并向左侧移动，触碰左脚跟，同时保持收缩一秒。进行该动作时呼气，然后吸气回到起始位置。两侧脚跟都已触碰后，算1次重复。
按此方式继续交替两侧，直到完成所有规定次数。

document.name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
instructions: Lay flat on the floor with your arms next to your sides.
Now bend your knees at around a 75 degree angle and lift your feet off the floor by around 2 inches.

Using your lower abs, bring your knees in towards you as you maintain the 75 degree angle bend in your legs. Continue this movement until you raise your hips off of the floor by rolling your pelvis backward. Breathe out as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: At the end of the movement your knees will be over your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top of the movement for a second and then return to the starting position slowly as you breathe in. Tip: Maintain a controlled motion at all times.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 平躺在地面上，双臂放在身体两侧。
屈膝约75度，并将双脚抬离地面约2英寸。
利用下腹部力量，在保持双腿约75度屈膝的情况下，将膝盖拉向身体。继续该动作，通过骨盆后倾将髋部抬离地面。完成这一部分动作时呼气。提示：动作结束时，膝盖应位于胸部上方。
在动作顶端收紧腹肌一秒，然后吸气，缓慢回到起始位置。提示：始终保持受控动作。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Bottoms Up
instructions: Begin by lying on your back on the ground. Your legs should be straight and your arms at your side. This will be your starting position.

To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest by flexing the hips and knees. Following this, extend your legs directly above you so that they are perpendicular to the ground. Rotate and elevate your pelvis to raise your glutes from the floor.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始仰卧在地上。双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。这将是你的起始姿势。
执行动作时，屈髋屈膝，将膝盖收向胸部。随后，将双腿向上伸直，使其垂直于地面。旋转并抬高骨盆，使臀部离开地面。
短暂停顿后，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Cocoons
instructions: Begin by lying on your back on the ground. Your legs should be straight and your arms extended behind your head. This will be your starting position.

To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest, rotating your pelvis to lift your glutes from the floor. As you do so, flex the spine, bringing your arms back over your head to perform a simultaneous crunch motion.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始时仰卧在地面上。双腿伸直，双臂向后伸过头顶。这是起始姿势。
执行动作时，将膝盖收向胸部，旋转骨盆使臀部离开地面。同时屈曲脊柱，将双臂从头后方向前带回，完成同步卷腹动作。
稍作停顿后，回到起始位置。

document.name: Cross-Body Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back and bend your knees about 60 degrees.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and place your hands loosely behind your head. This will be your starting position.

Now curl up and bring your right elbow and shoulder across your body while bring your left knee in toward your left shoulder at the same time. Reach with your elbow and try to touch your knee. Exhale as you perform this movement. Tip: Try to bring your shoulder up towards your knee rather than just your elbow and remember that the key is to contract the abs as you perform the movement; not just to move the elbow.
Now go back down to the starting position as you inhale and repeat with the left elbow and the right knee.
Continue alternating in this manner until all prescribed repetitions are done.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝约60度。
双脚平放地面，双手轻放于脑后。这是起始姿势。
卷腹起身，将右肘和右肩向身体对侧移动，同时左膝向左肩方向抬起。用肘去够膝。动作时呼气。提示：尽量让肩膀向膝盖靠近，而不只是移动肘部；关键是动作时收缩腹肌，而不只是移动肘部。
吸气回到起始位置，换左肘和右膝重复。
交替进行，直到完成规定次数。

document.name: Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground, or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle. If you are resting your feet on a bench, place them three to four inches apart and point your toes inward so they touch.
Now place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down in the floor to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off the floor.

Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale. Your shoulders should come up off the floor only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the floor. At the top of the movement, contract your abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
After the one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双脚平放地面，或放在长凳上、膝盖弯曲约90度。若双脚放在长凳上，双脚相距约3至4英寸，脚尖内扣使两脚尖相触。
双手轻放头部两侧，肘部内收。提示：不要将手指交叉扣在脑后。
将下背部压向地面，以更好地孤立腹肌，开始将肩膀卷离地面。
在收缩腹肌并呼气时，用下背部尽可能用力压向地面。肩膀离地仅约4英寸，下背部应保持贴地。动作顶端用力收紧腹肌，并保持收缩1秒。提示：专注于缓慢、可控的动作，不要借助惯性自欺。
保持收缩1秒后，一边吸气一边缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Decline Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back on a decline bench and hold on to the top of the bench with both hands. Don't let your body slip down from this position.

Hold your legs parallel to the floor using your abs to hold them there while keeping your knees and feet together. Tip: Your legs should be fully extended with a slight bend on the knee. This will be your starting position.
While exhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the bench. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在下斜凳上，双手抓住凳子上端。不要让身体从这个位置向下滑。
用腹肌将双腿保持在平行于地面的位置，膝盖和双脚并拢。提示：双腿应完全伸直，膝盖轻微弯曲。这将是你的起始位置。
呼气时，将双腿移向躯干，同时骨盆向后卷动，并将臀部抬离凳面。动作结束时，膝盖应触及胸部。
保持收缩1秒，吸气并将双腿回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Elbow to Knee
instructions: Lie on the floor, crossing your right leg across your bent left knee. Clasp your hands behind your head, beginning with your shoulder blades on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Perform the motion by flexing the spine and rotating your torso to bring the left elbow to the right knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，将右腿交叉放在弯曲的左膝上。双手在头后扣紧，开始时肩胛骨贴地。这是你的起始姿势。
通过屈曲脊柱并旋转躯干，将左肘向右膝靠近，完成动作。
回到起始位置，按所需次数重复，然后换边。

document.name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with your legs off the end.

Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench (or with palms down by the side on an exercise mat). Also extend your legs straight out. This will be your starting position.
Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out. Continue this movement until your knees are near your chest. Hold the contracted position for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在训练垫或平板凳上，双腿伸出凳子末端。
双手放在臀部下方且掌心向下，或放在身体两侧抓住凳子（在训练垫上则掌心向下放在身体两侧）。双腿也完全伸直。这将是你的起始姿势。
呼气时屈膝，将大腿上部拉向腹部。继续该动作，直到膝盖接近胸部。在收缩位置保持一秒。
吸气时缓慢回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，背部平贴凳子，双腿在凳子末端前方伸直。
双手放在臀部下方且掌心向下，或放在身体两侧抓住凳子。这将是你的起始姿势。
保持双腿伸直、尽可能绷直，膝盖微屈但锁定，抬起双腿直到与地面成90度角。做这部分动作时呼气，并在顶端保持收缩一秒。
现在吸气，缓慢将双腿放回起始姿势。

document.name: Leg Pull-In
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat with your legs extended and your hands either palms facing down next to you or under your glutes. Tip: My preference is with the hands next to me. This will be your starting position.

Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out. Continue the motion until your knees are around chest level. Contract your abs as you execute this movement and hold for a second at the top. Tip: As you perform the motion, the lower legs (calves) should always remain parallel to the floor.
Return to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在训练垫上，双腿伸直，双手掌心向下放在身体两侧或臀部下方。提示：我偏好双手放在身体两侧。这是起始姿势。
呼气时屈膝，将大腿上部拉向腹部。继续动作直到膝盖约至胸部高度。执行时收紧腹肌，并在顶端停顿一秒。提示：动作过程中，小腿应始终与地面平行。
吸气时回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Plank
instructions: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.
instructions_zh: 俯卧于地面，用脚趾和前臂支撑体重。手臂弯曲，位于肩膀正下方。
始终保持身体挺直，并尽可能长时间保持该姿势。要增加难度，可以抬起一只手臂或一条腿。

document.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie down on the floor with your legs fully extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on the floor. Your arms should be stationary for the entire exercise.
Move your legs up so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to the floor. This is the starting position.
While inhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the floor. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，双腿完全伸直，双臂放在躯干两侧，掌心贴地。整个动作过程中双臂应保持不动。
将双腿抬起，使大腿与地面垂直，双脚并拢且与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
吸气时，将双腿向躯干方向移动，同时骨盆向后卷动，并将臀部抬离地面。动作结束时膝盖应接触胸部。
保持收缩1秒，呼气时将双腿放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Scissor Kick
instructions: To begin, lie down with your back pressed against the floor or on an exercise mat (optional). Your arms should be fully extended to the sides with your palms facing down. Note: The arms should be stationary the entire time.
With a slight bend at the knees, lift your legs up so that your heels are about 6 inches off the ground. This is the starting position.
Now lift your left leg up to about a 45 degree angle while your right leg is lowered until the heel is about 2-3 inches from the ground.
Switch movements by raising your right leg up and lowering your left leg. Remember to breathe while performing this exercise.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 开始时仰卧，背部贴紧地面，或铺在瑜伽垫上（可选）。双臂应向两侧完全伸直，手掌朝下。注意：整个过程中双臂应保持不动。
膝盖微屈，将双腿抬起，使脚跟离地约6英寸。这是起始姿势。
现在将左腿抬高到约45度角，同时放下右腿，直到脚跟离地约2-3英寸。
通过抬高右腿并放下左腿来切换动作。做这个练习时记得呼吸。
重复建议的次数。

document.name: Seated Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
instructions: Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and your arms holding on to the sides of the bench. Your torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench. This will be your starting position.
Bring the knees in toward you as you move your torso closer to them at the same time. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
After a second pause, go back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳上，双腿向前伸直，略低于水平位置，双手抓住长凳两侧。躯干向后倾斜，与凳面约成45度角。这是起始姿势。
将膝盖朝身体收拢，同时让躯干靠近膝盖。进行此动作时呼气。
停顿一秒后，吸气并回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Seated Leg Tucks
instructions: Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and your arms holding on to the sides of the bench. Your torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench. This will be your starting position.
Bring the knees in toward you as you move your torso closer to them at the same time. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
After a second pause, go back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳上，双腿向前伸直并略低于水平，双手抓住长凳两侧。躯干应向后倾斜，与长凳约呈45度。这是起始姿势。
将膝盖收向身体，同时躯干也向膝盖靠近。完成此动作时呼气。
停顿一秒钟后，吸气并回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地板上，将双脚放在不会移动的物体下，或让同伴按住；双腿应在膝盖处弯曲。
双手放在脑后，手指交叉扣紧，这是起始姿势。
抬起上半身，使其与大腿形成一个假想的V形；做这部分动作时呼气。
感受到收缩一秒后，吸气并将上半身放回起始姿势。
按规定次数重复。

document.name: Spider Crawl
instructions: Begin in a prone position on the floor. Support your weight on your hands and toes, with your feet together and your body straight. Your arms should be bent to 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by raising one foot off of the ground. Externally rotate the leg and bring the knee toward your elbow, as far forward as possible.
Return this leg to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始。用手和脚趾支撑身体，双脚并拢，身体保持挺直。手臂弯曲约90度。这是起始姿势。
动作开始时，将一只脚抬离地面，腿部外旋，把膝盖尽量向前、向同侧肘部靠近。
将该腿放回起始姿势，然后在另一侧重复。

document.name: Toe Touchers
instructions: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your arms should be lying across your sides with the palms facing down.

Your legs should be touching each other. Slowly elevate your legs up in the air until they are almost perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. Your feet should be parallel to the floor.
Move your arms so that they are fully extended at a 45 degree angle from the floor. This is the starting position.
While keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso and use your hands to try and touch your toes. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise.
Slowly begin to lower your torso and arms back down to the starting position while inhaling. Remember to keep your arms straight out pointing towards your toes.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 开始前，仰卧在地面或训练垫上，背部紧贴地面。双臂放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
双腿并拢。缓慢将双腿抬至空中，直至几乎与地面垂直，膝盖微屈。双脚应与地面平行。
将双臂移动至完全伸直，并与地面呈45度角。这是起始姿势。
保持下背部贴地，缓慢抬起躯干，并用双手尝试触碰脚趾。做这一部分时记得呼气。
缓慢将躯干和双臂放回起始位置，同时吸气。双臂始终保持伸直并指向脚趾。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Tuck Crunch
instructions: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your arms should be lying across your sides with the palms facing down.

Your legs should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around the other. Slowly elevate your legs up in the air until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. Note: Your knees and toes should be parallel to the floor as opposed to the thighs.
Move your arms from the floor and cross them so they are resting on your chest. This is the starting position.
While keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise.
Slowly begin to lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 开始时仰卧在地板或瑜伽垫上，背部贴紧地面。双臂放在身体两侧，掌心向下。
双腿交叉，一只脚踝搭在另一只脚踝上。缓慢将双腿抬离地面，直至大腿与地面垂直，膝盖微屈。注意：膝盖和脚尖应平行于地面，而不是与大腿保持一条直线。
将双臂从地面抬起并交叉放在胸前。此为起始姿势。
保持下背部贴紧地面，缓慢抬起躯干。注意在此阶段呼气。
缓慢将躯干还原至起始姿势，同时吸气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Wind Sprints
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Your arms and legs should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by quickly raising one knee as high as you can. Do not swing your body or your legs. 3
Immediately reverse the motion, returning that leg to the starting position. Simultaneously raise the opposite knee as high as possible.
Continue alternating between legs until the set is complete.
instructions_zh: 正握引体向上杆悬垂，双臂和双腿伸直。这是起始位置。
开始快速将一侧膝盖尽可能抬高。不要摆动身体或腿。
立即反向动作，将该腿回到起始位置，同时尽可能抬高对侧膝盖。
继续交替双腿，直到完成该组。

query: 肩膀有旧伤，找小腿固定器械提踵

document.name: Calf Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.
instructions_zh: 调整座椅，使起始时双腿仅轻微弯曲。前脚掌应稳稳踩在踏板上。
选择合适重量，并握住把手。这是起始姿势。
通过伸展膝关节伸直双腿，仅将重量从配重堆上稍微抬起。踝关节应完全屈曲，脚尖向上。随后通过前脚掌尽可能向下踩来完成动作。
短暂停顿后，反向运动并重复。

document.name: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance.

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you without locking your knees. (Note: In some leg press units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your leg press unit allows for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the legs should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place your toes and balls of your feet on the lower portion of the platform with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Press on the platform by raising your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
