Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 使用腿举机，坐下后将双腿以中等（与肩同宽）站距放在正前方的踏板上。
放下固定负重踏板的保险杆，并将踏板一直推起，直到双腿在身前完全伸直，但不要锁死膝盖。（注：部分腿举机可保留保险杆以增加安全性；如果你的器械允许，建议采用这种方式。）躯干与双腿应成标准90度角。然后小心地将脚尖和前脚掌放在踏板下缘，脚跟悬空。脚尖可朝前、朝外或朝内，如本章开头所述。这是起始姿势。
呼气，通过尽可能高地伸展踝关节并收缩小腿，以抬起脚跟的方式踩压踏板。确保膝盖始终固定不动，任何时候都不应弯曲。保持收缩姿势1秒后再开始下放。
吸气，缓慢回到起始位置，放下脚跟并屈曲踝关节，直到小腿被拉伸。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the machine and place your toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off. Choose the toe positioning of your choice (forward, in, or out) as per the beginning of this chapter.

Place your lower thighs under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of your thighs. Now place your hands on top of the lever pad in order to prevent it from slipping forward.
Lift the lever slightly by pushing your heels up and release the safety bar. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower your heels by bending at the ankles until the calves are fully stretched. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Raise the heels by extending the ankles as high as possible as you contract the calves and breathe out. Hold the top contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 坐在器械上，将脚趾放在踏板下缘，脚跟悬空。按本章开头所述选择脚趾朝向（朝前、朝内或朝外）。
将大腿下段置于杠杆垫下方，杠杆垫需根据大腿高度调整。然后将双手放在杠杆垫上方，防止其向前滑动。
脚跟向上推，将杠杆稍微抬起并松开安全杆。这是起始位置。
踝关节弯曲，缓慢下放脚跟，直到小腿完全拉伸。做此动作时吸气。
收缩小腿并呼气，尽可能高地伸展踝关节抬起脚跟。在顶部收缩处保持1秒。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Place a block or weight plate below the bar on the Smith machine. Set the bar to a position that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step onto the plates with the balls of your feet and place the bar on the back of your shoulders.
Take the bar with both hands facing forward. Rotate the bar to unrack it. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing off of the balls of your feet, flexing your calf at the top of the contraction. Your knees should remain extended. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Return slowly to the starting position as you breathe in while lowering your heels.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 在史密斯机杠铃杆下方放置木块或杠铃片。将杆调到最适合你身高的位置。选定高度并加载重量后，以前脚掌踩在杠铃片上，将杆置于肩后。
双手朝前握住杠铃杆。旋转杠铃杆将其从架上解锁。这是起始姿势。
以前脚掌发力，尽量抬高脚跟，在收缩顶点收紧小腿。膝盖应保持伸直。保持收缩位一秒后开始下放。
吸气，缓慢降下脚跟回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raises
instructions: Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to fit your height and align a raised platform right under the bar.
Stand on the platform with the heels of your feet secured on top of it with the balls of your feet extending off it. Position your toes facing forward with a shoulder width stance.

Now, place your shoulders under the barbell while maintaining the foot positioning described and push the barbell up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: The barbell on your back is only for balance purposes.

Raise the balls of your feet as you breathe out by extending your toes as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering the balls of your feet and toes.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将史密斯机杠铃调整到适合你的高度，并在杠铃正下方对齐一个抬高的平台。
站在平台上，脚跟固定在平台上方，前脚掌伸出平台边缘。脚尖朝前，采用与肩同宽的站距。
现在，在保持上述脚部位置的同时，将肩部置于杠铃下方，通过伸展髋部和膝盖将杠铃向上顶起，直到躯干直立。膝盖应保持微屈，绝不能锁死。这是起始姿势。提示：背上的杠铃仅用于保持平衡。
呼气时，尽可能伸展脚趾并收缩小腿，抬起前脚掌。确保膝盖始终固定不动，任何时候都不应弯曲。在收缩位置保持一秒，然后开始下放。
吸气时，缓慢下放前脚掌和脚趾，回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Adjust the padded lever of the calf raise machine to fit your height.

Place your shoulders under the pads provided and position your toes facing forward (or using any of the two other positions described at the beginning of the chapter). The balls of your feet should be secured on top of the calf block with the heels extending off it. Push the lever up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 调整提踵机的带垫杠杆以适合你的身高。
将肩膀置于提供的垫下，脚尖朝前（或采用本章开头描述的另外两种位置之一）。前脚掌应稳稳踩在提踵台上，脚跟悬空。通过伸髋伸膝将杠杆向上推，直到躯干直立。膝盖应保持微屈，切勿锁死。脚尖按本章开头所述朝前、朝外或朝内。这是起始姿势。
呼气时踮起脚跟，通过尽可能高地伸踝并收缩小腿。确保膝盖始终固定不动，任何时候都不应弯曲。在收缩位保持一秒，然后开始下放。
吸气时缓慢回到起始姿势，通过屈踝放低脚跟，直到小腿有拉伸感。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: All Fours Quad Stretch
instructions: Start off on your hands and knees, then lift your leg off the floor and hold the foot with your hand.
Use your hand to hold the foot or ankle, keeping the knee fully flexed, stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors.
Focus on extending your hips, thrusting them towards the floor. Hold for 10-20 seconds and then switch sides.
document.name_zh: 手膝跪姿股四头肌拉伸
aliases_zh: 四足跪姿股四头肌拉伸
instructions_zh: 从手膝跪姿开始，然后将一条腿抬离地面，并用手抓住脚。
用手握住脚或脚踝，保持膝盖完全屈曲，拉伸股四头肌和髋屈肌。
专注于伸展髋部，将髋部向地面压。保持10-20秒，然后换边。

document.name: Bench Jump
instructions: Begin with a box or bench 1-2 feet in front of you. Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Perform a short squat in preparation for the jump; swing your arms behind you.
Rebound out of this position, extending through the hips, knees, and ankles to jump as high as possible. Swing your arms forward and up.
Jump over the bench, landing with the knees bent, absorbing the impact through the legs.
Turn around and face the opposite direction, then jump back over the bench.
instructions_zh: 在身前1-2英尺（约30-60厘米）处放置一个跳箱或长凳。双脚与肩同宽站立。这是起始姿势。
做一个短促的下蹲为跳跃做准备；双臂向后摆。
从该姿势反弹发力，伸展髋部、膝部和踝部，尽可能跳高。双臂向前上方摆。
跳过长凳，落地时屈膝，通过腿部缓冲冲击。
转身面向相反方向，再跳回长凳另一侧。

document.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. You can place your hands behind your head. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing your knees and hips, sitting back with your hips.
Continue down to full depth if you are able,and quickly reverse the motion until you return to the starting position. As you squat, keep your head and chest up and push your knees out.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，可将双手放在脑后。这将是你的起始姿势。
通过屈膝屈髋开始动作，臀部向后坐。
如果能力允许，继续下蹲至全深度，然后迅速反向运动，回到起始姿势。下蹲时保持头部和胸部抬起，并将膝盖向外推。

document.name: Double Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin standing with your knees slightly bent.
Quickly squat a short distance, flexing the hips and knees, and immediately extend to jump for maximum vertical height.
As you go up, tuck your heels by flexing the knees, attempting to touch the buttocks.
Finish the motion by landing with the knees only partially bent, using your legs to absorb the impact.
instructions_zh: 开始时站立，膝盖微屈。
快速下蹲一小段距离，屈髋屈膝，并立即伸展起跳，以达到最大垂直高度。
起跳时屈膝收脚跟，尽量触碰臀部。
落地时膝盖仅部分弯曲，用双腿缓冲冲击，完成动作。

document.name: Fast Skipping
instructions: Start in a relaxed position with one leg slightly forward. This will be your starting position.
Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, and so on, alternating back and forth.
Perform fast skips by maintaining close contact with the ground and reduce air time, moving as quickly as possible.
instructions_zh: 以放松姿势开始，一条腿稍微向前。这将是你的起始姿势。
按照右-右-步到左-左-步的步骤跳模式进行跳步，并如此来回交替。
保持与地面近距离接触并减少腾空时间，尽可能快速地完成快速跳步。

document.name: Freehand Jump Squat
instructions: Cross your arms over your chest.
With your head up and your back straight, position your feet at shoulder width.
Keeping your back straight and chest up, squat down as you inhale until your upper thighs are parallel, or lower, to the floor.
Now pressing mainly with the ball of your feet, jump straight up in the air as high as possible, using the thighs like springs. Exhale during this portion of the movement.
When you touch the floor again, immediately squat down and jump again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双臂交叉置于胸前。
抬头挺胸、背部挺直，双脚与肩同宽站立。
保持背部挺直和胸部上挺，吸气并下蹲，直到大腿上侧与地面平行或更低。
现在主要用前脚掌发力，像弹簧一样用大腿向上尽可能高跳起。此阶段呼气。
再次落地时立即下蹲并再次起跳。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Lying Prone Quadriceps
instructions: Lay face down on the floor with your partner kneeling beside you. Flex one knee and raise that leg off the ground, attempting to touch your glutes with your foot. Your partner should hold the knee and ankle. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to extend your knee while your partner prevents any actual movement.
After 10-20 seconds, relax your muscles as your partner gently pushes the foot towards your glutes, further stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors.
After 10-20 seconds, switch sides.
aliases_zh: 同伴辅助俯卧股四头肌拉伸
instructions_zh: 俯卧于地面，同伴跪在你身旁。屈起一侧膝盖并将该腿抬离地面，尝试用脚触碰臀部。同伴应握住你的膝和踝。此为起始姿势。
尝试伸直膝盖，同时由同伴阻止任何实际动作（等长收缩）。
10~20秒后放松肌肉，同伴轻轻将脚向臀部方向推，进一步拉伸股四头肌和髋屈肌。
10~20秒后换另一侧。

document.name: Rear Leg Raises
instructions: Place yourself on your hands knees on an exercise mat. Your head should be looking forward and the bend of the knees should create a 90-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves. This will be your starting position.
Extend one leg up and behind you. The knee and hip should both extend. Repeat for 5-10 repetitions, and then switch sides.
instructions_zh: 在瑜伽垫上呈手膝跪姿。头部应向前看，膝盖弯曲应使腘绳肌与小腿之间形成90度角。这是起始姿势。
将一条腿向上并向后伸展。膝盖和髋部都应伸展。重复5-10次，然后换边。

document.name: Rocket Jump
instructions: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body.
To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible.
Fully extend your entire body, reaching overhead as far as possible. As you land, absorb your impact through the legs.
instructions_zh: 以放松站姿开始，双脚与肩同宽，双臂靠近身体。
启动动作时，下蹲至半蹲，然后爆发向上尽量跳高。
充分伸展全身，尽可能向头顶上方伸展。落地时通过腿部缓冲冲击。

document.name: Scissors Jump
instructions: Assume a lunge stance position with one foot forward with the knee bent, and the rear knee nearly touching the ground.
Ensure that the front knee is over the midline of the foot. Extending through both legs, jump as high as possible, swinging your arms to gain lift.
As you jump as high as you can, switch the position of your legs, moving your front leg to the back and the rear leg to the front.
As you land, absorb the impact through the legs by adopting the lunge position, and repeat.
instructions_zh: 呈弓步站姿，一只脚在前且屈膝，后膝几乎触地。
确保前膝位于脚掌中线正上方。双腿同时发力，尽可能向上跳，摆臂助力。
跳到最高时交换两腿位置，前腿移至后方，后腿移至前方。
落地时成弓步姿势缓冲冲击，然后重复。

document.name: Single Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin by standing on one leg, with the bent knee raised. This will be your start position.
Using a countermovement jump, take off upward by extending the hip, knee, and ankle of the grounded leg.
Immediately flex the knee and attempt to touch your butt with the heel of your jumping leg.
Return the leg to a partially bent position underneath the hips and land. Your opposite leg should stay in relatively the same position throughout the drill.
instructions_zh: 开始时单腿站立，另一侧屈膝抬起，这是起始姿势。
通过反向动作跳跃，支撑腿伸展髋、膝和踝向上起跳。
立即屈膝，尝试用起跳腿的脚跟触碰臀部。
将腿回到髋部下方半屈位置落地；整个练习中另一条腿应基本保持同一位置。

document.name: Split Jump
instructions: Assume a lunge stance position with one foot forward with the knee bent, and the rear knee nearly touching the ground.
Ensure that the front knee is over the midline of the foot.
Extending through both legs, jump as high as possible, swinging your arms to gain lift.
As you jump, bring your feet together, and move them back to their initial positions as you land.
Absorb the impact by reverting back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 呈弓步姿势，一脚在前且膝弯曲，后膝几乎触地。
确保前膝位于脚的中线正上方。
双腿同时伸展，尽可能跳高，摆臂帮助获得升力。
跳跃时将双脚并拢，落地时再把双脚移回初始位置。
回到起始姿势以缓冲冲击。

document.name: Standing Long Jump
instructions: This drill is best done in sand or other soft landing surface. Ensure that you are able to measure distance. Stand in a partial squat stance with feet shoulder width apart.
Utilizing a big arm swing and a countermovement of the legs, jump forward as far as you can.
Attempt to land with your feet out in front you, reaching as far as possible with your legs.
Measure the distance from your landing point to the starting point and track results.
instructions_zh: 这个练习最好在沙地或其他柔软落地区域进行。确保能够测量距离。以半蹲姿势站立，双脚与肩同宽。
利用大幅度摆臂和腿部反向动作，尽可能向前跳远。
尝试双脚向前伸落地，双腿尽可能远伸。
测量从落地点到起点的距离并记录结果。

document.name: Star Jump
instructions: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body.
To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible. Fully extend your entire body, spreading your legs and arms away from the body.
As you land, bring your limbs back in and absorb your impact through the legs.
instructions_zh: 以放松姿势开始，双脚与肩同宽，双臂贴近身体。
开始动作时，下蹲至半蹲，然后尽可能爆发向上跳起。完全伸展全身，将双腿和双臂向身体两侧展开。
落地时收回四肢，并通过腿部缓冲冲击。

query: 用药球做俯身弯举练二头肌

document.name: 3/4 Sit-Up
instructions: Lie down on the floor and secure your feet. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind or to the side of your head. You will begin with your back on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Flex your hips and spine to raise your torso toward your knees.
At the top of the contraction your torso should be perpendicular to the ground. Reverse the motion, going only ¾ of the way down.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上并固定双脚，双腿屈膝。
双手放在脑后或头两侧。背部贴地作为起始姿势。
屈髋并屈曲脊柱，将躯干抬向膝盖。
收缩顶点时躯干应与地面垂直。然后反向还原，只下放约3/4行程。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Advanced Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Clean and press a kettlebell overhead with one arm.

Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push your butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell. Keep the non-working arm behind your back and turn your feet out at a forty-five degree angle from the arm with the kettlebell.
Lower yourself as far as possible.
Pause for a second and reverse the motion back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 单臂将壶铃翻举至头顶。
始终保持壶铃锁定在头顶，将臀部朝举铃手臂方向推出。非持铃手放在背后，双脚相对持铃手臂向外转约45度。
尽可能向下降低身体。
停顿1秒，然后反向回到起始姿势。

document.name: Air Bike
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. For this exercise, you will need to put your hands beside your head. Be careful however to not strain with the neck as you perform it. Now lift your shoulders into the crunch position.
Bring knees up to where they are perpendicular to the floor, with your lower legs parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now simultaneously, slowly go through a cycle pedal motion kicking forward with the right leg and bringing in the knee of the left leg. Bring your right elbow close to your left knee by crunching to the side, as you breathe out.
Go back to the initial position as you breathe in.
Crunch to the opposite side as you cycle your legs and bring closer your left elbow to your right knee and exhale.
Continue alternating in this manner until all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.
instructions_zh: 平躺在地面上，下背部贴紧地面。双手放在头两侧。动作时注意不要使颈部过度受力。将肩膀抬离地面进入卷腹姿势。
屈膝抬起双腿，使大腿与地面垂直、小腿与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
现在同时缓慢做蹬车动作：右腿向前蹬出，左膝收向身体。向侧方卷腹，使右肘靠近左膝，同时呼气。
吸气并回到初始姿势。
继续蹬腿并向另一侧卷腹，使左肘靠近右膝，同时呼气。
继续交替进行，直到每侧完成所有建议次数。

document.name: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound
instructions: Assume a comfortable stance with one foot slightly in front of the other.
Begin by pushing off with the front leg, driving the opposite knee forward and as high as possible before landing. Attempt to cover as much distance to each side with each bound.
It may help to use a line on the ground to guage distance from side to side.
Repeat the sequence with the other leg.
instructions_zh: 采取舒适站姿，一只脚略位于另一只脚前方。
以前腿蹬地开始，推动对侧膝盖尽可能向前上方抬起，然后落地。每次跳跃尽量向两侧方向覆盖更大距离。
在地面画一条线来帮助判断左右两侧的距离可能会有帮助。
换另一条腿重复该序列。

document.name: Alternating Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Move the cables to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight.
Grasp the cables and hold them at shoulder height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your head and chest up, extend through the elbow to press one side directly over head.
After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
instructions_zh: 将绳索调到训练塔底部，并选择合适的重量。
抓住绳索，将其保持在肩部高度，掌心朝前。这是起始姿势。
保持头部和胸部抬起，伸直肘部将一侧直接推过头顶。
在顶部稍停后，回到起始位置，并在对侧重复。

document.name: Alternating Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to your shoulders.
Position one in place on your chest and then the other, gripping the kettlebells on the handle with the palms facing forward.
Extend both arms, so that the kettlebells are being held above your chest. Lower one kettlebell, bringing it to your chest and turn the wrist in the direction of the locked out kettlebell.
Raise the kettlebell and repeat on the opposite side.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，两只壶铃放在肩膀两侧。
先将一只壶铃放到胸前位置，再放另一只，握住壶铃手柄，掌心朝前。
伸直双臂，使壶铃位于胸部上方。放低一只壶铃至胸前，并将手腕转向另一只保持伸直锁定的壶铃方向。
抬起壶铃，并在对侧重复。

document.name: Anti-Gravity Press
instructions: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor. Flex the elbows, performing a reverse curl to bring the bar near your chest. This will be your starting position.
To begin, press the barbell out in front of your head by extending your elbows. Keep your arms parallel to the ground throughout the movement.
Return to the starting position and repeat to complete the set.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放在上斜训练凳头端后方的地面上。
俯卧在训练凳上。采用正握，从地面拿起杠铃。屈肘做反式弯举，将杠铃带到胸前附近。这将是你的起始姿势。
开始时，伸肘将杠铃向头部前方推出。整个动作过程中保持手臂与地面平行。
返回起始姿势并重复，完成该组。

document.name: Back Flyes - With Bands
instructions: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack.
Grab the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises.

Extend and lift the arms straight in front of you. Tip: Your arms should be straight and parallel to the floor while perpendicular to your torso. Your feet should be firmly planted on the floor spread at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, move your arms to the sides and back. Keep your arms extended and parallel to the floor. Continue the movement until the arms are extended to your sides.
After a pause, go back to the original position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕过深蹲架等固定立柱。
握住弹力带把手，向后站远，使弹力带张力增加。
双臂伸直并抬至身体正前方。提示：手臂应伸直、与地面平行，并与躯干垂直。双脚与肩同宽，稳稳踩地。这是起始姿势。
呼气时，将双臂向两侧后方移动。保持手臂伸直并与地面平行。继续动作，直到双臂向两侧展开。
稍作停顿后，吸气回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Backward Drag
instructions: Load a sled with the desired weight, attaching a rope or straps to the sled that you can hold onto.
Begin the exercise by moving backwards for a given distance. Leaning back, extend through the legs for short steps to move as quickly as possible.
instructions_zh: 给雪橇装上所需重量，并在雪橇上系好可抓握的绳索或拉带。
开始练习时向后移动一定距离。身体后仰，通过腿部伸展迈小步，尽可能快速地后退。

document.name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw
instructions: This exercise is best done with a partner. If you lack a partner, the ball can be thrown and retrieved or thrown against a wall.
Begin standing a few meters in front of your partner, both facing the same direction. Begin holding the ball between your legs.
Squat down and then forcefully reverse direction, coming to full extension and you toss the ball over your head to your partner.
Your partner can then roll the ball back to you. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 这项练习最好与同伴一起完成。如果没有同伴，可以抛出后自行捡回，或向墙壁抛掷。
开始时站在同伴前方几米处，两人面朝同一方向。双手将药球置于双腿之间。
下蹲，然后用力反向发力，充分伸展身体，将药球从头顶向后抛给同伴。
同伴随后可将球滚回给你。按所需次数重复。

document.name: Balance Board
instructions: Place a balance board in front of you.
Stand up on it and try to balance yourself.
Hold the balance for as long as desired.
instructions_zh: 将平衡板放在身前。
站上平衡板，努力保持身体平衡。
按需保持平衡所需时间。

document.name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Choke the band around the center of the pullup bar. You can use different bands to provide varying levels of assistance.
Pull the end of the band down, and place one bent knee into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out. Take a medium to wide grip on the bar. This will be your starting position.

Pull yourself upward by contracting the lats as you flex the elbow. The elbow should be driven to your side. Pull to the front, attempting to get your chin over the bar. Avoid swinging or jerking movements.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕在引体向上杆中央并收紧。可使用不同弹力带提供不同程度的辅助。
将弹力带一端向下拉，把一条弯曲的膝盖伸入带圈，确保不会滑脱。以中等至较宽握距握住单杠。这是起始姿势。
收缩背阔肌并屈肘将身体向上拉。肘部应向身体两侧下压。向前上方拉，尽量使下巴超过单杠。避免摆动或猛拉。
短暂停顿后，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Band Good Morning
instructions: Using a 41 inch band, stand on one end, spreading your feet a small amount. Bend at the hips to loop the end of the band behind your neck. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your legs straight, extend through the hips to come to a near vertical position.
Ensure that you do not round your back as you go down back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 使用41英寸弹力带，双脚略微分开站在一端，屈髋将另一端绕到颈后。这是起始姿势。
保持双腿伸直，通过伸髋起身至接近直立。
回到起始姿势下放时，确保不要弓背。

document.name: Band Good Morning (Pull Through)
instructions: Loop the band around a post. Standing a little ways away, loop the opposite end around the neck. Your hands can help hold the band in position.
Begin by bending at the hips, getting your butt back as far as possible. Keep your back flat and bend forward to about 90 degrees. Your knees should be only slightly bent.
Return to the starting position be driving through with the hips to come back to a standing position.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕在固定柱上。站在稍远处，把另一端绕到颈后，可用双手帮助固定弹力带位置。
先屈髋，尽量把臀部向后推。保持背部平直，向前俯身约90度，膝盖只应轻微弯曲。
通过髋部发力回到站立起始姿势。

document.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
From the starting position, breathe in and begin coming down slowly until the bar touches your middle chest.

After a brief pause, push the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out. Focus on pushing the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position at the top of the motion, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上。采用中等握距（使动作中点时前臂与上臂约成90度），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定将杠铃笔直举于身体上方。这是起始姿势。
从起始姿势吸气，开始缓慢下放，直到杠铃触及胸部中部。
短暂停顿后，呼气将杠铃推回起始姿势。集中用胸肌发力推起。在动作顶端手臂锁定并挤压胸肌，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所需时间约为上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on you upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: it should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜训练凳上。采用中等握距（即动作中段时前臂与上臂约呈90度角），从架上取下杠铃，双臂伸直锁定，将杠铃保持在身体正上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到感觉杠铃接触上胸部。
停顿1秒后，呼气并用胸部肌肉将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂，挤压胸肌，保持1秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复该动作。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Double Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Place a kettlebell in front of your front foot and clean and press a kettlebell overhead with your opposite arm. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward.

Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push your butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell. Turn your feet out at a forty-five degree angle from the arm with the locked out kettlebell.
Bending at the hip to one side, sticking your butt out, slowly lean until you can retrieve the kettlebell from the floor. Keep your eyes on the kettlebell that you hold over your head at all times.
Pause for a second after retrieving the kettlebell from the ground and reverse the motion back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将一只壶铃放在前脚前方，用对侧手臂将另一只壶铃翻至肩部并推举至头顶。通过伸腿伸髋将壶铃拉向肩部完成翻铃，过程中旋转手腕使掌心朝前。
始终保持壶铃锁定在头顶，朝锁定壶铃的方向将臀部推出。将双脚向外转至与持锁定壶铃的手臂成45度角。
髋部向一侧弯曲，臀部外顶，缓慢侧倾，直到能从地面取回壶铃。始终注视头顶的壶铃。
从地面取回壶铃后停顿一秒，然后反向运动回到起始姿势。

document.name: Good Morning
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at shoulder height. Rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Step back from the rack.
Begin by bending at the hips, moving them back as you bend over to near parallel. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Reverse the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings. Continue until you have returned to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始时，将杠铃放在与肩同高的深蹲架上。像背蹲一样将杠铃架在肩后，而不是压在肩上。保持背部收紧，肩胛骨夹紧，膝盖微屈。从架上后退一步。
从屈髋开始，臀部向后移动，上身前屈至接近与地面平行。保持腰背自然反弓，颈椎保持正确排列。
通过臀肌和大腿后侧伸髋，反向回到起始姿势。继续直到回到起始位置。

document.name: Good Morning off Pins
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Bend over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. At the proper height, you should be near parallel to the floor when bent over. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Begin the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings, and you are standing with the weight. Slowly lower the weight back to the pins returning to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 开始时，将杠铃放在约与腹部同高的架子上。俯身到杠铃下方，像背蹲一样将杠铃架在肩后，而不是压在肩上。杠铃高度合适时，俯身后身体应接近与地面平行。保持背部收紧，肩胛骨夹紧，膝盖微屈。保持腰背自然反弓，颈椎正确排列。
通过臀肌和大腿后侧伸髋开始动作，直到持铃站直。然后缓慢将重量放回架子上，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Hack Squat
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将躯干后侧贴住器械靠背垫，把肩膀挂在提供的肩垫下方。
双脚站在踏板上，采用与肩同宽的中等站距，脚尖略微外展。提示：始终抬头，并始终保持背部贴紧靠垫。
双手放在器械两侧把手上，解除安全杆（大多数设计中，将侧把手从朝前位置转到斜向位置即可）。
现在伸直双腿，但不要锁死膝盖。这是起始姿势。（注：本说明采用上述中等站距，以全面发展为目标；不过你也可以选择脚位部分所述的三种站距中的任意一种。）
开始缓慢屈膝下放器械，同时保持身体挺直、抬头（背部始终贴垫）。继续下放，直到大腿与小腿之间的角度略小于90度（即大腿低于与地面平行的位置）。此阶段吸气。提示：如果动作正确，膝盖前方应与脚尖形成一条垂直于前方的假想直线。如果膝盖超过这条假想线（即超过脚尖），就会给膝关节带来不必要的压力，说明动作执行不正确。
开始呼气并向上抬起器械，主要用脚跟蹬地，再次伸直双腿，回到起始姿势。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Suspend the bar using chains or suspension straps.

Bend over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your traps. At the proper height, you should be near parallel to the floor when bent over. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Begin the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings, and you are standing with the weight.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position, where it is supported by the chains.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放在与腹部大致同高的架子上，用链条或悬吊带悬挂杠铃。
在杠下俯身，将杠铃置于肩后，如力量深蹲那样，不要放在斜方肌顶部。高度合适时，俯身应接近与地面平行。保持背部绷紧、肩胛骨夹紧、膝盖微屈。保持背部拱起，颈椎保持正确对齐。
通过臀部和腘绳肌伸展髋部开始动作，直至负重站立。
缓慢将重量降回起始位置，由链条支撑。

document.name: Isometric Wipers
instructions: Assume a push-up position, supporting your weight on your hands and toes while keeping your body straight. Your hands should be just outside of shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Begin by shifting your body weight as far to one side as possible, allowing the elbow on that side to flex as you lower your body.
Reverse the motion by extending the flexed arm, pushing yourself up and then dropping to the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 采取俯卧撑姿势，用手和脚趾支撑体重，同时保持身体笔直。双手应略宽于肩宽。这将是你的起始姿势。
开始将体重尽可能移向一侧，同时让该侧肘部弯曲，使身体下降。
通过伸展弯曲的手臂反向运动，将自己推起，然后倒向另一侧。
按所需次数重复。

document.name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
instructions: Place kettlebell between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.

Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
Lower the kettlebell, keeping the hamstrings loaded by keeping your back straight and your butt out.
instructions_zh: 将壶铃放在双脚之间。进入起始姿势时，臀部向后推，目视前方。
将壶铃翻至肩部。通过伸展腿部和髋部，同时将壶铃向上提至肩部，完成向肩部的翻铃。过程中手腕应随之转动。
放下壶铃，保持背部挺直、臀部向后，使腘绳肌持续受力。

document.name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Place a kettlebell in front of your lead foot and clean and press it overhead with your opposite arm. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. Press it overhead by extending the elbow.

Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push your butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell. Turn your feet out at a forty-five degree angle from the arm with the locked out kettlebell. Bending at the hip to one side, sticking your butt out, slowly lean until you can touch the floor with your free hand. Keep your eyes on the kettlebell that you hold over your head at all times.
Pause for a second after reaching the ground and reverse the motion back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将壶铃放在前脚前方，用对侧手臂将其高翻并推举过头。高翻至肩部时，通过伸展腿部和髋部将壶铃拉向肩部，同时转动手腕，使掌心朝前；再通过伸直肘部将其推举过头。
始终保持壶铃锁定在头顶，将臀部朝锁定壶铃的方向顶出。双脚相对持壶铃手臂向外转约45度。髋部向一侧弯曲、臀部后顶，缓慢侧倾，直到空出的手能触地。始终注视头顶上方的壶铃。
触地后停顿一秒，然后反向动作回到起始位置。

document.name: London Bridges
instructions: Attach a climbing rope to a high beam or cross member. Below it, ensure that the smith machine bar is locked in place with the safeties and cannot move. Alternatively, a secure box could also be utilized.
Stand on the bar, using the rope to balance yourself. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your body straight, lean back and lower your body by slowly going hand over hand with the rope. Continue until you are perpendicular to the ground.
Keeping your body straight, reverse the motion, going hand over hand back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将攀爬绳固定在高处的横梁或横杆上。在其下方，确保史密斯机横杆已用安全锁固定牢靠、无法移动；也可以改用稳固的箱子。
站在横杆上，借助绳索保持平衡。这是起始姿势。
保持身体挺直，向后仰，并通过双手交替抓绳缓慢下放身体，直到身体与地面垂直。
保持身体挺直，反向做动作，双手交替抓绳回到起始姿势。

document.name: Rickshaw Carry
instructions: Position the frame at the starting point, and load with the appropriate weight. Standing in the center of the frame, begin by gripping the handles and driving through your heels to lift the frame. Ensure your chest and head are up and your back is straight.

Immediately begin walking briskly with quick, controlled steps. Keep your chest up and head forward, and make sure you continue breathing. Bring the frame to the ground after you have reached the end point.
instructions_zh: 将框架置于起点，并装上合适重量。站在框架中央，握住把手，通过脚跟发力将框架抬起。确保挺胸、抬头、背部挺直。
立即以快速、可控的步伐开始快走。保持挺胸、头部向前，并确保持续呼吸。到达终点后将框架放回地面。

document.name: Seated Good Mornings
instructions: Set up a box in a power rack. The pins should be set at an appropriate height. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders, not on top of your traps. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across your shoulders.

Remove the bar from the rack, creating a tight arch in your lower back. Keep your head facing forward. With your back, shoulders, and core tight, push your knees and butt out and you begin your descent. Sit back with your hips until you are seated on the box. This will be your starting position.
Keeping the bar tight, bend forward at the hips as much as possible. If you set the pins to what would be parallel, you not only have a safety if you fail, but know when to stop.
Pause just above the pins and reverse the motion until your torso it upright.
instructions_zh: 在力量架上设置一个箱子，保护销高度要合适。先站到杠铃下，将杠铃放在肩后部，而不是斜方肌上方。收紧肩胛骨，肘部向前旋转，尝试把杠铃在肩上弯紧。
将杠铃从架上取下，下背部保持紧致反弓。头部朝前。背部、肩部和核心收紧，膝盖和臀部向外推，开始下蹲。髋部向后坐，直到坐在箱子上。这是起始姿势。
保持杠铃稳定，尽可能以髋部为轴向前俯身。如果将保护销设置到躯干与地面平行时的高度，不仅失败时有保护，也能知道何时停止。
在保护销上方稍作停顿，然后反向动作直到躯干直立。

document.name: Stairmaster
instructions: To begin, step onto the stairmaster and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

Pump your legs up and down in an established rhythm, driving the pedals down but not all the way to the floor. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Stairmasters offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上楼梯机，从菜单中选择所需选项。可选择手动模式，也可选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重，以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。
双腿以稳定节奏上下踩踏，向下驱动踏板，但不要一直踩到底。建议始终握住扶手，以免摔倒。扶手可用于监测心率，帮助你保持合适强度。
楼梯机使用方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小。它们通常比其他有氧器械更费力。体重150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Standing Long Jump
instructions: This drill is best done in sand or other soft landing surface. Ensure that you are able to measure distance. Stand in a partial squat stance with feet shoulder width apart.
Utilizing a big arm swing and a countermovement of the legs, jump forward as far as you can.
Attempt to land with your feet out in front you, reaching as far as possible with your legs.
Measure the distance from your landing point to the starting point and track results.
instructions_zh: 这个练习最好在沙地或其他柔软落地区域进行。确保能够测量距离。以半蹲姿势站立，双脚与肩同宽。
利用大幅度摆臂和腿部反向动作，尽可能向前跳远。
尝试双脚向前伸落地，双腿尽可能远伸。
测量从落地点到起点的距离并记录结果。

document.name: Step Mill
instructions: To begin, step onto the stepmill and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Use caution so that you don't trip as you climb the stairs. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall.

Stepmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside while offering a similar rate of calories burned. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上台阶机并从菜单中选择所需选项。可以选择手动设置，或选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。爬楼梯时要注意不要绊倒。建议始终握住扶手，以防摔倒。
台阶机方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小，同时消耗卡路里速度相近。它们通常比其他有氧器械难得多。一个150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Stiff Leg Barbell Good Morning
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your legs stationary, move your torso forward by bending at the hips while inhaling. Lower your torso until it is parallel with the floor.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by elevating your torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 为了安全，此练习最好在深蹲架内进行。开始时，先将杠铃杆设置在最适合你身高的架子上。选择正确高度并装好杠铃后，走到杠铃下方，将杠铃杆放在肩后（略低于颈部）。
双手在身体两侧握住杠铃杆，先通过腿部发力并同时挺直躯干，将杠铃从架上抬起。
离开架子，双腿采用与肩同宽的中等站距。始终保持抬头，因为低头会使你失去平衡，同时保持背部挺直。这是起始姿势。
保持双腿不动，吸气时通过屈髋将躯干向前移动。下放躯干直到与地面平行。
呼气时，通过将躯干抬回起始位置开始抬起杠铃。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Tire Flip
instructions: Begin by gripping the bottom of the tire on the tread, and position your feet back a bit. Your chest should be driving into the tire.
To lift the tire, extend through the hips, knees, and ankles, driving into the tire and up.

As the tire reaches a 45 degree angle, step forward and drive a knee into the tire. As you do so adjust your grip to the upper portion of the tire and push it forward as hard as possible to complete the turn. Repeat as necessary.
instructions_zh: 开始时，双手抓住轮胎底部胎面，双脚稍微后站。胸部应向前顶住轮胎发力。
要抬起轮胎，伸展髋部、膝部和踝部，向轮胎内发力并向上抬起。
当轮胎达到45度角时，向前迈步并用膝盖顶住轮胎。同时将握位调整到轮胎上部，尽可能用力向前推，完成翻转。根据需要重复。

query: 给我推荐一款游戏显卡

document.name: 3/4 Sit-Up
instructions: Lie down on the floor and secure your feet. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind or to the side of your head. You will begin with your back on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Flex your hips and spine to raise your torso toward your knees.
At the top of the contraction your torso should be perpendicular to the ground. Reverse the motion, going only ¾ of the way down.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上并固定双脚，双腿屈膝。
双手放在脑后或头两侧。背部贴地作为起始姿势。
屈髋并屈曲脊柱，将躯干抬向膝盖。
收缩顶点时躯干应与地面垂直。然后反向还原，只下放约3/4行程。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Air Bike
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. For this exercise, you will need to put your hands beside your head. Be careful however to not strain with the neck as you perform it. Now lift your shoulders into the crunch position.
Bring knees up to where they are perpendicular to the floor, with your lower legs parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now simultaneously, slowly go through a cycle pedal motion kicking forward with the right leg and bringing in the knee of the left leg. Bring your right elbow close to your left knee by crunching to the side, as you breathe out.
Go back to the initial position as you breathe in.
Crunch to the opposite side as you cycle your legs and bring closer your left elbow to your right knee and exhale.
Continue alternating in this manner until all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.
instructions_zh: 平躺在地面上，下背部贴紧地面。双手放在头两侧。动作时注意不要使颈部过度受力。将肩膀抬离地面进入卷腹姿势。
屈膝抬起双腿，使大腿与地面垂直、小腿与地面平行。这是起始姿势。
现在同时缓慢做蹬车动作：右腿向前蹬出，左膝收向身体。向侧方卷腹，使右肘靠近左膝，同时呼气。
吸气并回到初始姿势。
继续蹬腿并向另一侧卷腹，使左肘靠近右膝，同时呼气。
继续交替进行，直到每侧完成所有建议次数。

document.name: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound
instructions: Assume a comfortable stance with one foot slightly in front of the other.
Begin by pushing off with the front leg, driving the opposite knee forward and as high as possible before landing. Attempt to cover as much distance to each side with each bound.
It may help to use a line on the ground to guage distance from side to side.
Repeat the sequence with the other leg.
instructions_zh: 采取舒适站姿，一只脚略位于另一只脚前方。
以前腿蹬地开始，推动对侧膝盖尽可能向前上方抬起，然后落地。每次跳跃尽量向两侧方向覆盖更大距离。
在地面画一条线来帮助判断左右两侧的距离可能会有帮助。
换另一条腿重复该序列。

document.name: Alternating Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Move the cables to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight.
Grasp the cables and hold them at shoulder height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your head and chest up, extend through the elbow to press one side directly over head.
After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
instructions_zh: 将绳索调到训练塔底部，并选择合适的重量。
抓住绳索，将其保持在肩部高度，掌心朝前。这是起始姿势。
保持头部和胸部抬起，伸直肘部将一侧直接推过头顶。
在顶部稍停后，回到起始位置，并在对侧重复。

document.name: Alternating Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to your shoulders.
Position one in place on your chest and then the other, gripping the kettlebells on the handle with the palms facing forward.
Extend both arms, so that the kettlebells are being held above your chest. Lower one kettlebell, bringing it to your chest and turn the wrist in the direction of the locked out kettlebell.
Raise the kettlebell and repeat on the opposite side.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在地面上，两只壶铃放在肩膀两侧。
先将一只壶铃放到胸前位置，再放另一只，握住壶铃手柄，掌心朝前。
伸直双臂，使壶铃位于胸部上方。放低一只壶铃至胸前，并将手腕转向另一只保持伸直锁定的壶铃方向。
抬起壶铃，并在对侧重复。

document.name: Anti-Gravity Press
instructions: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor. Flex the elbows, performing a reverse curl to bring the bar near your chest. This will be your starting position.
To begin, press the barbell out in front of your head by extending your elbows. Keep your arms parallel to the ground throughout the movement.
Return to the starting position and repeat to complete the set.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放在上斜训练凳头端后方的地面上。
俯卧在训练凳上。采用正握，从地面拿起杠铃。屈肘做反式弯举，将杠铃带到胸前附近。这将是你的起始姿势。
开始时，伸肘将杠铃向头部前方推出。整个动作过程中保持手臂与地面平行。
返回起始姿势并重复，完成该组。

document.name: Atlas Stone Trainer
instructions: This trainer is effective for developing Atlas Stone strength for those who don't have access to stones, and are typically made from bar ends or heavy pipe.
Begin by loading the desired weight onto the bar. Straddle the weight, wrapping your arms around the implement, bending at the hips.

Begin by pulling the weight up past the knees, extending through the hips. As the weight clears the knees, it can be lapped by resting it on your thighs and sitting back, hugging it tightly to your chest.
Finish the movement by extending through your hips and knees to raise the weight as high as possible. The weight can be returned to the lap or to the ground for successive repetitions.
instructions_zh: 这种训练器适合没有阿特拉斯石的人发展阿特拉斯石所需力量，通常由杠铃端头或重型管材制成。
先将目标重量装到杠铃上。跨立于重物两侧，双臂环抱器械，屈髋。
先通过伸髋将重物拉起超过膝盖。当重物过膝后，可将其搁在大腿上，臀部后坐，并紧抱于胸前。
最后伸髋伸膝，将重物尽可能抬高。可将重物放回大腿上或地面，以便连续重复。

document.name: Atlas Stones
instructions: Begin with the atlas stone between your feet. Bend at the hips to wrap your arms vertically around the Atlas Stone, attempting to get your fingers underneath the stone. Many stones will have a small flat portion on the bottom, which will make the stone easier to hold.
Pulling the stone into your torso, drive through the back half of your feet to pull the stone from the ground.
As the stone passes the knees, lap it by sitting backward, pulling the stone on top of your thighs.

Sit low, getting the stone high onto your chest as you change your grip to reach over the stone. Stand, driving through with your hips. Close distance to the loading platform, and lean back, extending the hips to get the stone as high as possible.
instructions_zh: 将阿特拉斯石放在双脚之间。屈髋，双臂竖直环抱石球，尽量让手指伸到石球下方。许多石球底部有一小块平面，会更便于抓握。
将石球拉向躯干，用脚掌后半部发力，将石球从地面拉起。
当石球过膝后，向后坐髋，将石球翻到大腿上。
降低身体重心，调整握法为从上方环抱石球，把石球抱到胸前高处。髋部发力站起。靠近装载平台，后仰并伸展髋部，将石球举到尽可能高。

document.name: Back Flyes - With Bands
instructions: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack.
Grab the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises.

Extend and lift the arms straight in front of you. Tip: Your arms should be straight and parallel to the floor while perpendicular to your torso. Your feet should be firmly planted on the floor spread at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, move your arms to the sides and back. Keep your arms extended and parallel to the floor. Continue the movement until the arms are extended to your sides.
After a pause, go back to the original position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕过深蹲架等固定立柱。
握住弹力带把手，向后站远，使弹力带张力增加。
双臂伸直并抬至身体正前方。提示：手臂应伸直、与地面平行，并与躯干垂直。双脚与肩同宽，稳稳踩地。这是起始姿势。
呼气时，将双臂向两侧后方移动。保持手臂伸直并与地面平行。继续动作，直到双臂向两侧展开。
稍作停顿后，吸气回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Backward Drag
instructions: Load a sled with the desired weight, attaching a rope or straps to the sled that you can hold onto.
Begin the exercise by moving backwards for a given distance. Leaning back, extend through the legs for short steps to move as quickly as possible.
instructions_zh: 给雪橇装上所需重量，并在雪橇上系好可抓握的绳索或拉带。
开始练习时向后移动一定距离。身体后仰，通过腿部伸展迈小步，尽可能快速地后退。

document.name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw
instructions: This exercise is best done with a partner. If you lack a partner, the ball can be thrown and retrieved or thrown against a wall.
Begin standing a few meters in front of your partner, both facing the same direction. Begin holding the ball between your legs.
Squat down and then forcefully reverse direction, coming to full extension and you toss the ball over your head to your partner.
Your partner can then roll the ball back to you. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 这项练习最好与同伴一起完成。如果没有同伴，可以抛出后自行捡回，或向墙壁抛掷。
开始时站在同伴前方几米处，两人面朝同一方向。双手将药球置于双腿之间。
下蹲，然后用力反向发力，充分伸展身体，将药球从头顶向后抛给同伴。
同伴随后可将球滚回给你。按所需次数重复。

document.name: Balance Board
instructions: Place a balance board in front of you.
Stand up on it and try to balance yourself.
Hold the balance for as long as desired.
instructions_zh: 将平衡板放在身前。
站上平衡板，努力保持身体平衡。
按需保持平衡所需时间。

document.name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Choke the band around the center of the pullup bar. You can use different bands to provide varying levels of assistance.
Pull the end of the band down, and place one bent knee into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out. Take a medium to wide grip on the bar. This will be your starting position.

Pull yourself upward by contracting the lats as you flex the elbow. The elbow should be driven to your side. Pull to the front, attempting to get your chin over the bar. Avoid swinging or jerking movements.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕在引体向上杆中央并收紧。可使用不同弹力带提供不同程度的辅助。
将弹力带一端向下拉，把一条弯曲的膝盖伸入带圈，确保不会滑脱。以中等至较宽握距握住单杠。这是起始姿势。
收缩背阔肌并屈肘将身体向上拉。肘部应向身体两侧下压。向前上方拉，尽量使下巴超过单杠。避免摆动或猛拉。
短暂停顿后，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Band Good Morning
instructions: Using a 41 inch band, stand on one end, spreading your feet a small amount. Bend at the hips to loop the end of the band behind your neck. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your legs straight, extend through the hips to come to a near vertical position.
Ensure that you do not round your back as you go down back to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 使用41英寸弹力带，双脚略微分开站在一端，屈髋将另一端绕到颈后。这是起始姿势。
保持双腿伸直，通过伸髋起身至接近直立。
回到起始姿势下放时，确保不要弓背。

document.name: Band Good Morning (Pull Through)
instructions: Loop the band around a post. Standing a little ways away, loop the opposite end around the neck. Your hands can help hold the band in position.
Begin by bending at the hips, getting your butt back as far as possible. Keep your back flat and bend forward to about 90 degrees. Your knees should be only slightly bent.
Return to the starting position be driving through with the hips to come back to a standing position.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕在固定柱上。站在稍远处，把另一端绕到颈后，可用双手帮助固定弹力带位置。
先屈髋，尽量把臀部向后推。保持背部平直，向前俯身约90度，膝盖只应轻微弯曲。
通过髋部发力回到站立起始姿势。

document.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
From the starting position, breathe in and begin coming down slowly until the bar touches your middle chest.

After a brief pause, push the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out. Focus on pushing the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position at the top of the motion, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在平凳上。采用中等握距（使动作中点时前臂与上臂约成90度），从架上取下杠铃，双臂锁定将杠铃笔直举于身体上方。这是起始姿势。
从起始姿势吸气，开始缓慢下放，直到杠铃触及胸部中部。
短暂停顿后，呼气将杠铃推回起始姿势。集中用胸肌发力推起。在动作顶端手臂锁定并挤压胸肌，保持一秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：理想情况下，下放重量所需时间约为上推时间的两倍。
按规定次数重复。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on you upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: it should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在上斜训练凳上。采用中等握距（即动作中段时前臂与上臂约呈90度角），从架上取下杠铃，双臂伸直锁定，将杠铃保持在身体正上方。这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到感觉杠铃接触上胸部。
停顿1秒后，呼气并用胸部肌肉将杠铃推回起始位置。在收缩位置锁定手臂，挤压胸肌，保持1秒，然后再次缓慢下放。提示：下放所用时间至少应为上推时间的两倍。
按建议次数重复该动作。
完成后将杠铃放回架上。

document.name: Conan's Wheel
instructions: With the weight loaded, take a zurcher hold on the end of the implement. Place the bar in the crook of the elbow and hold onto your wrist. Try to keep the weight off of the forearms.

Begin by lifting the weight from the ground. Keep a tight, upright posture as you being to walk, taking short, fast steps. Look up and away as you turn in a circle. Do not hold your breath during the event. Continue walking until you complete one or more complete turns.
instructions_zh: 加载重量后，用泽奇握法握住器械末端。将杠铃置于肘窝处并握住自己的手腕。尽量让重量不要压在前臂上。
先将重量从地面提起。开始行走时保持收紧、直立的姿势，采用短而快的步伐。转身绕圈时抬头并看向远处。过程中不要憋气。继续行走，直到完成一圈或多圈完整旋转。

document.name: Dip Machine
instructions: Sit securely in a dip machine, select the weight and firmly grasp the handles.
Now keep your elbows in at your sides in order to place emphasis on the triceps. The elbows should be bent at a 90 degree angle.
As you contract the triceps, extend your arms downwards as you exhale. Tip: At the bottom of the movement, focus on keeping a little bend in your arms to keep tension on the triceps muscle.
Now slowly let your arms come back up to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 稳坐在双杠臂屈伸机上，选择重量并紧握手柄。
将肘部收于身体两侧，以强调肱三头肌。肘部应弯曲约90度。
收缩肱三头肌，呼气的同时将手臂向下伸直。提示：动作底部注意保持手臂微屈，使肱三头肌持续受力。
吸气，缓慢让手臂回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Hack Squat
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将躯干后侧贴住器械靠背垫，把肩膀挂在提供的肩垫下方。
双脚站在踏板上，采用与肩同宽的中等站距，脚尖略微外展。提示：始终抬头，并始终保持背部贴紧靠垫。
双手放在器械两侧把手上，解除安全杆（大多数设计中，将侧把手从朝前位置转到斜向位置即可）。
现在伸直双腿，但不要锁死膝盖。这是起始姿势。（注：本说明采用上述中等站距，以全面发展为目标；不过你也可以选择脚位部分所述的三种站距中的任意一种。）
开始缓慢屈膝下放器械，同时保持身体挺直、抬头（背部始终贴垫）。继续下放，直到大腿与小腿之间的角度略小于90度（即大腿低于与地面平行的位置）。此阶段吸气。提示：如果动作正确，膝盖前方应与脚尖形成一条垂直于前方的假想直线。如果膝盖超过这条假想线（即超过脚尖），就会给膝关节带来不必要的压力，说明动作执行不正确。
开始呼气并向上抬起器械，主要用脚跟蹬地，再次伸直双腿，回到起始姿势。
重复建议次数。

document.name: Leverage Deadlift
instructions: Load the pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between the handles. Grasp the bottom handles with a comfortable grip, and then lower your hips as you take a breath. Look forward with your head and keep your chest up. This will be your starting position.
Return the weight to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 在配重销上加载适当重量。站在两个把手正中间。以舒适握法握住下方把手，然后吸气并降低髋部。头朝前看，保持胸部挺起。这是起始姿势。
将重量放回起始位置。

document.name: Leverage High Row
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you. Adjust the knee pad to help keep you down. Grasp the handles with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your shoulder blades as you flex the elbow.
Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handles to the starting position.
For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
instructions_zh: 在配重销上加载适当重量，并调节座椅高度，使你刚好能够到头顶上方的把手。调节膝垫以帮助固定身体。用正握握住把手。这是起始姿势。
将把手拉向躯干，屈肘的同时后收肩胛骨。
在动作底部停顿，然后缓慢将把手放回起始位置。
进行多次重复时，避免将重量完全放回挡块，以保持目标肌肉的张力。

document.name: Linear 3-Part Start Technique
instructions: This drill helps you accelerate as quickly as possible into a sprint from a dead stop. It helps to use a line to start from. Begin with two feet on the line. Place your left foot with the toe next to your right ankle. Place your right foot 4-6 inches behind the left.
Place your right hand onto the line, and thing bring your nose close to your left knee.
Squat down as you lean foward, your head being lower than your hips and your weight loaded onto the left leg. This will be your starting position.
Take your left hand up so that it is parallel to the ground, pointing behind you, and explode out when ready.
instructions_zh: 该练习有助于从静止状态尽可能快地加速进入冲刺。可借助一条线作为起点。开始时双脚位于线上。将左脚脚尖放在右脚踝旁。将右脚放在左脚后方4–6英寸处。
将右手放在线上，然后把鼻子靠近左膝。
下蹲并身体前倾，使头部低于髋部，将体重加载到左腿上。这是起始姿势。
将左手抬起至与地面平行，指向身后，准备好后爆发式冲出。

document.name: Linear Acceleration Wall Drill
instructions: Lean at around 45 degrees against a wall. Your feet should be together, glutes contracted.
Begin by lifting your right knee quickly, pausing, and then driving it straight down into the ground.
Switch legs, raising the opposite knee, and then attacking the ground straight down.
Repeat once more with your right leg, and as soon as the right foot strikes the ground hammer them out rapidly, alternating left and right as fast as you can.
instructions_zh: 身体与墙面约呈45度前倾靠墙。双脚并拢，收紧臀部。
开始时快速抬起右膝，稍作停顿，然后笔直向下蹬地。
换腿，抬起对侧膝盖，然后笔直向下蹬地。
右腿再重复一次，一旦右脚触地，就尽可能快速地左右交替蹬地。

document.name: Lying Machine Squat
instructions: Adjust the leg machine to a height that will allow you to get inside it with your knees bent and the thighs slightly below parallel.

Once you select the weight, position yourself inside the machine face up with the knees bent and thighs slightly below parallel to the platform. Make sure that the knees do not go past the toes. The angle created between the hamstrings and the calves should be one that is slightly less than 90 degrees (since your starting position requires you to start slightly below parallel). Your back and your head should be resting on the machine while your shoulders are pressed under the shoulder pads.
Place your hands by the handles and position your feet slightly pointing out at a shoulder width position. This will be your starting position.

While pressing with the balls of the feet as you breathe out, make your whole body erect as you squeeze the quads. Hold the contracted position for a second. Tip: Since you are starting below parallel, you can opt to use your hands to help you up by pressing on your thighs only on the first repetition.

Slowly squat down as you inhale but instead of going all the way down to the starting position, just stop once your thighs are parallel to the platform. The angle between your hamstrings and calves should be a 90-degree angle.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 调整腿部器械高度，使你能屈膝进入，且大腿略低于平行位。
选择重量后，面朝上进入器械，屈膝，大腿略低于平台平行。确保膝盖不超过脚尖。腘绳肌与小腿之间的夹角应略小于90度，因为起始位需略低于平行。背部和头靠器械，肩部压于肩垫下。
双手扶把手，双脚略外展，与肩同宽。这是起始姿势。
呼气时用前脚掌发力，收紧股四头肌使身体直立。收缩位停顿1秒。提示：由于起始位低于平行，第一次重复可仅用手压大腿帮助起身。
吸气时缓慢下蹲，但不要完全下到起始位，只到大腿与平台平行时停止。腘绳肌与小腿夹角应为90度。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Machine Bicep Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat to the appropriate height and make your weight selection. Place your upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.
Perform the movement by flexing the elbow, pulling your lower arm towards your upper arm.
Pause at the top of the movement, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position.
Avoid returning the weight all the way to the stops until the set is complete to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
instructions_zh: 将座椅调整到合适高度并选择重量。把上臂贴靠在垫上并握住把手。此为起始姿势。
通过屈肘完成动作，将前臂向上臂方向拉起。
在动作顶端稍作停顿，然后缓慢将重量放回起始位置。
在一组动作完成前，不要让重量完全回到限位，以保持目标肌肉的张力。

document.name: Narrow Stance Hack Squats
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.

Position your legs in the platform using a less than shoulder width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Your feet should be around 3 inches or less apart. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).
Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position.

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heels of your feet as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 将躯干后侧靠在机器的背垫上，双肩顶在肩垫下方。
双脚采用小于肩宽的窄站距踩在踏板上，脚尖略微外展。双脚间距约3英寸或更小。提示：始终保持抬头，并始终让背部贴紧背垫。
双手放在机器两侧把手上，解除安全杆（多数设计中，将侧把手从前向位置转到斜向位置即可）。
现在伸直双腿，但不要锁死膝盖。这是起始姿势。
开始缓慢屈膝下放器械，同时保持身体挺直、抬头（背部始终贴紧背垫）。继续下放，直到大腿与小腿之间的角度略小于90度（即大腿低于与地面平行的位置）。下放过程中吸气。
开始呼气并向上推起器械，主要用脚跟蹬地，再次伸直双腿并回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Pyramid
instructions: Start off by rolling your torso forward onto the ball so your hips rest on top of the ball and become the highest point of your body.

Rest your hands and feet on the floor. Your arms and legs can be slightly bent or straight, depending on the size of the ball, your flexibility, and the length of your limbs. This also helps develop stabilizing strength in your torso and shoulders.
instructions_zh: 首先将躯干向前滚到球上，使髋部停在球的上方，并成为身体的最高点。
双手和双脚撑在地面上。手臂和腿可以略微弯曲或伸直，具体取决于球的大小、你的柔韧性和四肢长度。这也有助于发展躯干和肩部的稳定力量。

document.name: Recumbent Bike
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.

Select the desired option from the menu. You may have to start pedaling to turn it on. You can use the manual setting, or you can select a program to use. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. The level of resistance can be changed throughout the workout. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Recumbent bikes offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and have less impact than other activities. A 150 lb person will burn about 230 calories cycling at a moderate rate for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories or more running.
instructions_zh: 首先，坐上健身车并根据身高调节座椅。
从菜单中选择所需模式。可能需要开始踩踏才能开机。可使用手动模式，也可选择程序。通常可输入年龄和体重来估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。整个锻炼过程中可调节阻力级别。扶手可用于监测心率，帮助保持合适强度。
卧式健身车方便、有益心血管，且冲击比其它活动小。体重150磅的人以中等速度骑行30分钟约消耗230卡路里，而跑步可消耗450卡路里或更多。

document.name: Single-Cone Sprint Drill
instructions: This drill teaches quick foot action. You need a single cone. Begin standing next to the cone with one arm back and one arm forward.
Chop the feet as quickly as possible, blocking with the arms. Circle the cone, keep your knees up, with violent foot action.
Rest after three trips around the cone.
instructions_zh: 这个练习用于训练快速步频。需要一个锥桶。开始时站在锥桶旁边，一臂向后、一臂向前。
尽可能快速地原地碎步，双臂配合摆动。绕锥桶跑动，保持膝盖抬起，脚步动作快速有力。
绕锥桶完成三圈后休息。

document.name: Stairmaster
instructions: To begin, step onto the stairmaster and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

Pump your legs up and down in an established rhythm, driving the pedals down but not all the way to the floor. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Stairmasters offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上楼梯机，从菜单中选择所需选项。可选择手动模式，也可选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重，以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。
双腿以稳定节奏上下踩踏，向下驱动踏板，但不要一直踩到底。建议始终握住扶手，以免摔倒。扶手可用于监测心率，帮助你保持合适强度。
楼梯机使用方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小。它们通常比其他有氧器械更费力。体重150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Step Mill
instructions: To begin, step onto the stepmill and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Use caution so that you don't trip as you climb the stairs. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall.

Stepmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside while offering a similar rate of calories burned. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
instructions_zh: 开始时，踏上台阶机并从菜单中选择所需选项。可以选择手动设置，或选择程序运行。通常可输入年龄和体重以估算运动期间消耗的卡路里。爬楼梯时要注意不要绊倒。建议始终握住扶手，以防摔倒。
台阶机方便、有益心血管，通常比户外跑步冲击更小，同时消耗卡路里速度相近。它们通常比其他有氧器械难得多。一个150磅的人30分钟通常可消耗超过300卡路里，而步行约消耗175卡路里。

document.name: Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw
instructions: Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent. Hold the ball with one hand, extending the arm fully behind your head. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement at the shoulder, throwing the ball directly forward of you as you sit up, attempting to go for maximum distance.
The ball can be thrown to a partner or bounced off of a wall.
instructions_zh: 仰卧于地面，双膝弯曲。单手持球，将手臂完全伸向头后方。这是起始姿势。
从肩部发起动作，在坐起的同时将球向正前方抛出，尽量抛得更远。
可将球抛给搭档，或掷向墙面反弹。

document.name: Dumbbell Lunges
instructions: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. This will be your starting position.

Step forward with your right leg around 2 feet or so from the foot being left stationary behind and lower your upper body down, while keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance. Inhale as you go down. Note: As in the other exercises, do not allow your knee to go forward beyond your toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the knee joint. Make sure that you keep your front shin perpendicular to the ground.
Using mainly the heel of your foot, push up and go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat the movement for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
instructions_zh: 站直，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。这是起始姿势。
右腿向前迈约2英尺（约60厘米），后脚保持原地不动，降低上身，同时保持躯干直立并维持平衡。下蹲时吸气。注意：与其他动作一样，下蹲时不要让膝盖超过脚尖，以免给膝关节带来过度压力。确保前侧小腿与地面垂直。
主要用脚跟发力推起，呼气时回到起始姿势。
按建议次数重复该动作，然后换左腿进行。

document.name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. This will be your starting position.

Step backward with your right leg around two feet or so from the left foot and lower your upper body down, while keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance. Inhale as you go down. Tip: As in the other exercises, do not allow your knee to go forward beyond your toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the knee joint. Make sure that you keep your front shin perpendicular to the ground. Keep the torso upright during the lunge; flexible hip flexors are important. A long lunge emphasizes the Gluteus Maximus; a short lunge emphasizes Quadriceps.
Push up and go back to the starting position as you exhale. Tip: Use the ball of your feet to push in order to accentuate the quadriceps. To focus on the glutes, press with your heels.
Now repeat with the opposite leg.
instructions_zh: 站直，躯干保持直立，双手各持一只哑铃垂于身体两侧。这是起始姿势。
右腿向后迈约两英尺（约60厘米），降低上半身，同时保持躯干直立并维持平衡。下蹲时吸气。提示：与其他练习一样，下蹲时不要让膝盖超过脚尖，否则会给膝关节带来过度压力。确保前侧小腿与地面垂直。弓步过程中保持躯干直立；髋屈肌柔韧性很重要。长距离弓步更强调臀大肌；短距离弓步更强调股四头肌。
呼气时向上推起，回到起始姿势。提示：用前脚掌发力以更强调股四头肌；若想重点刺激臀部，则用脚跟发力。
现在换另一条腿重复。

document.name: Dumbbell Seated Box Jump
instructions: Position a box a couple feet to the side of a bench. Hold a dumbbell to your chest with both hands and seat yourself on the bench facing the box. This will be your starting position.
Plant your feet firmly on the ground as you lean forward, extending through the hips and knees to jump up and forward.
Land on the box with both feet, absorbing the impact by allowing the hips and knees to bend.
Step down and return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 将一个跳箱放在长凳旁约几英尺处。双手将一只哑铃抱在胸前，坐在长凳上，面向跳箱。这是起始姿势。
双脚牢牢踩地，身体前倾，伸展髋部和膝部，向上并向前跳起。
双脚落在跳箱上，通过屈髋屈膝缓冲冲击。
走下跳箱，回到起始姿势。

document.name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section.

Begin to slowly lower your torso by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise your torso as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 站直，双手各持一只哑铃（掌心朝向腿侧）。
双腿采用与肩同宽的中等站距，脚尖略微外展。始终保持抬头，因为低头会使你失去平衡，并保持背部挺直。这是起始姿势。注：本说明采用上述中等站距，以促进整体发展；不过你也可以选择脚位部分讨论的三种站距中的任意一种。
开始缓慢下蹲，屈膝，同时保持姿势挺直、抬头。继续下蹲直到大腿与地面平行。提示：如果动作正确，膝盖前侧应与脚尖形成一条垂直于前方的假想直线。如果膝盖超过该假想线（超过脚尖），就会给膝盖造成不必要的压力，说明动作错误。
开始起身，呼气，主要用脚跟蹬地，同时伸直双腿回到起始位置。
按推荐次数重复。

document.name: Dumbbell Squat To A Bench
instructions: Stand up straight with a flat bench behind you while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section.

Begin to slowly lower your torso by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until you slightly touch the bench behind you. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 站直，身后放一张平凳，双手各持一只哑铃（掌心朝向腿侧）。
双腿采用与肩同宽的中等站距，脚尖略微外展。始终保持抬头，因为低头会使你失去平衡，并保持背部挺直。这是起始姿势。注：本说明采用上述中等站距，以促进整体发展；不过你也可以选择脚位部分讨论的三种站距中的任意一种。
开始缓慢下蹲，屈膝，同时保持姿势挺直、抬头。继续下蹲直到轻触身后的平凳。做这部分动作时吸气。提示：如果动作正确，膝盖前侧应与脚尖形成一条垂直于前方的假想直线。如果膝盖超过该假想线（超过脚尖），就会给膝盖造成不必要的压力，说明动作错误。
开始起身，呼气，主要用脚跟蹬地，同时伸直双腿回到起始位置。
按推荐次数重复。

document.name: Dumbbell Step Ups
instructions: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Place the right foot on the elevated platform. Step on the platform by extending the hip and the knee of your right leg. Use the heel mainly to lift the rest of your body up and place the foot of the left leg on the platform as well. Breathe out as you execute the force required to come up.

Step down with the left leg by flexing the hip and knee of the right leg as you inhale. Return to the original standing position by placing the right foot of to next to the left foot on the initial position.
Repeat with the right leg for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
instructions_zh: 站直，双手各持一只哑铃（掌心朝向腿侧）。
将右脚放在抬高的平台上。伸展右腿的髋部和膝部踏上平台。主要用脚跟发力将身体其余部分抬起，并将左脚也放到平台上。发力起身时呼气。
左腿下台阶，同时屈曲右腿的髋部和膝部，吸气。右脚放回左脚旁，回到最初的站立姿势。
右腿按推荐次数重复，然后换左腿进行。

document.name: Plie Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at the base with both hands and stand straight up. Move your legs so that they are wider than shoulder width apart from each other with your knees slightly bent.
Your toes should be facing out. Note: Your arms should be stationary while performing the exercise. This is the starting position.
Slowly bend the knees and lower your legs until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Make sure to inhale as this is the eccentric part of the exercise.
Press mainly with the heel of the foot to bring the body back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_zh: 双手在底部握住一只哑铃，站直。双腿分开至比肩宽更宽，膝盖微屈。
脚尖朝外。注意：动作过程中手臂应保持不动。这是起始姿势。
缓慢屈膝下蹲，直到大腿与地面平行。下蹲时吸气，因为这是离心阶段。
主要用脚跟发力，将身体推回起始姿势，同时呼气。
按建议次数重复。

document.name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
instructions: Position yourself into a staggered stance with the rear foot elevated and front foot forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, letting them hang at the sides. This will be your starting position.
Begin by descending, flexing your knee and hip to lower your body down. Maintain good posture througout the movement. Keep the front knee in line with the foot as you perform the exercise.
At the bottom of the movement, drive through the heel to extend the knee and hip to return to the starting position.
instructions_zh: 进入交错站姿，后脚抬高，前脚向前。
双手各持一只哑铃，让其自然垂于体侧。这是起始姿势。
开始下蹲，屈膝屈髋降低身体。整个动作保持良好姿态。执行时前膝与脚保持对齐。
动作最低点，通过脚跟发力伸展膝和髋，回到起始姿势。
